title: Account Development Representative I - France
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Hi there! We're hiring a French-speaking ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you will do:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Fluency in French

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-JS1 #LI-Remote #France

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $91,000.00 to $181,700.00

  • United Kingdom: £57,200.00 to £116,400.00

  • Singapore: S$113,100.00 to S$209,900.00

  • France: €58,800.00 to €120,500

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process:Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

For information about how your personal data is processed, please refer to Camunda’s Applicant Privacy Policy. We note that phone numbers and SMS opt-in data are not shared, sold, or rented to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

By opting in to SMS use, please be aware that:

  • Text message frequency may vary;

  • Standard text message and data rates may apply; and

  • By opting in, you will be enrolled directly in ongoing recruiting text messages from Camunda.

To opt-out, simply select 'No' when prompted during your application. You can also change your preferences at any time by contacting ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

title: Account Director - Enterprise Tech & Media
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, UK

Weekly office requirement: Minimum 2 days per week
Employment type: permanent


At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for an Account Director to play a key role in our Enterprise Tech & Media team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.


Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔

As an Account Director in the Enterprise Tech & Media team, you’ll help support our global expansion, working across our most lucrative Tech clients, like Meta and Microsoft. GWI is the world's most revealing data set on consumer behaviors. We work with the world's largest Media Owners, Agencies and Brands to help drive smarter marketing decisions and generate revenue.


A few things you’ll be responsible for: 

👉 Work closely with your Senior Director Tech & Media to intensify and expand your tech platform client relationships.

👉 Help to drive and execute the expansion strategy and grow assigned portfolio year-on-year; including building client mappings and ability to perform gap analysis

👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.

👉 Regularly lead client conversations and detailed presentations face-to-face, via email, on the phone and via screen share.

👉 Identify and engage with key target contacts via personal network, qualified in-bound leads and proactive outbound engagement with key DM’s in defined vertical against defined corporate targets

👉 Project-manage and prepare client presentations by using GWI datasets and deliver tailored pitch and proposal documents

👉 Diligent approach to tracking all conversations and managing all sales opportunities via Salesforce.

👉 Stay up-to-date on key developments and changes within the GWI product eco-system; as well as have an acute awareness of wider developments in the digital and media advertising landscape.

It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.

What do I need to bring with me? 🧳

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:

👉 Proven Account Management experience working with top tier clients in the media, platform, advertising or research industry.

👉 Commercial Tenacity & Resilience: Unwavering determination and drive to consistently surpass client expectations and revenue goals, remaining composed, optimistic, and focused during high-stakes renewal and expansion negotiations.

👉 Knowledge/network of clients of the media/advertising industry.

👉 Detailed understanding of the SaaS revenue model and how to identify growth potentials

👉 Great knowledge in consumer research and how current trends change their behavior.

👉 Proven track of working in the research sector, including knowledge of quant and qual methodologies

👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.  - a driver for this skill could be 'Relationship building' 

👉Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to build trust at C-level.

👉Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and problem-solving skills.


Why Join Us

👉 Be part of something that matters. Join a disruptor shaping the global market research industry, where your work drives real impact

👉 Think big, move fast. You'll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech, working on problems that actually challenge you

👉 Collaboration at the core. Thrive in a forward-thinking team that values ambition, curiosity, and genuine respect for one another

👉 A culture that trusts you. We're not afraid to ask why, and neither should you be. Entrepreneurial spirit is celebrated here

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.

We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.

At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Account Executive to drive new B2B business for Proton in Switzerland. You will own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying opportunities to negotiating and closing deals. You will build relationships with senior decision-makers, develop strategic partnerships across the Swiss business and public-sector ecosystems, and help grow Proton's presence in its home market.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Creation & Strategic Opportunity Development

• Identify and develop new strategic opportunities across target segments

• Build and manage your own pipeline of high-quality opportunities

• Balance long-term opportunity creation with closing deals

Strategic Partnerships

• Identify, engage, and develop partnerships with corporates, industry bodies, service providers and ecosystem partners (including co-selling opportunities)

Market Development (Switzerland Focus)

• Leverage your existing network within Swiss corporates and organizations

• Expand Proton's presence within local business and public-sector ecosystems

• Identify high-value entry points into target companies

Relationship Building

• Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders (IT, security, leadership)

• Act as a trusted advisor and entry point into organizations

• Navigate complex organizational structures to identify opportunities

Full Sales Cycle Ownership

• Own the full sales cycle, from first contact to signed contract

• Identify and qualify opportunities

• Run discovery to understand use case, stakeholders and potential deal scope

• Negotiate and close deals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Sales leadership to align on target segments

• Provide feedback on market opportunities and ICP evolution

• Share insights from partnerships and market interactions

What We’re Looking For

Experience

• 3–7 years in Account Executive, Business Development or Strategic Sales roles, owning the full sales cycle

• Proven experience selling in the Swiss market (required)

• Experience in B2B SaaS or technology environments

• Proven track record of generating pipeline and closing deals

Network

• Strong existing network within Swiss companies and/or public-sector ecosystems (highly preferred)

• Appetite to develop and grow a network of Swiss customers

Skills

• Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities

• Ability to identify and develop strategic opportunities

• Strong negotiation and closing skills

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Comfortable operating without a structured playbook

Languages

• Fluent in Swiss German and English (required)

• French is a strong plus

Mindset

• Hunter mindset focused on opportunity creation and closing

• Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

• Long-term relationship builder

Location

• Geneva, Zurich or remotely within Switzerland.

What we offer

  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
  • Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Check our social media to learn more about Proton: 

LinkedIn ,Reddit ,X, YouTube

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at -----

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the role

Zone & Co. is looking for a high-velocity Account Executive to sell finance automation solutions to the Office of the CFO. We move fast, set ambitious goals, and expect our team to deliver. Our targets are designed to be achievable, and we're looking for disciplined, driven sellers who know how to manage a pipeline, maintain deal momentum, and consistently convert opportunities into closed business.

You'll own pipeline generation through strategic outbound prospecting, complemented by additional opportunities from our partner ecosystem and marketing team.

If you thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, are comfortable navigating short sales cycles, bring rigor to your MEDDPICC process, and enjoy building relationships face-to-face with partners and customers, this could be the opportunity for you. You'll also have the chance to develop deep expertise across a broad and growing product portfolio in a dynamic, expanding market.

What you'll do:

  • Own a net new number. Win new logos across a defined EMEA territory against an annual ARR target, measured monthly and quarterly.
  • Build your own pipeline. Outbound is part of the job, every week: calls, sequences, LinkedIn, and your own network. Partner and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.
  • Get out there. Travel to partner offices, industry events, and customer meetings. Face time with partners and clients is key.
  • Work the partner ecosystem. Build trusted relationships with our implementation and referral partners so they bring you in early and back you to close.
  • Run a high-velocity motion. Manage 30 + active opportunities at once and close 10–15 deals a month, from first call through pricing, paper process and signature.
  • Sell with discipline. Use MEDDPICC on every deal: find the pain, the metrics and the economic buyer, build a champion, and run a clear close plan with a next step every time.
  • Sell the whole journey. We are positioning the complete end-to-end story. We want to connect the customer pain with how to solve finance challenges, and turn that vision into bigger, multi-product wins.
  • Partner with Solution Consulting. Bring in SCs at the right moment for sharp, tailored demos on larger deals.
  • Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce clean and call your number with confidence every week.

What success looks like:

  • You consistently hit, and regularly beat, your monthly and quarterly ARR targets.
  • Your pipeline is a good mix of self-sourced and partner-sourced from relationships you've built.
  • Partners know you by name and bring you into their deals early.
  • Your deals are MEDDPICC-complete, your forecast is reliable, and your average deal size grows as you sell more of the platform.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years closing net new SaaS business, with a track record of hitting and overachieving ARR targets in a fast-paced, transactional or mid-market motion.
  • A real outbound habit: you prospect daily and you're proud of the pipeline you create yourself.
  • Strong MEDDPICC (or MEDDIC) skills, applied for real, not just known.
  • Commercial acumen: you understand ROI, pricing and negotiation, and you're comfortable talking value with finance leaders and CFOs.
  • Experience selling to the Office of the CFO AP Automation, Procure-to-Pay, billing, payments or order-to-cash, is a big plus. NetSuite ecosystem experience is a bonus.
  • A diligent, organised approach: you manage a busy pipeline without dropping the detail.
  • A keen eye to learn. Our product set grows through innovation and acquisition, and you'll want to master new products fast.
  • Happy on the road: comfortable travelling to partner sites, events and client meetings across the UK and EMEA.
  • Confident with Salesforce, Gong and modern sales tools. As well as AI tools such as Clay and Claude.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

United States

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

Non-US Jurisdictions

This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence.  Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

title: Account Executive, Digital Natives
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across the UK and Northern Europe. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

Working with product and science:

  • Bring customer feedback, usage patterns, and competitive insight back to our product and science teams to inform priorities and the roadmap

  • Connect customers directly with our product and research teams where it accelerates their success

What We're Looking For:

  • 5 to 8 years of sales experience, with a track record of closing deals with startups and scale-ups for a technical product (API, developer tools, infrastructure, or data)

  • Experience selling to technical buyers: founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders

  • Working knowledge of how AI products are built, and the ability to hold a credible conversation about models, evaluation, and deployment with an engineering audience

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup, ideally in AI, developer tools, or infrastructure

  • Comfort with usage-based revenue, where growth comes from what customers ship rather than from a single contract

  • Excellent English; French, German, Dutch, or a Nordic language is a plus

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, and a hands-on, low-ego approach

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Your territory. Your pipeline. Your impact.

title: Account Lead strategic Influencer Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du arbeitest im Influencer Marketing und denkst manchmal: Da müsste eigentlich noch mehr gehen? Mehr Strategie. Mehr Verantwortung. Größere Marken. Größere Ideen. Ein eigenes Team. Und vor allem mehr Einfluss darauf, was am Ende wirklich passiert und was im besten Fall die Branche prägt?

Then keep reading. 👀

Ykone zählt zu den führenden Influencer Marketing Agenturen weltweit. Seit über 13 Jahren gestalten wir die Branche mit und arbeiten heute mit internationalen Top Brands aus Beauty, Fashion, Luxury, Lifestyle und Tech. Von München über Paris, Mailand und London bis Dubai verbinden unsere Teams lokale Expertise mit einem globalen Netzwerk.

In Deutschland sind wir gerade in einer besonders spannenden Phase: Wir wachsen, gewinnen große internationale Etats und entwickeln gleichzeitig weiter, wie Influencer Marketing in Zukunft funktioniert. Strategischer, kreativer, technologischer und skalierbarer.

Das macht Ykone zu einem Ort für Menschen, die mehr wollen als den nächsten Job. Die Verantwortung übernehmen, große Ideen vorantreiben, andere mitnehmen und wirklich Einfluss darauf haben wollen, was wir als Agentur und für unsere Kunden aufbauen.

Aufgaben

Wir suchen jemanden, der übernimmt. Als Account Lead strategic Influencer Marketing verantwortest du mehrere unserer wichtigsten internationalen Kunden aus Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle und Tech.

Du entwickelst ihre Influencer Strategie, berätst Marketing Leads auf Senior Level, führst große Pitches, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Konzepte und erkennst Business Potenziale, bevor der Kunde danach fragt.

Und: Du führst Menschen. Nicht im Sinne von Aufgaben verteilen und Status Calls führen. Sondern indem du Standards setzt, andere besser machst, challengest, inspirierst, Entscheidungen triffst und deinem Team zutraust, über sich hinauszuwachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Accounts führen: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für mehrere unserer wichtigsten Kunden und bist strategische Ansprechpartner auf Senior Level. Du kennst ihr Business, ihre Herausforderungen und Ziele und denkst ihnen einen Schritt voraus.

  • Strategische Richtung vorgeben: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Strategy und deinem Team Jahresstrategien und große Kampagnenideen, challengest bestehende Ansätze und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit nicht nur kreativ überzeugt, sondern auf die Business- und Marketingziele unserer Kunden einzahlt.

  • Business entwickeln: Du erkennst Potenziale, bevor daraus ein Briefing entsteht. Du identifizierst neue Themen, Services und Budgets, entwickelst daraus konkrete Opportunities und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiter aus.

  • Pitches gewinnen: Du führst große Pitches und strategische Präsentationen federführend, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Spezialist die richtige Story und überzeugst Kunden von unseren Ideen.

  • Teams führen und entwickeln: Du führst dein eigenes Account-Team, gibst Richtung und klare Standards vor und entwickelst Menschen weiter. Du musst nicht jede Aufgabe selbst lösen. Dein Job ist es, dein Team so gut zu machen, dass es Verantwortung übernehmen und über sich hinauswachsen kann.

  • Die richtigen Expert zusammenbringen: Influencer Marketing ist für uns längst mehr als klassische Kampagnen. Du verbindest deine Accounts mit unseren Expert aus Strategy, Creative, Events, Social, Paid und Scaled Campaigns und entwickelst daraus Lösungen, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen.

  • Wirtschaftliche Verantwortung übernehmen: Du steuerst Budgets und Ressourcen über deine Accounts hinweg, behältst Forecast, Profitabilität und Wachstum im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit unternehmerischem Verständnis.

  • Qualität verantworten: Du musst nicht in jedem Projekt operativ arbeiten, aber du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass Strategie, Kreation und Umsetzung unseren Anspruch erfüllen und Ergebnisse liefern.

  • YKONE mitgestalten: Du denkst über deine eigenen Accounts hinaus, bringst neue Ideen und Perspektiven ein, challengest uns als Agentur und hilfst dabei, unsere Services, Teams und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Das könnte dein Job sein, wenn du ...

👀 Influencer Marketing nicht nur ausführst, sondern wirklich verstehst. Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Vollzeit-Erfahrung auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite mit und kennst die Branche, Creator, Managements und ihre Mechaniken.

🧠 Marken strategisch beraten willst, statt Briefings einfach abzuarbeiten. Du entwickelst Jahresstrategien, übersetzt Business- und Marketingziele in klare Influencer-Strategien und kannst deine Empfehlungen auch auf Senior-Level überzeugend vertreten.

🚀 Verantwortung nicht erst übernimmst, wenn sie dir jemand offiziell übergibt. Du hast bereits große Kunden und idealerweise siebenstellige Budgets verantwortet und fühlst dich wohl damit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und für Ergebnisse einzustehen.

🤝 aus guten Kundenbeziehungen langfristige Partnerschaften und neues Business machen kannst. Du erkennst Potenziale, denkst über das bestehende Briefing hinaus und hast Lust darauf, deine Accounts aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und wachsen zu lassen.

👥 Menschen nicht nur managen, sondern besser machen willst. Du hast bereits Teams oder Kolleg geführt und weiterentwickelt, kannst klare Erwartungen setzen, konstruktiv challengen und Verantwortung abgeben.

💡 Ideen hast, die nicht nur kreativ sind, sondern unsere Kunden weiterbringen. Du kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen, eine strategische Richtung vorgeben und aus einer ersten Idee eine überzeugende Story machen.

📱 TikTok, Instagram und YouTube auf Marketer-Level verstehst. Formate, Plattformmechaniken, Creator-Ecosystem und relevante Benchmarks gehören für dich zum Handwerkszeug und du interessierst dich dafür, was als Nächstes kommt.

📈 große Ziele eher motivierend als einschüchternd findest. Du willst nicht nur gute Kampagnen umsetzen, sondern Kunden, Teams und Business entwickeln und hast Lust darauf, an deinem eigenen Impact gemessen zu werden.

Und vielleicht am wichtigsten:

Du liebst diese Branche wirklich. Du bist neugierig auf das, was sich verändert, hast eine Meinung dazu, was gutes Influencer Marketing heute und morgen ausmacht, und willst die nächsten Jahre nicht nur dabei sein, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit internationalen Top-Marken und Budgets, die wirklich etwas bewegen

  • Entscheidungsspielraum in deinen Accounts und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit mit den YKONE-Teams in Paris, Mailand, London und weiteren Städten

  • Office First in München, aber mit Flexibilität: Homeoffice möglich, Remote ebenfalls, wenn es zu deiner Lebenssituation passt

  • 28 Urlaubstage, MacBook, iPhone, Egym/Wellfit-Mitgliedschaft

Aber deswegen solltest du den Job nicht machen.

Du solltest ihn machen, wenn du irgendwann auf die nächsten Jahre deiner Karriere zurückblicken und sagen willst: Ich habe nicht einfach tolle Accounts betreut. Ich habe etwas aufgebaut und mitgestaltet.

Klingt nach dir? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Kein Roman als Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV und am liebsten 2 bis 3 Cases, auf die du wirklich stolz bist. Und sag uns, was daran dein Anteil war.

👉 Account Lead Influencer Marketing & Brand Strategy (m/w/d)
📍 München / Hybrid
🚀 Start: sobald es für beide Seiten passt

title: Account Manager, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and grow gross profit through renewals, upsell and expansion across Airwallex's product suite. You'll build trusted relationships with senior commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, using strategic account plans, business reviews and customer insight to increase adoption, improve retention and identify new growth opportunities.

  • Coordinate complex onboarding, escalations and customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts while turning customer feedback into product, operational and go-to-market improvements.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions.

  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders.

  • Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally.

  • Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage.

Preferred

  • Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products.

  • Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders.

  • A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline.

  • Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

Learn more about your team

Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.

It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Du baust KI-Module für Übersetzung, SEO-Content, Produktbeschreibungen, Bildgenerierung für Shopping-Feeds und interne Assistenten – inklusive Prompt-Engineering, Evaluierung und Kostenkontrolle.
  • RAG & Wissensdatenbanken: Du konzipierst und implementierst RAG-Systeme, um interne Wissensquellen (Produktdaten, Anleitungen, FAQ-Inhalte) für LLM-Anwendungen nutzbar zu machen – von der Datenstrukturierung über Vektordatenbanken bis zur robusten Pipeline.
  • Datenanalyse & Python-Pipelines: Du entwickelst Auswertungen auf Basis unserer Bestell- und Produktdaten z.B. Warenkorbanalysen oder Content-Quality-Scoring.
  • Interne Tools: Du erweiterst unsere interne Tool-Plattform (React/TypeScript/Express, Node.js) um neue Module und Dashboards für die Fachbereiche.
  • Infrastruktur: Unsere Systeme laufen self-hosted auf Linux-Servern (Docker Compose, Nginx). Du bringst deine Lösungen selbst in Produktion – Deployment gehört bei uns dazu.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung: Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik o.ä. – oder gleichwertige Praxis als Quereinsteiger. Uns interessiert, was du gebaut hast, nicht nur, was auf dem Papier steht.
  • n8n / Automatisierung: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in n8n (oder Make/Zapier mit Wechselbereitschaft), inklusive Entwicklung, Fehlerbehandlung und Betrieb skalierbarer Workflows.
  • AI-Coding: Du entwickelst mit modernen AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code als festem Bestandteil deines Workflows – von der Idee über den Code bis zum Deployment. Ein Grundverständnis für Python oder JavaScript/TypeScript ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – wichtiger ist, dass du weißt, was du baust, und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen kannst.
  • LLMs & KI: Fundierte Praxis mit LLM-APIs (z.B. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) und echtes Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen. Erfahrung mit RAG-Architekturen, Embeddings und Vektordatenbanken ist ein Plus, ebenso Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen (Ollama).
  • Datenbanken: Sicherer Umgang mit SQL (MySQL/MariaDB, idealerweise auch MSSQL). Du kannst komplexe Abfragen über große Datenmengen schreiben und optimieren.
  • Nice to have: Erfahrung mit JTL-Wawi oder anderen ERP-Systemen, E-Commerce-Hintergrund (Amazon, eigener Shop), Docker/Linux-Administration, SEO-Tools.
  • Problemlöser-Mentalität: Deine wichtigste Fähigkeit ist nicht ein bestimmtes Tool, sondern die Art, wie du an Probleme rangehst: Du zerlegst komplexe Themen, erkennst die eigentliche Ursache statt nur Symptome und findest auch dort Lösungen, wo es keine Anleitung gibt.
  • Kreativität: Du denkst um die Ecke – ob beim Prompt-Design, bei ungewöhnlichen Tool-Kombinationen oder wenn eine API mal nicht das kann, was sie soll. Der spannendste Weg ist bei uns oft der, den noch keiner gegangen ist.
  • Arbeitsweise: Lösungsorientiert, eigenverantwortlich, pragmatisch. Du lieferst lieber eine funktionierende schlanke Lösung als ein überengineertes Konzept – und du kommunizierst technische Themen verständlich in Richtung Fachbereiche.

Benefits

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem wachstumsstarken E-Commerce-Unternehmen.
  • Echter Tech-Stack, echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest vom ersten Tag an produktiven Systemen – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne Konzern-Overhead.
  • Modernes Arbeiten: Claude Teams, aktuelle KI-Tools und eigene GPU-Infrastruktur für lokale Modelle gehören zum Arbeitsalltag.
  • Arbeitsklima: Flache Hierarchien und ein kleines, passioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt.
  • Vergütung: Attraktive, leistungsorientierte Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung und Verantwortung gerecht wird.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Konferenzen, Schulungen und Raum für eigene strategische Projekte im Bereich KI und Automatisierung.

Die Metzler GmbH ist ein führender Anbieter von hochwertigen Briefkästen, Paketboxen, Türklingeln, Sprechanlagen und Hausnummern in Deutschland und Europa. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2013 haben wir über 1,6 Millionen Kunden beliefert – über unseren eigenen Shop und Amazon in mehreren europäischen Märkten. Wir legen größten Wert auf Qualität, Design und Nachhaltigkeit – und treiben die Digitalisierung unserer Prozesse konsequent mit KI voran.

title: Analysis Experience Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position description

You will own the product vision and domain strategy for analysis experience, partnering with engineering and product leaders to align investment and delivery across teams.

Your mission is to evolve existing report processing, storage, and APIs into a shared service, so teams can submit work, process findings, and retrieve reusable artifacts and evidence without rebuilding these capabilities independently. Shape the service around static and agentic workflows, with support for additional analysis types guided by validated customer needs.

The domain covers issue-processing pipelines, durable storage, and supporting APIs and events. You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions.

Your direct customers are the technical teams building analysis engines, agent services, guidance capabilities, and other products on this service. Success is the value these teams deliver to developers and enterprises, not the number of shared capabilities shipped.


What you will do

title: Applied ML Engineer/Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care.

We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.

Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer.

This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features.


What you'll do:

Build and validate models

  • Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring.
  • Backtest on the historical book and run models in shadow mode alongside human decision-makers, reporting where and why they disagree.
  • Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review.

    • Platform and MLOps

  • Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data.
  • Set up experiment tracking, model versioning, and production monitoring, partnering with engineering on integration.

  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems.
  • Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, measurable modelling.

  • Build privacy, fairness, and explainability into every model that touches personal or health data, working with compliance and legal on nDSG/GDPR boundaries.
  • Models support decisions; accountable owners make them. Pricing, reserving, and claims work requires licensed-actuary sign-off, and any automation requires governance approval first.

    • Collaborate

  • Explain model behavior and limits to underwriting, claims, actuarial, and compliance teams.

    • What you'll need:
  • Strong applied ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series, and survival/duration modeling.
  • Proven experience building models on real-world, relational, effective-dated data, including imbalanced outcomes.
  • Fluent Python (pandas, scikit-learn, a modern ML stack) and strong SQL.
  • Solid grasp of validation, calibration, and explainability (e.g. SHAP).
  • Production MLOps: experiment tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring.
  • Sound judgment on data privacy and modelling.
  • Fluent English.
  • Bias for action, ownership, and clear cross-functional communication.

    • Big plus:
  • Insurance, actuarial, or risk modeling (pricing, reserving, loss ratios).
  • Health, disability, or absence data, especially Swiss insurance (KTG, UVG); fraud detection in claims.
  • Regulated special-category data under nDSG/GDPR, or model risk management.
  • Google Cloud, including security-restricted deployments.
  • German language skills.

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on optimisation and operational research. You will post-train SOTA large language models to formulate and solve optimisation problems, and apply them to diverse use cases.

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

title: B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) im Außendienst / Bergisches Land
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt befindet sich an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt. Als B2B Sales Manager (x/f/m) im Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Solingen, Bergisch Gladbach und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business und bringst mit unserer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung echten Mehrwert direkt in den Praxisalltag.

Du gewinnst neue Zahnarztpraxen für Doctolib und begleitest sie auf dem Weg zu einer effizienteren, digitaleren Organisation. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Outbound und Inbound Sales: Du kombinierst die aktive Ansprache potenzieller Kund:innen über bereitgestellte Leads, telefonisch und vor Ort, mit der Bearbeitung eingehender Inbound-Anfragen. Dein Ziel ist es, qualifizierte Ersttermine zu vereinbaren und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln.

  • Erste Verkaufsgespräche und Bedarfsermittlung: Du führst erste Gespräche mit Zahnärzt:innen und Praxisteams, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und identifizierst ihren individuellen Bedarf.

  • Full-Cycle-Sales: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle, von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Bedarfsermittlung, Produktpräsentation und Verhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Pipeline, Umsatz und Wachstum: Du baust Deine Pipeline eigenständig auf und verantwortest die Entwicklung Deines Vertriebsgebiets.

  • Kundenzentrierte Beratung: Du zeigst potenziellen Kund:innen den konkreten Mehrwert unserer digitalen HealthTech-Lösung für ihren Praxisalltag.

  • Datengetriebene Erfolgsmessung: Du trackst Deine Performance regelmäßig mit Salesforce und nutzt Daten für eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie.

  • Strukturierte Übergabe nach Vertragsabschluss: Nach dem Abschluss übergibst Du Deine neuen Kund:innen strukturiert an unser Projektmanagement-Team. Dort werden sie anschließend vollständig betreut und bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet.

Die Position ist vollständig auf die Gewinnung neuer Kund:innen ausgerichtet. Eine laufende Bestandskundenbetreuung gehört nicht zu Deinen Aufgaben.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die oder der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen.

  • Sales ist Deine Welt: Du hast mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Außendienst und im Neukundengeschäft

  • Proaktivität und Akquise-Talent: Du hast bereits eigenständig Pipeline aufgebaut und neue Kund:innen gewonnen

  • Beratungsstärke: Du kannst erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen verständlich und kundenzentriert vermitteln

  • Energie und Überzeugungskraft: Du trittst sicher und professionell auf, verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und lässt Dich auch von Rückschlägen nicht entmutigen

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du bist ergebnisorientiert, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei Herausforderungen den Fokus

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du kannst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher ausdrücken

  • Internationale Kompetenz: Für interne Trainings, All-Hands und die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kolleg:innen sind Englischkenntnisse hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Regionale Verfügbarkeit: Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst das Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach (rechtsrheinisch). Du bist bereit, regelmäßig Kundentermine in dieser Region wahrzunehmen. Ein Wohnort in der Region oder in erreichbarer Nähe ist hilfreich, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung

  • Flexibilität und Mobilität: Dein Vertriebsalltag findet dort statt, wo es zählt, direkt bei Zahnärzt:innen vor Ort. Ein Führerschein der Klasse B wird vorausgesetzt

Erfahrung im SaaS-, HealthTech- oder Healthcare-Vertrieb ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend sind Deine Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb, Deine Eigenständigkeit und Dein Wille, Dinge voranzutreiben.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Einen Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung, versteuert nach der 1 %-Regelung

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen, unter anderem Zahnreinigung

  • 28 Urlaubstage plus einen zusätzlichen Tag für jedes volle Beschäftigungsjahr, maximal 30 Tage

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 %

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm mit einem zusätzlichen Monat Elternzeit

  • Kostenlose Mental-Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner Moka.care

  • Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen, unter anderem durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung und psychologische Unterstützung

Der Interview-Prozess

  1. Interview mit unserem Talent Team, remote, 35 Minuten

  2. Interview mit deinem Regional Manager, remote, 60 Minuten

  3. DoctoDay: Verbringe einige Stunden mit Deinem zukünftigen Team und erhalte einen ersten Einblick in den Job als Account Executive

  4. Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Region: Vertriebsgebiet Dreieck Leverkusen, Wuppertal und Gummersbach, rechtsrheinisch, mit Office in Düsseldorf

  • Startdatum: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Unsere Philosophie

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei Doctolib nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos oder Dein Alter verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen.

Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

  • Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

  • Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

  • Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

  • Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

  • Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

  • Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

What you’ll need

  • At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

  • An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

  • A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

  • A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

  • A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

  • Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

  • Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Bristol and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

descriptionHtml:

Mission

En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables.

Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Coordonner la mise en usage, la formation des utilisateurs et le handover client: relais managériaux, communautés, rituels et office hours.Piloter les boucles de feedback, les indicateurs de valeur et, si désigné, le plan de change sur une mission ciblée.
