Pour en savoir plus sur Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • De la stratégie à la réalisation

Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.

  • Une collaboration entre expertises

Occuper un rôle à la croisée de la stratégie (AI Strategy), de la technologie (Engineering) et de l'humain (AI Adoption).

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Un parcours clair vers Senior Manager puis Directeur, dans un environnement d’apprentissage continu axé sur la transmission des connaissances et le pragmatisme technologique.

title: Chef.fe de Projet Applicatifs Hôpitaux
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Chef.fe de projet, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

  • Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

  • Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

  • Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

  • Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

  • Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

  • Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

  • Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

  • La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

  • Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

  2. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

  3. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client.

  4. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes.

    Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape.

title: Chief Commercial Officer at CFO Insights
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Chief Commercial Officer.

About us

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one. 

What we offer you

As our Chief Commercial Officer, you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in our HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Market-competitive compensation.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You will be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor the marketing team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Set clear goals and expectations and evaluate team performance regularly. Recruiter and onboard your team.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with sales, product development, and other teams to ensure alignment of marketing strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Campaign Management: Oversee the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across various channels, including email marketing, social media, website etc.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with the company's overall objectives. Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.

What we expect from you

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have +10 years of work experience with outstanding performance in the industry.
  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Start date

Flexible 

Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria Station) and do not offer remote work.

title: Chief Operating Officer COO
descriptionHtml:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers.

Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs.

What you will do:

  • Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028

  • Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes

  • Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry

  • Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure

  • Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel

Who you are:

  • A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation

  • Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations

  • A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation

  • A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before'

  • Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines

  • Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas

  • Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome

  • Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus

Why join us now?

  • We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: This role is based in our Amsterdam office.

title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.

  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.

  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.

  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.

  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.

  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage

  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden

  • Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze unserer Kunden

  • Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht

  • Wachstum: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Personal Brands, Formaten und Zielgruppen und entwickelst dich als Creator und Führungskraft kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringst du mit:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads

  • Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung

  • Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention

  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten

  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen

  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey

  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL

  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht

  • Souveräne Kundenkommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Unternehmern

  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen

  • du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt

  • du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst

  • du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst

  • du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln

  • du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst

  • du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern

  • du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst

  • du Kunden nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert

  • dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken

  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln



Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen – bewirb dich jetzt!

title: Creative Lead
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi moves money home for people who live between countries. Behind every transfer there is a real story: school fees, a wedding, a mother's new roof. We have the mission, the communities and the brand platform. What we need now is someone who can find those stories, write them, and make them look unmissable.


You will report to the VP of Brand and Design, and sit at the centre of a lean creative team. You will concept campaigns alongside Isabel, write the words, set the visual direction, and lead the activations that make LemFi feel like it genuinely belongs to the communities it serves. This is not a brief-taking role. You will bring 10 ideas, kill 8, sharpen 2, and then make the 2 real.

What you'll build and own

  • Find the stories: dig into our customers, corridors and cultures, and turn real lives into campaign ideas that land across markets

  • Write the work: manifestos, scripts, headlines, social, OOH and launch narratives, copy that is sharp enough to stand alone

  • Set the visual direction: art-direct campaigns, shoots and brand films so the idea is as strong visually as it is in words

  • Lead activations: concept and run real-world moments, events, partnerships and cultural drops across our markets, from idea to on-the-ground execution

  • Brief and direct: brief designers, directors, agencies and creators, push the work until it earns its place

  • Build the brand platform: grow the creative system so it scales consistently across channels and corridors, using AI tools to move through concept rounds faster

title: Customer Engagement Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how it interfaces with our technology, the Customer engagement team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform. We build strong relationships with our clients, provide expert guidance and support, and drive customer satisfaction and retention. Our team is committed to understanding and addressing client needs, ensuring a seamless and rewarding experience with Rivia. This role has many dynamic opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

 

The Role

As a Customer Engagement Manager at Rivia, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they navigate their clinical trials and maximize the benefits from our platform. You will work closely with clients to understand their objectives, provide guidance and support that drives customer satisfaction and retention. The ideal candidate is customer-focused, impact driven, tech-savvy, and has a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical industry.

  

What Excites You

  • Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on our customer’s biotech innovations and our business.

  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your customer success expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships.

  • Understand client needs and objectives, and ensure they are successfully met through Rivia’s platform.

What Excites us

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for delivering exceptional service and support.

  • Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing client needs.

 

Bonus

  • Experience with SaaS products for biopharma

  • Evidence of customer retention and expansion

  • Knowledge of drug development and/or clinical trials

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

title: Data Analyst (EN)
descriptionHtml:
Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact!

At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome.

What will you do?

Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied.

Product

In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.

  • Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition;

  • Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working;

  • Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts;

  • Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them;

  • Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development;

  • Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company.

Commercial & marketing support

Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex.

  • Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities;

  • Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS.

This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact.

Your team

You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data.

The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst;

  • Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics;

  • Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude;

  • Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it;

  • Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter;

  • Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders;

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues;

  • Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus);

We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them.

What do we offer?

  • A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more;

  • A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy;

  • One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in;

  • A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions;

  • A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility.

YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you.

title: Data & AI Engineer, Digital Twin und Pricing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
HICONIUM baut die Pricing- und Handelsplattform für Sammlerfahrzeuge. Zwei Dinge tragen alles, was wir tun: der Digital Twin, die vollständige und belegte digitale Akte jedes Fahrzeugs, und HICON-PRICE, eine exakte, mit Evidenz hinterlegte Zahl statt einer Spanne.

Für beides suchen wir die Person, die aus Serviceheften, Rechnungen, Zertifikaten, Herstellerdaten und Marktdaten saubere, geprüfte Daten macht und die Pipelines dafür selbst baut. Du arbeitest täglich mit unserem CTO und unserem Head of Research & Data Science, unterstützt beide und übernimmst einen Teilbereich in eigener Verantwortung.

Schweizer Vollzeitanstellung, hybrid mit Basis in Zürich und flexibler Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen vorrangig in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich. Arbeitssprache Deutsch; Englisch für internationale Quellen und Kontakte.

Aufgaben

  • Dokumente zu Daten: Du baust die Pipeline, die hochgeladene Unterlagen (Fahrzeugausweise, Rechnungen, Servicehefte, Zertifikate, Kaufverträge) erkennt und in strukturierte Felder überführt; jedes Feld mit Evidenzgrad, Konfidenz und Verweis auf die Stelle im Dokument. Unsichere Fälle gehen in eine Prüfschleife, und du misst, wie oft die Pipeline falsch liegt.

  • Importe: Du entwickelst die Importe für Daten von Herstellern, Restauratoren, Werkstätten und Händlern (CSV, JSON, Schnittstellen), so dass jede Angabe ihre Herkunft behält.

  • Datenbasis für HICON-PRICE: Du führst Auktionsergebnisse, Händlerangebote und Fahrzeugakten zusammen, löst Dubletten und Fahrgestellnummern sauber auf und hältst Datenlecks aus den Modellen fern.

  • Vom Modell zum Produkt: Du stellst Modelle so bereit, dass eine Zahl mit ihrer Evidenz herauskommt, mit Versionierung, Backtests, Kalibrierung und Monitoring.

  • Analyse: Du beantwortest Fragen aus den Daten (Abdeckung, Qualität, Auffälligkeiten, Marktbewegungen) und machst die Antworten für Team, Händler und Sammler verständlich.

  • Verantwortung: Nach der Einarbeitung führst du einen Teilbereich fachlich selbst, zum Beispiel Ingestion und Datenqualität des Digital Twin.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Daten- oder ML-Pipelines gebaut, die produktiv laufen, und kannst erzählen, was kaputtging und wie du es behoben hast.

  • Sehr gutes Python und SQL; Erfahrung mit Dokumentenextraktion (OCR, Sprach- und Vision-Modelle) oder mit grossen, uneinheitlichen Datenquellen.

  • Du misst, bevor du behauptest: Fehlerquoten, Vergleich mit Referenzdaten, saubere Trennung von Trainings- und Testdaten.

  • Du verstehst Modelle gut genug, um Forschungsarbeit produktionsreif zu machen; forschen musst du nicht selbst.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Coding-Werkzeugen und prüfst deren Ergebnisse selbst; mit vertraulichen Daten gehst du bewusst um. Sicheres Arbeiten mit macOS gehört dazu: Wir setzen ausschliesslich Apple-Geräte ein.

  • Du arbeitest ohne fertiges Pflichtenheft, dokumentierst nachvollziehbar und meldest dich, bevor etwas hängt.

  • Deutsch und Englisch fliessend; Italienisch oder Französisch ist ein Plus.

  • Fahrzeugwissen ist kein Muss, echte Neugier darauf schon. Wer Sammlerfahrzeuge, Auktionen oder Herstellerdaten kennt, hat einen Vorsprung.

Benefits

  • Du arbeitest am Kernprodukt: Auf deiner Arbeit bauen Bewertung, Handel und alle Partneranbindungen auf.

  • Du arbeitest mit echten Fahrzeugen und echten Sammlungen und bekommst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, der mit dir wächst.

  • Schweizer Anstellung mit transparentem Fixgehalt und flexiblem Arbeiten im gemeinsam vereinbarten Modell.

title: DevOps Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

title: Director, Content Distribution, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

Roku's Content Distribution team drives strategic growth by sourcing, negotiating, and closing distribution partnerships with leading streaming video providers and major TV networks. As Director, Content Distribution, UK, you will lead strategy and execution for Roku's content distribution business in the UK. You will directly own high-value, complex negotiations with local public service broadcasters (PSBs), operators, and digital distributors, and guide the long-term roadmap for partner acquisition, renewals, and revenue expansion in the market.

This role requires a senior leader with a proven track record of closing large, strategic content deals, deep expertise in streaming and subscription business models, and established C-level relationships across the UK media industry. You will shape how Roku is perceived by the local media community and represent Roku in the UK and EU. 

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they’ve used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

Strategic Leadership & Deal Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end negotiation of major content distribution, premium subscription, and advertising inventory deals with UK PSBs (e.g., BBC, ITV, Channel 4), operators, and SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and premium channel providers
  • Own the strategic vision, roadmap, and financial performance of UK Content Distribution, including revenue management, ensuring sustained partner and revenue growth
  • Serve as the primary executive-level relationship owner for key UK partners, driving alignment on long-term collaboration, business strategy, and deal expansion opportunities
  • Negotiate advertising arrangements, including ad inventory splits, revenue shares, and backfill agreements

Business Development & Deal Structuring

  • Lead all aspects of new partner development, including sourcing, financial modeling, forecasting, term-sheet creation, contract drafting, negotiations, and closing
  • Own renewal strategy for the installed base of UK contracts, including re-negotiating major deals and developing a plan to upgrade existing Roku partnerships to the next level, in partnership with Roku's Legal team
  • Provide cross-functional leadership to legal, finance, marketing, product, and ad sales teams throughout negotiations and ongoing partnership management

Analytics, Strategy, & Executive Communications

  • Develop and present strategic materials, including deal strategies, quarterly updates, executive level presentations, and analysis of the UK media landscape and broader industry trends
  • Evaluate potential channel partners using deep analysis of content value, market demand and appeal, competitive positioning, financial modeling, and long-term strategic fit
  • Continuously analyze current channel applications and competitor lineups to prioritize channel onboarding
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, and the evolving UK streaming ecosystem to inform Roku's content distribution strategy
  • Support the content acquisition team by researching content trends, identifying ad innovations, and recommending new partners

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee the lifecycle of UK partner contracts, including compliance, renewals, and operational optimization
  • Build and mentor a high-performing team focused on complex negotiations, partner management, and business performance
  • Establish scalable processes to manage a large and diverse portfolio of partners

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 10+ years of experience in content distribution, business development, or media partnerships at a leading broadcaster, operator, streaming platform, or media company, including direct ownership of major deal negotiations
  • A proven, high-level network of traditional and digital media executives across the UK, including direct experience working with C-level leaders
  • Deep understanding of subscription streaming models, linear licensing agreements, and advertising economics, including the UK advertising ecosystem, ad inventory pricing and structures, and direct, programmatic, and audience-based monetization
  • Extensive experience working with legal teams on complex distribution agreements
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships with senior and mid-level leaders, internally and externally
  • Demonstrated excellence in financial modeling, competitive analysis, and strategic decision-making
  • Revenue management experience, and experience working with media sales teams
  • A demonstrated passion for the UK media landscape and a solid understanding of streaming media technologies
  • Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and managing multiple high-impact deals simultaneously, with 5+ years of people management experience
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, JD, or similar advanced degree preferred
#LI-OR1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

descriptionHtml:
About G2 - The Company

G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.

Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.

And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.

Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!

About G2 - Our People

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

About The Role

G2 is looking for a commercially minded marketing leader who is passionate about the software industry and excited to help build G2 EMEA. This role reports to the VP, EMEA and leads marketing for the region, with one direct report.

Three things sit at the centre of this job. You own the pipeline G2 generates in EMEA. You own the EMEA event calendar and the pipeline that comes out of it. And you are the connection between the region and G2's central Growth Marketing team, in both directions.

Central Growth Marketing markets to buyer personas globally. This role owns the market. You decide what EMEA needs, secure it, adapt it, build what only the region can build, and own the number at the end of it. You also work the other way round: finding the triggers and signals that convert in this region and feeding them back into the global model.

You will be the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team, and you will have the autonomy that comes with sitting in the region rather than at the centre.

As the Director, EMEA Marketing, you will be a key player in our mission to build the largest and most trusted global software marketplace.

 

In This Role, You Will: 

  • Own the EMEA marketing plan, budget, and pipeline target.

  • Serve as the marketing voice on the EMEA leadership team and the EMEA voice within central marketing.

  • Translate G2's global GTM strategy into a regional plan built for how European buyers actually buy.

  • Drive EMEA pipeline growth and conversion, covering the full volume of demand generated and how well it converts.

  • Lead EMEA event strategy and execution (executive dinners, sponsored events, partner events, virtual formats), including format, audience, calendar, and spend.

  • Lead the EMEA account-based marketing program, using buyer intent and account signals to prioritize target accounts.

  • Run the weekly pipeline and funnel review with EMEA sales leadership, and manage the marketing-to-sales handoff.

  • Partner with central Growth Marketing to adapt global campaigns and signals for EMEA, feeding regional results back into the global model.

  • Forecast and report on MQA, SQLA, pipeline, revenue, and average contract value using Salesforce and Looker.

  • Manage, coach, and develop one direct report.

Minimum Qualifications:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience

  • 2+ years leading a lean marketing team in a player-coach capacity, balancing hands-on execution with people management

  • You have hands-on experience designing digital one-to-one and one-to-few ABM campaigns, overseeing event efforts, as well as planning and executing. bottom-of-the-funnel activation programmes.

  • You have owned an event strategy and run executive-level formats that produced pipeline, not just attendance.

  • You’ve previously worked in a B2B company in the sales and marketing tech category.

  • You’ve previously developed and executed an enterprise marketing plan in partnership with Account Development, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

  • You have turned buyer intent or behavioural signals into campaigns that converted, and can show which signals worked and which did not.

  • You’re motivated by results and contribution to pipeline/revenue.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy creating new ways of working.

What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:

  • Have been a G2 customer.

  • Are well-versed in the enterprise software buying process.

  • Experience with our existing tech stack, (SFDC, Marketo, 6Sense and Looker strongly preferred)

  • Experience using AI tools to do the work. G2's growth function is moving towards AI-orchestrated plays and this role is part of that.

  • Experience building a customer community in a region.

title: Director of Finance - Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The Strategic Finance, Planning & Analysis team drives financial performance management across Prosus's global ecosystems - partnering with operating companies and Group Finance to ensure targets are met and capital is deployed effectively. The EU ecosystem team sits at the centre of Prosus's ambition to build a leading lifestyle e-commerce platform in Europe, and this Director role is the financial engine behind that ambition.

You'll own the full Strategic FP&A function for Prosus's European portfolio, managing the annual budgeting, planning, and forecasting cycle across a multi-entity, multi-country ecosystem, and leading the operating cadences that keep business unit CFOs, ecosystem leads, and Group Finance aligned. Within your first 60 days, you'll have established a working rhythm with every BU and minority investment finance team in the region. Within your first quarter, you'll hold full ownership of the EU ecosystem budgeting and forecasting cycle.

This is an active moment for the portfolio. M&A and divestiture activity is ongoing, and you'll be a direct contributor to at least one strategic transaction within your first year, not as a reviewer, but as a hands-on partner to the ecosystem leads driving those decisions. The team you'll lead is five to six direct reports; developing their capabilities and raising the bar on finance practice across the BU finance teams is as much a part of the role as the numbers themselves.

This isn't a reporting function. This is financial leadership for one of Prosus's most strategically significant regions.

Who You Are

You think in systems and act with precision. You're comfortable holding the full picture of a complex, multi-entity portfolio while also rolling up your sleeves on the analysis that makes a business case credible or a forecast defensible. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down - you move forward with the information available, surface the brutal facts clearly, and adjust as the picture sharpens.

You've built trust with senior stakeholders before - CFOs, business leads, Group Finance counterparts, not just by managing up but by being the person in the room who brings clarity. You give direct, evidence-based points of view and create space for the people around you to do the same. You care about the growth of your team as much as the quality of the output, and you understand that both are how a finance function earns its seat at the table.

What You Bring

- Deep experience in finance or FP&A at group or multi-entity level, with a background in digital economy, e-commerce, consumer internet, or a closely adjacent sector

- Proven ability to lead end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and planning cycles across complex, matrixed organisations - coordinating multiple finance teams toward a single, coherent view

- Hands-on track record analysing financial statements, business cases, and performance data to surface actionable insight for senior decision-makers

- Comfortable partnering directly with business unit CFOs and ecosystem leads on strategic projects including M&A, divestiture, and performance benchmarking with the credibility to challenge and the judgement to know when to align

- Experience managing and developing a finance team, with a genuine investment in building capability at every level

- Fluent English communication, written and spoken, with the ability to translate financial complexity into clear, concise narratives for diverse audiences

- Familiarity with Group Finance functions (tax, treasury, reporting, consolidation) and how a finance function at this level interfaces with each

- Experience with Hyperion or OneStream is a plus

- Background in minority investment oversight or portfolio company finance is a plus

- Exposure to multi-country or cross-border finance environments in Europe is a plus

Your Typical Day

Your day might begin with a performance review call with a business unit CFO - working through the latest actuals, flagging variances, and agreeing on the narrative before it reaches Group Finance. From there, you're likely in the detail: a forecast model that needs stress-testing, a business case for a potential acquisition, or a consolidation question that cuts across tax, treasury, and reporting.

Throughout the day, your team is moving in parallel - running analyses, preparing materials, coordinating with BU finance counterparts across the EU. You check in, unblock, and give direct feedback. By afternoon, you might be in a working session with an ecosystem lead on a live strategic project, or preparing the ecosystem performance summary that feeds into the Group FP&A cycle.

What We Offer

- Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

- Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

- Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

- Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

- Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace.

- Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

- Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

- Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access
descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

Revolutionizing access to medical treatments

We're on a mission to enable earlier and better access to treatments and improve the lives of patients. Making it possible for anyone to find and access the best possible treatment options, with the click of a button. Bringing together demand and supply like never before, in one of the world's largest industries. Our patient-centered offering is gaining traction, and with the right team we can go from helping thousands of patients each year, to millions of patients. Do you aspire to be at the forefront of innovation in healthcare and creating the next health tech unicorn? You’ve come to the right place!

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access

As the Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with BioPharmaceutical companies for myTomorrows' Expanded Access Program (EAP) solutions, with a focus on global sustainble acess. You will be responsible for generating leads, establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives, and growing the number of chargeable expanded access programs (named patient sales) we run for our partners.

Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset, market access and expanded access experience, and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, strategic partnership development and closing high-value, multi-year deals. A clear approach to target key account and ideal customer profiles will be key.

You will be directly accountable for qualifying deals and delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, with a clear path to measurable growth and market expansion.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities. You do this in close collaboration with our EAP operations, global access, marketing and revenue operations teams, as part of the Expanded Access business unit.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidatesin North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role

  • Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a Pharma Partnerships Associate.

  • Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners for chargeable EAPs and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Drive revenue growth by meeting and exceeding partnership targets and sales quotas.

  • Qualify deals, negotiate agreements and close multi-year EAP partnerships that align with company objectives.

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets, with clear accountability for pipeline conversion and deal velocity.

  • Together with our Director, Expanded Access Strategy and Director, Global Access, build the case for chargeable programs with BioPharma clients: identify the countries and pathways where charging for treatment is allowed, and design pricing, country selection, regulatory approach and supply model to match.

  • Lead proposals and bid defenses together with EA strategy and Global Access and finance, so every offer is commercially sound and deliverable.

  • Collaborate closely with EAP Operations and Global Access to ensure a smooth handover and the successful implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, such as moving free-of-charge programs to a chargeble model, additional countries, assets, post-trial access, real-world data and patient recruitment, and support contracting for these expansions.

  • Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

  • Act as a thought leader in Expanded Access, strengthening myTomorrows' external positioning through industry presence, conference talks and high-quality content.

  • Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

  • Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time).

What you bring to the table

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Life Science or Healthcare (Bachelor's degree considered with strong experience).

  • 5+ years of experience in partnership development, business development or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within medical affairs, market access, regulatory affairs and the Expanded Access space.

  • Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

  • Strong understanding of Expanded Access, Named Patient Sales pricing and reimbursement, and the regulatory frameworks for Expanded Access in Europe and other key markets.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

  • The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

  • An AI-first way of working. You use AI tools daily to research, verify and document faster, and you are always looking for ways to do more with less, without compromising on accuracy.
