title: GM / VP Sales, DACH
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Come build our DACH territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion, and DACH is a market we're committing to. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What we need now is the leader who turns that into a real business on the ground.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Own the DACH number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Be in the deals: run and close our biggest DACH opportunities yourself, with CFOs, CPOs and procurement leaders

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in DACH: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in DACH

Who this is for

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent German and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's DACH business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in DACH.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Go-To-Market Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Graduate Business Analyst, Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
Location: London (3 days a week in office)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

 

Role Purpose

This is a rare opportunity for a graduate to sit close to the heart of our Healthcare business. You'll work directly with Healthcare leadership and colleagues across corporate development, commercial and marketing, turning data and market insight into the business cases, proposals and strategic narratives that shape where Genomics goes next. If you want your analysis to influence real decisions from day one – not sit in a spreadsheet – this is the role.

 

A Day in the Life

  • Analyse & advise: You'll work with Healthcare leadership and teams across the business to turn data into insight that drives real decisions.

  • Track performance: You'll track key performance metrics and keep the data behind them accurate and trustworthy.

  • Build the case: You'll help build business cases, presentations and proposals that support sales pitches and internal investment decisions.

  • Scan the market: You'll spot emerging trends across pharma and therapeutics, and help the team get ahead of them.

  • Tell the story: You'll help craft compelling narratives for client presentations and strategic conversations.

Who You Are

  • Data-curious: A graduate (or equivalent experience) in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field, comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and keen to learn tools like Power BI or Tableau.

  • Genuinely interested in healthcare: You have a genuine interest in healthcare, pharmaceuticals and therapeutics, and enjoy following market trends and dynamics.

  • Detail-driven: You take pride in accuracy, keep things organised, and can manage several threads of work at once.

  • A clear communicator: You can explain complex ideas simply, and you're just as comfortable contributing in a team as working independently.

  • Self-motivated: You take initiative, follow through, and bring energy to everything you do.

     

Your Package

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

Compensation & Growth

  • Competitive Reward: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure market-aligned compensation.

  • Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.

  • Continuous Learning: Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

Wellbeing & Time Off

  • Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.

  • Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.

  • Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

Work Environment & Culture

  • Hybrid Working

  • Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.

  • Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.

  • Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

Ready to Build the Future?

title: Grafikdesigner / Mediengestalter (m/w/d) – Print, Digital & Projektkoordination
descriptionHtml:
Das Team von Lebenslust Touristik ist voller Tatendrang und legt viel Wert auf ein offenes Miteinander, eine hohe Arbeitsqualität und eine gute Kommunikation. Wir suchen nach neuen Mitarbeitern und Mitarbeiterinnen, die mit Herzblut bei der Sache sind – denn schließlich geht es um das schöne Thema Reisen.

Bei uns kannst du dich mit deinen Stärken und Ideen umfassend einbringen. Als moderner Direktmarketing-Reiseveranstalter vertreiben wir Gruppenreisen für die Zielgruppe Best Ager.

Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir am Standort Oberursel eine*n Grafikdesigner / Mediengestalter (m/w/d) – Print, Digital & Projektkoordination in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche).

Das erwartet dich:

  • Ein offenes und herzliches Team, das Wert auf Vielfältigkeit legt und gerne auch mal gemeinsam einen Kaffee aus unserer Siebträgerkaffeemaschine trinkt.

  • Ein starker Teamgeist mit Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern, Teamevents im In- und Ausland und einer gelebten Feedback-Kultur.

  • Ein modernes, lichtdurchflutetes Büro im Herzen von Oberursel mit gemeinsamen Mittagspausen, ausreichend Parkmöglichkeiten und guter ÖPNV-Anbindung.

  • 30 Urlaubstage und Home-Office-Möglichkeiten für 2 Tage/Woche nach der Probezeit.

  • Viel Gestaltungsfreiheit sowie Möglichkeiten für Mitwirkung und Weiterbildung.

  • Ein interessantes und spannendes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, touristikbezogene Rabatte, JobRad und unser internes Taler-Anreizsystem

  • … und natürlich: die schönste Branche der Welt.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du realisierst vielfältige Werbemittel und Marketingmaterialien für unsere B2C-Kampagnen – von der kreativen Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung, mit einem klaren Schwerpunkt auf Print.

  • Du übernimmst professionelle Layout- und Satzarbeit, Reinzeichnung und Druckdatenerstellung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Werbemittel technisch einwandfrei und termingerecht in Produktion gehen.

  • Du hast auch inhaltlich ein wachsames Auge: Du prüfst Texte, Preise und weitere Angaben auf Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität und erkennst mögliche Unstimmigkeiten, bevor sie in den Druck gehen.

  • Du koordinierst eigenständig Projekte im operativen Marketing-Tagesgeschäft, hältst offene Punkte aktiv nach und stimmst dich dafür eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Entwicklung kreativer Ideen und die Gestaltung neuer Werbemittel ein, setzt auch digitale Werbemittel um und übernimmst bei abwechslungsreichen Marketingprojekten Verantwortung.

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Grafik-, Kommunikations- oder Mediendesign oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Mediengestalter*in Digital und Print und verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Grafikdesign mit Schwerpunkt Printmedien.

  • Du beherrschst die Adobe Creative Cloud und bist in den Bereichen Layout, Typografie, Reinzeichnung und Druckdatenerstellung sattelfest.

  • Du verbindest ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch und der nötigen Sorgfalt, um auch umfangreiche Satzarbeiten und wiederholte Korrekturschleifen zuverlässig umzusetzen.

  • Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Sprachgefühl, sichere Kenntnisse der deutschen Rechtschreibung und ein gutes Auge für Details – auch inhaltliche Zusammenhänge und mögliche Unstimmigkeiten fallen dir auf.

  • Du bist ein echtes Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert und vorausschauend und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten und engen Deadlines den Überblick.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst mit und gehst Aufgaben proaktiv an – du erkennst, wo Handlungsbedarf besteht, und kümmerst dich selbstständig um die nächsten Schritte.

  • Du bist ein aufgeschlossener Teamplayer und hast Freude daran, dich in neue Themen und Aufgaben einzuarbeiten.

  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung in der Touristik mit oder hast Lust, dich intensiv in die spannende Welt des Reisens einzuarbeiten.

Wir freuen uns sehr auf deine Bewerbung! Bitte sende deine Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins sowie deiner Gehaltsvorstellung an Katja Nachtigall.

PS: In dieser Stellenanzeige duzen wir – bei Bedarf können wir uns im weiteren Bewerbungsprozess aber auch gern siezen.

title: Growth Engineer - Data & Tracking
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Growth Engineer – Outbound & Data Automation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du liebst es, Outbound-Prozesse technisch zu automatisieren, datengetriebene Leads zu generieren und E-Mail-Infrastrukturen auf Skalierung zu trimmen? Dann passt du perfekt zu uns!

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Growth Engineer – Outbound & Data Automation (m/w/d) (in Vollzeit, als Freelancer oder Berater/Coach), der nicht nur E-Mails versendet, sondern als technischer Spezialist unsere Cold-Outbound-Infrastruktur auf das nächste Level hebt. Mit deinem starken IT-Background, tiefem Wissen rund um Tools wie Instantly sowie Automatisierungstools baust du hocheffiziente, datenbasierte Lead-Generierungssysteme auf.

Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Infrastruktur & Delivery-Setup: Du baust professionelle Cold-Outbound-Setups auf (Spintax, Domain-Warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Instantly) und stellst maximale Zustellbarkeiten für große E-Mail-Volumina sicher.

  • Cold Email Automation: Du richtest skalierbare E-Mail-Kampagnen in Instantly ein, optimierst A/B-Tests und steuerst den systematischen Versand über viele Accounts hinweg.

  • Data & Lead Scraping: Du nutzt IT- und Scraper-Tools (z. B. Clay, PhantomBuster, Apollo, API-Schnittstellen), um hochspezifische Zielgruppen-Daten zu extrahieren, zu bereinigen und anzureichern.

  • Prozess- & Workflow-Automatisierung: Du verknüpfst Outbound-Tools über Zapier, Make oder benutzerdefinierte Webhooks nahtlos mit unserem CRM und Vertriebs-Workflow.

  • Analyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du überwachst Reply Rates, Deliverability und Meeting-Booking-Raten datenbasiert und leitest kontinuierlich technische sowie inhaltliche Stellschrauben ab.

Was du mitbringst

  • Fundierter IT-Background (Verständnis von DNS-Einstellungen, Webhooks, APIs, Datenstrukturen und Automatisierung).

title: Growth Lead - Sell Side
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Growth Lead for tem's Sell engine, the side of tem that works with generators.

You own the way tem turns up for generators and the organisations around them: the brand, the positioning, the product marketing, the events, the account mapping and the materials that build trust before there is a deal on the table. Our deals are won on trust and relationships as much as price, and worked one account at a time: hundreds of deals a year, not tens of thousands. You sit behind the people who originate and manage our accounts and drive them to success: they own the deals, you own how we show up and what we show up with, so the engine generates both pipeline and conversion. This is a hands-on, forward-deployed role: you do the work yourself, with AI tooling, alongside the people who close.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Map the accounts that matter to us in detail, work out who to target and how, and build the account plan for each.

  • Design and run a programme of bespoke events, speaking slots and round tables that move named relationships forward, and show the brand at every one.

  • Sharpen tem's positioning and product marketing for generators, and produce the materials our originators and account leads walk in with.

  • Bring account mapping and account marketing to the people who manage our existing accounts, so they can grow them.

  • Take a target account from first conversation to qualified pipeline, and see it convert with the people who close.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Own how we turn up: the brand, the positioning and the product marketing that make generators and the organisations around them trust tem before there is a deal on the table.

  • Map accounts in detail: who matters, how they think, how to reach them and in what order, so our growth is granular and targeted rather than broad.

  • Run bespoke events: choose the events, round tables and speaking slots that matter, set them up and run them, and show the brand in materials and in the room.

  • Arm the people who close: produce the materials, plans and targeting that our originators and account leads walk in with, and keep them sharp as the product and the market move.

  • Drive pipeline and conversion: sit behind the originators and account leads, support them account by account, and map deals out end to end so what you open lands as qualified pipeline and converts.

  • Think from first principles: decide what has to be true for tem to win each type of customer, and in what order to go after them.

  • Work AI-native: use AI and outreach tooling by default so one person can hold more accounts, events and campaigns than would otherwise be possible.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Enterprise growth marketing experience: you have grown pipeline and conversion for complex, high-value deals, and you know what it is like to be forward deployed, working in the field with customers and the people who sell rather than from behind a dashboard.

  • Intense account planning and mapping: you have built detailed account plans, worked out who to target and how, and opened doors with them.

  • You can turn up and show the brand, in materials and at events: choosing, setting up and running bespoke events, and producing the positioning and product marketing that go with them.

  • A very smart generalist problem solver who is AI native, with the sophistication to map out and position a plan strategically and structurally.

  • Hands-on: you do this work yourself rather than building a team to do it.

  • You like winning and growing numbers, you want to find out how counterparties think, and you prioritise hard across several fronts and are clear about what you are not doing.

Desirable

  • Experience in referral and natural, organic growth.

  • Energy market experience: you understand how generation is bought, sold and routed to market.

  • Experience across more than one of the customer types we serve, from farmers to councils and the investment firms that own generation.

  • Public affairs or policy-facing experience, such as convening a round table at parliament.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. title: Growth Manager (m/w/d), Acquisition & Performance
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir sind ein etabliertes deutsches Consumer-Fintech, gebacked von namhaften internationalen Investoren. Diese Position besetzen wir vertraulich, deshalb findest du hier noch keinen Firmennamen. Wer wir sind, erfährst du im ersten Gespräch.

Wir bauen unser Marketing-Team neu auf, und du wirst eine der beiden tragenden Säulen darunter: Gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Marketing und der Lead der Creative-Seite bildest du das Führungsdreieck des Teams. Du verantwortest alles, was Nutzer:innen zu uns bringt und sie bei uns hält.

Dafür steht dir ein Jahresbudget von 2 Mio. € zur Verfügung, das du eigenverantwortlich auf Kanäle und Projekte verteilst. Dazu verantwortest du ein kleines Team aus CRM und Product Marketing.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst unsere Acquisition über alle Paid-Kanäle hinweg: Du entscheidest, wo das Budget den größten Hebel hat, planst die Projekte dahinter und begleitest die Umsetzung.

  • Du koordinierst die Arbeit deines Teams: Was du planst, wird von CRM und Product Marketing umgesetzt, und du sorgst dafür, dass Prioritäten, Timings und Kapazitäten zusammenpassen.

  • CRM und Lifecycle liegen in deiner Hand: Du gestaltest aus, wohin wir die Kommunikation entwickeln, und planst die Projekte, mit denen wir dorthin kommen.

  • Bei Performance und BI baust du die Grundlage, auf der wir Kanäle beurteilen, und leitest daraus ab, was als Nächstes passiert.

  • Unser Martech- und Tracking-Setup gehört ebenfalls zu deinem Bereich. Dafür steht dir zusätzlich eine externe Expertin oder ein externer Experte zur Seite, den du steuerst.

  • Du baust unsere Partnerschaften im Influencer- und Affiliate-Bereich auf und entscheidest, mit wem wir arbeiten und in welchen Formaten.

  • Mit unserem Creative-Team arbeitest du eng zusammen, dort entstehen die Assets für deine Kampagnen.

Dein Profil

Wie du denkst und wie du arbeitest, zählt für uns mehr als dein Lebenslauf.

  • Ownership: Du willst diese Verantwortung, also Budget, Team und Zahlen, und siehst darin eine Chance und kein Risiko. Du hast vielleicht noch kein Team geführt, willst es aber und bringst die Reife mit, es gut zu machen.

  • Fachliche Basis: Du hast zwei bis vier Jahre im Performance Marketing, Growth oder Media Buying gearbeitet, bist sicher in den gängigen Ad-Plattformen und im Umgang mit Tracking- und Analytics-Setups. Eigene Budgetverantwortung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Der Rahmen: Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Muss, dazu sicheres Englisch. Du bist in Berlin oder bereit umzuziehen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte Budgetverantwortung: 2 Mio. € im Jahr, die du eigenverantwortlich einsetzt. In dieser Höhe bekommst du das auf diesem Level selten.

  • Zweite Ebene von Tag eins: Du berichtest direkt an den Head of Marketing und bist an den Entscheidungen beteiligt, die die Richtung setzen.

  • Führung: Du gibst die Richtung für CRM und Product Marketing vor und baust dir die Struktur, die du dafür brauchst.

  • Arbeitsmodell: Ein flexibles Hybrid-Modell mit festem Standort Berlin, weil diese Rolle von enger Zusammenarbeit lebt.

  • Ausstattung und Kultur: Modernes Equipment, ein zentrales Büro mit voll ausgestatteter Küche, Sportzuschuss und regelmäßige Teamevents.

title: GTM Engineering Intern | Revenue Operations (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
In a nutshell: 4 to 6-month internship in our RevOps team at our Munich headquarters (hybrid), starting between February and April 2027, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role straight afterwards.

About this role at Luminovo

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

Our go-to-market engineering function builds the systems that find the right companies and the right people for our sales team: target lists, data enrichment, hyper-personalised outbound campaigns that signal our sellers whom to call next. We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

By the end of your internship, you will have shipped revenue systems that our sales & marketing teams rely on every day, and gained hands-on experience in go-to-market engineering, one of the hottest roles on the market right now!

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

This role is for you

  • You combine technical thinking with commercial curiosity: perhaps you studied engineering and want to understand how companies sell, or you have discovered a passion for the commercial side of start-ups.

  • You are keen to work in a fast-paced environment and to grow alongside a high-growth start-up.

  • You bring the drive to learn quickly, a sharp analytical mind and the ambition to take on real responsibility from your first weeks. You collaborate well, ask questions without hesitation and are happy to get your hands dirty.

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You have built your own automations, workflows or tools, and can explain what you shipped and what came of it.

  • You are fluent in both German and English. Much of our outbound targets buyers in the DACH region, while the company operates in English.

  • You stand out if you have built something entrepreneurial during your studies, be it a side project, a student society or a small business.

  • You have first experience in GTM engineering, sales operations or automation (this is a big advantage but not a requirement!)

Your performance objectives

🧬 Run outbound campaigns

  • Deliver multichannel campaigns end to end. Build target lists, source and enrich the right contacts, and write the messaging in German and English.

  • Go where coverage is thin. Your campaigns will go wherever our sellers need the most support or wherever there is an opportunity worth pursuing, starting with DACH and extending to the rest of Europe and North America. Take on event campaigns, new regions and opportunistic plays, and turn them around to contribute to our pipeline.

🌀 Build signals and tooling

  • Ship signals. Build plugins or scrapers that generate high-intent leads for our sellers.

  • Process scaling. Transform website engagement into automated outbound triggers and create repeatable playbooks.

⚙️ Build automations

  • Remove manual work. Automate the repetitive manual tasks our revenue teams deal with day to day.

  • Challenge what exists. Get to know the systems we have built, then tell us where they fall short and help improve them.

💶 Unblock the sales team

  • Understand what sales reps need. Work closely with our AEs and BDRs, get to know their accounts and processes, and remove the friction that slows them down.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn from replies and campaign results back to sales and marketing.

🗂 Own the data

  • Own enrichment and imports. Take responsibility for account enrichment and every data import into HubSpot on contact, company and lead level.

  • Keep data accuracy high. You will be responsible for maintaining our enrichment so that data stays clean and workflows keep firing.

Your Toolkit

You will learn to work with the most modern sales automation tools on the market, such as Clay, n8n, Twain, Lusha, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and many more.

Work location

Our Munich headquarters. For your first two months you will be in the office most days, so you get to know the product, the team, our ICP and the basics of our market. After that, the role is hybrid, with the flexibility to work from home. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

Whom you will be working with

  • Max Hungenbach, Revenue Operations Team Lead and your line manager

  • Danny Bodnar, GTM Engineer, your mentor and day-to-day coach

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales. You will work directly with him on GTM strategy.

  • Dasha Vyazemskaya, Head of BDR and your partner on handing campaigns over to the BDR team

  • George Knight, Demand Generation Manager in Marketing and your partner on campaigns run alongside marketing

  • Our Account Executives and BDRs across Europe and North America, for whom your campaigns run

Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know, we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you’re interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles, see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Head of AI
descriptionHtml:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

title: Head of Business Automation
descriptionHtml:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity

We build robots that inspect industrial plants completely autonomously. Internally, our operations are much less automated than our products, which is where this role comes in.

You will own internal productivity as a measurable outcome, not a theoretical initiative. Your job is to find where hours, cash, and margins leak, determine whether the fix requires automation, a system-of-record change, or deleting a redundant process, and execute the solution.

You will build solutions directly using n8n, Claude, or whatever tool the problem requires. You will also partner with designated process owners across Commercial, Product, Operations, Finance, and R&D to implement changes within their teams. Because you are shifting how 220 people work, the primary challenge is change management, not just technology.

This is a high-visibility, individual contributor role reporting directly to the executive team and board on productivity outcomes. You will work alongside strong peers in IT Infrastructure and Data without managing direct reports.


Your Impact

  • Deliver Automations: Build and deploy automations across all business systems, including people with clear baseline metrics (hours saved, cycle times reduced, errors eliminated). Every project must show a clear, measured return.

  • Build an Operations Network: Identify and onboard key process owners across Commercial, Product, Operations, Finance, and R&D, establishing cross-functional delivery without direct authority.

  • Improve Data Quality at the Source: Resolve data issues where they originate alongside process owners, eliminating the need for downstream BI fixes.


    • Your Profile

  • ROI-Driven: You track exact costs before and after process changes. You focus on concrete operational outcomes rather than framework adoption.

  • Proven Change Management: You have successfully redesigned cross-functional processes despite organizational friction, with measurable results.

You are proficient with tools like n8n, Make, or Workato, standard ERP/CRM platforms, APIs, and AI integrations (knowing when to use AI and when deterministic systems are better).

  • Business Acumen: You understand how business operations directly impact revenue and prioritize accordingly.

    • Bonus Points

  • Experience with installed-base, entitlement, or recurring-revenue models for hardware/software products.

    • What We Offer

  • Broad operational ownership across a 220-person company.

title: Head of Business Development (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Berlin · Vollzeit · unbefristet · internationale Reisetätigkeit

Wachstum gestalten. Neue Märkte erschließen. Zukunft möglich machen.

Cantourage steht für hochwertigen medizinischen Cannabis, neue Perspektiven und den Mut, Dinge anders zu denken. Der Markt entwickelt sich schnell – und mit ihm die Möglichkeiten für Cantourage. Um diese Chancen gezielt zu nutzen, suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die strategische Weitsicht mit Umsetzungsstärke verbindet.

Als Head of Business Development entwickelst du unsere internationale Wachstumsagenda und treibst neue Märkte, Partnerschaften und Geschäftsmodelle voran. Das bringst du mit

title: Head of Data Science and Analytics (JetBrains Air)
descriptionHtml:
You’ve built data teams from the ground up and know how to turn raw information into better product decisions. You care deeply about how AI is changing software development, and you want to shape the data foundations that make it happen.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 organizations, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

JetBrains Air is an AI-native software development platform that connects developer workflows, collaboration, and control into a single system. Because this is a major strategic focus for us, we need a strong data function to help guide it. As Head of Data Science and Analytics for JetBrains Air, you’ll lead our data science, analytics, and data engineering capabilities for both the product and go-to-market domains. 

By building a high-performing team, you’ll help us use data to navigate product direction, optimize product and go-to-market decisions, and accelerate growth. You’ll own the data strategy for JetBrains AI, partnering closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to ensure our data infrastructure scales smoothly alongside our ambitions.

Day to day, you will:

  • Build and lead a cohesive team of data scientists, analysts, and data engineers.
  • Help teams adopt a rigorous experimentation culture, improving how we test and measure product changes.
  • Uncover insights across the customer journey to improve acquisition, retention, and monetization.
  • Establish scalable analytics foundations, including clear metric frameworks, data models, and self-service reporting.
  • Partner with engineering teams to design robust, compliant data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Guide the development of machine learning capabilities that enhance marketing acquisition, product personalization, and operational efficiency.
  • Translate complex data signals into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Define the business unit's data strategy to support product and engineering priorities.

What you’ll bring

  • A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to dive hands-on into the details when necessary.
  • A strong belief in building experimentation cultures and helping others make data-informed decisions.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and build new capabilities in a fast-moving space.
  • Clear, candid communication skills to align both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A deep appreciation for developer products and a distinct point of view on how AI will shape the future of software creation.
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards for privacy, security, and responsible data use.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience leading and scaling a data function within a product-led, B2B SaaS, AI, or developer tools environment.
  • A deep understanding of modern data science and analytics practices, including cohort analysis, A/B testing, segmentation, and machine learning applications to product and marketing problems.
  • A solid grasp of data engineering fundamentals, such as data modeling, and orchestration.
  • A track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary data teams.
  • Willingness to learn fast and find practical solutions to hard problems.

What success looks like

You will have transformed JetBrains Air into a truly data-informed, experimentation-driven product offering. By establishing strong data foundations, you’ll empower teams to deeply understand our customers, accurately measure product impact, and confidently make strategic decisions. Rather than just reporting on what has already happened, your work will actively shape what we build next.


Why join JetBrains? 

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.

  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.

title: Head of Legal
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

This is an opportunity to take the lead on legal matters across Zego, working closely with senior stakeholders and playing an important role in supporting the business as it continues to grow and evolve. Reporting to the Group CFO, you will work alongside Compliance and the wider Legal and Regulatory Affairs (LRA) team.

It's a varied, hands-on role with plenty of ownership and autonomy. You will be the go-to person for legal advice across the business, advising on key decisions, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts and working with external counsel where needed. While you won't have line management responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact.

A particular focus will be insurance law and regulation, which sits at the heart of Zego's business, alongside a broad range of commercial and contractual matters. You'll work closely with colleagues responsible for compliance, financial crime and risk, providing legal advice on the regulatory questions that arise, while those teams retain responsibility for their respective areas.

What you will be doing

  • Insurance distribution and capacity. Draft and negotiate binding authority agreements, co-insurance and cooperation agreements, claims handling agreements, reinsurance-related documents.

  • Insurance products. Work with Underwriting, Product and Claims on policy wordings, endorsements and coverage questions, including large losses.

  • Regulatory legal advice. Advise on the structuring of insurance arrangements, including binding authority agreements, insurer and distribution relationships, regulatory permissions and perimeter questions, and the legal and regulatory requirements that apply to Zego's insurance and lending activities.

  • Commercial. Draft and negotiate supplier, outsourcing, technology, partnership and data sharing agreements, including material outsourcing terms required by FCA and GFSC rules.

  • Corporate and governance. Support board and committee governance, intra-group agreements, financing and capital projects, and company secretarial work in the UK and Gibraltar.

  • Legal operations. Keep templates, playbooks and self-serve tools current so the business can handle routine matters (such as NDAs) without Legal.

  • External counsel. Scope instructions, manage budgets and hold firms to account on quality and timing.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Qualified to practise in England and Wales, with around 6+ years' PQE gained at a law firm, in-house, or both.

  • Substantial experience of insurance law and regulation, ideally advising an MGA, broker or insurer.

  • Experienced in drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, with sound judgement on which points matter and which to concede.

  • Comfortable working on your own with a high volume of varied matters and competing deadlines.

  • Able to explain legal risk clearly and briefly to senior leaders and boards, and to give a recommendation, not only the options.

  • Commercially minded: you find a way to get the business where it needs to go while protecting the company's interests.

  • Organised, with good records and clear file notes.

Desirable experience

  • Gibraltar insurance law or GFSC-regulated business.

  • Delegated authority, co-insurance or reinsurance arrangements.

  • Insurtech, fintech or another high-growth regulated business.

  • Corporate finance, capital raising or M&A.

  • Consumer credit or premium finance.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan.

To support this growth, we're moving from fractional legal support to our first full-time in-house lawyer. As we grow and our product and client base expand, we need someone who can own the legal function day to day.

As this is our first full-time legal hire, we're looking for a self-starter who is passionate about the role and who will build, own and manage our internal legal function, creating value and protecting the business from risk. You’ll work autonomously and efficiently, leading on legal matters and bringing in external counsel where required, and you’ll report directly to our CFO.

  • Lead on B2B SaaS contracting: draft, negotiate and manage customer, partner and supplier agreements, and maintain contract templates and playbooks.

  • Update terms and conditions as new product features are released, working closely with product, sales and commercial colleagues.

  • Act as product counsel on AI-enabled features: advise product and engineering on the legal and regulatory implications of AI in Street Group’s products (including data use and training, IP and output ownership, accuracy and liability, and transparency), and ensure customer terms, data terms and product documentation reflect them.

  • Advise on data protection, privacy and information security, including customer-facing data terms and requirements.

  • Work with compliance and governance colleagues to establish and maintain corporate governance, AI governance and policy, and compliance frameworks.

  • Support M&A and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence and post-acquisition integration.

  • Identify and manage legal risks ahead of any future diligence or exit process.

  • Advise the executive team and, as required, the Board on legal, regulatory and risk matters.

  • Keep up to date with legislative and regulatory change affecting the business.

Who we're looking for

  • You’re qualified to practise in England and Wales, with 8+ years’ PQE gained in a law firm, in-house, or both.

  • You have strong experience drafting and negotiating B2B SaaS agreements, ideally with institutional or regulated customers.

  • You’re commercially focused: you act as a partner to sales, product and senior leadership and balance legal risk with commercial objectives.

  • You’ve built or scaled a legal function, including templates, processes and external counsel management.

  • You’re able to work autonomously as the sole in-house lawyer, with the judgement to know when to escalate or bring in specialists.

  • You have excellent negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills, and you turn complex legal issues into practical, business-oriented advice.

  • You manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points if…

  • You’ve worked in an FCA-regulated business.

  • You’ve worked in a private equity-backed business.

  • You have M&A experience, including due diligence and post-deal integration.

  • You’ve had exposure to governance, company secretarial and ESG matters.

Why Join Us?

  • Direct access to the Co-Founders and leadership team

Salary

£120k - £150k dependent on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

title: Head of Operations (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies and we work with SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.


The role

As Head of Operations, you make sure what we sell actually goes live, and that the company behind it runs without friction. Your job is to make our customers successful and to free up the founders, sales and engineering to do the work only they can do.

We are growing from a small founding team into a company that runs several enterprise rollouts at once, works with SAP consultancy partners, and is hiring across engineering, sales and product. That growth needs one person who owns how it all fits together.

You report directly to the founders and our diffrent department Heads. This is not an admin role. Half of it sits right next to the customer.

What you'll own

  • Customer delivery and onboarding. From signature to live. You run the rollout plan with our Forward Deployed Engineers and solution architects: kick-off, access and security onboarding, milestones, steering meetings. You make sure every customer reaches value on time, and you spot the risk before it becomes an escalation.

  • Commercial operations. Contracts, order forms, framework agreements, procurement and supplier onboarding at enterprise customers, invoicing and collections. You make the paper process predictable so deals close faster and cash comes in on time.

  • Partner operations. We work with SAP consultancies and system integrators who use Qorelo in their own client projects. You set up and run how that works in practice: agreements, enablement, joint delivery, reporting.

  • Finance and planning. Budget, burn and runway tracking, monthly reporting, board and investor material, together with our external tax advisor and accountants. You know the numbers and can explain them.

  • People operations. Hiring process, onboarding, contracts, payroll setup, equity administration, tools. Every new joiner is productive in their first week.

  • Systems and process. You decide what we build, what we buy and what we outsource, and you use AI to keep the team lean.

What you need

  • 4+ years in operations, delivery or customer-facing project roles, with at least 2 years at a B2B software startup or scale-up.

  • Hands-on experience running enterprise rollouts or implementations: you have taken software through enterprise IT, security, procurement and works council onboarding.

  • Commercial and financial fluency: you can read a contract, build a budget, track runway and explain the numbers to a board.

  • You build process only where it helps, and you are just as happy doing the work yourself as designing the system for it.

  • You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what else they can automate.

  • Business-fluent German and English. Most of our customers are in DACH.

You might be a fit if

  • You have worked in or around the SAP ecosystem, at a consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor, and know how a transformation programme runs.

  • You have been an early operations, chief of staff or COO hire at a startup and built the operating backbone from scratch.

  • You have worked with partners or resellers and know what it takes to make a channel deliver.

  • People call you when something has to get done and nobody owns it.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo is built. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior operations leaders in Berlin.

  • The scope. You build the operating backbone of a company selling to Fortune 500 and DAX 40 customers.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg, and the flexibility to work where you are most effective. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your operations and delivery background with Louis, our CEO (60 min)

  3. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at ----- or apply on our careers page. No cover letter needed, but we would love two or three sentences on the messiest rollout or operational problem you took over, and how you fixed it.

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

Als Hospitality & Facility professionals zorgen wij ervoor dat iedereen binnen DPG Media onder de beste omstandigheden kan werken en dat gasten zich direct welkom voelen. Samen met het team zorgen we voor een veilige, duurzame en gastvrije werkomgeving, waarin collega’s zich thuis voelen en graag werken. Dit alles doen wij in lijn met de groei en dynamiek van het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland.

Wat ga je doen?
Tijdens jouw stage werk je mee in ons hoofdkantoor in Amsterdam, waar we ruim 2000 collega’s huisvesten in ons grootste hout-hybride kantoor. Je ondersteunt bij het organiseren van interne evenementen, pakt facilitaire projecten op en krijgt de ruimte om jouw creativiteit en gastvrijheid in te zetten.

Jouw taken:

  • Events & Bijeenkomsten: Je ondersteunt bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van interne evenementen (o.a. in onze Club), beheert de eventagenda, stemt de wensen af met interne organisatoren en externe partners zoals catering, schoonmaak en beveiliging.

  • Gastvrijheid & beleving: Op drukke momenten ondersteun je het receptieteam in de ontvangsthal en denk je mee over hoe we de hospitality en servicebeleving naar een hoger niveau kunnen tillen.

  • Facility Management: Jouw scherpe oog ziet alles, zo ondersteun je bij het dagelijks beheer van ons pand, de werkplekken, vergaderruimtes en facilitaire voorzieningen.

title: HR stagiair Learning & Development (meewerkstage)
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij tijdens je stage echt meedraaien en ontdekken hoe leren en ontwikkelen werkt in de praktijk? Bij DPD Nederland in Oirschot krijg je als HR stagiair Learning & Development de kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een professioneel én toegankelijk L&D‑team. Je werkt samen met ervaren specialisten en leert hoe trainingen en e‑learning bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van medewerkers.
Lees verder en ontdek of deze stage bij jou past.

Wat ga je doen?

Je komt in het Learning & Development team van DPD Nederland. Dit team bestaat uit de Manager Talent Acquisition & Development en twee Learning & Development specialisten en is onderdeel van afdeling HR, waar ruim 20 collega’s werken.
Je krijgt goede begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en leert vooral door te doen. Geen stagedag is hetzelfde.

Dit ga je leren en doen:

  • Meewerken met het leermanagementsysteem (LMS), zoals het bouwen en verbeteren van online cursussen.

  • Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van leerprogramma’s en trainingen.

  • Meedenken over creatieve en vernieuwende manieren van leren, online én offline.

  • Helpen bij het inventariseren van leerbehoeften van medewerkers.

  • Assisteren bij de organisatie van workshops, trainingen en e‑learningmodules.

  • Leren hoe DPD investeert in persoonlijke ontwikkeling, innovatie en duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450 tot €550 bruto per maand.

  • Een meewerkstage van 4 of 5 dagen per week.

  • Intensieve en persoonlijke begeleiding door ervaren L&D‑specialisten.

  • Onbeperkt toegang tot ons leerplatform en deelname aan DPD Inspires.

  • Veel ruimte om te leren, vragen te stellen en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

  • Vrijheid om mee te denken en (waar mogelijk) eigen ideeën uit te werken.

  • Een leerzame stage binnen een professionele, maar toegankelijke werkomgeving.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Je volgt een Hbo- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Learning & Development, HRM, opleidingskunde, onderwijskunde of (bedrijfs- of toegepaste)psychologie.

  • Interesse in leren, ontwikkelen en persoonlijke groei.

  • Een leergierige, proactieve houding.

  • Je kunt goed plannen en houdt overzicht.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en durft vragen te stellen.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en wilt graag nieuwe dingen leren.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.
