title: Lead Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world's carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer to own design at Spruce: someone whose bar for craft is higher than ours, and who wants to set the standard for what our product looks and feels like as it gets more ambitious.

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're just about to launch solar and battery, and we're ultimately building the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

🥖 The role

Our product handles building physics, fluid dynamics modelling and compliance – and is about to do a whole lot more. The job is to make all of that quick, intuitive and even delightful for a tradesperson who wants to spend as little time as possible at their desk. We've been design-led since the beginning, but the challenge is only growing as the product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you'll be:

  • Owning design at Spruce – Setting the design direction and standards across the product, deciding what good looks like, and building the practice (critique, tooling, rituals) that lets us keep shipping fast as the product and team grow. You'll work alongside our two product designers, raising the bar on their work as well as your own.

  • Doing the hardest design work yourself – This is a hands-on role. You'll take the gnarliest flows end to end: desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl. LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work for everyone from a 3-person local installer to a national utility.

  • Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs ship quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team).

  • Researching and validating – Spending time with installers on site to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems are; building quick prototypes to test decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.

🫵 About you

We're looking for a designer with 6+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially much more), including time as the most senior designer on a product or team – ideally in a startup or a fast-moving, impact-focussed environment. We'd love to speak with you if you have:

  • Exceptional craft – You have a very high bar for UI execution and sweat the interaction details. You can point to work you'd happily put next to the best B2B products out there, and you can explain exactly why it's good.

  • A point of view – You hold strong design opinions, argue for them, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You'd rather be challenged than left alone.

  • Comfort in complexity – You're a clear, systematic thinker who enjoys technical detail, even in a domain that's new to you.

  • User obsession – You've run research with real customers yourself, not via a research team, and you've shipped things that measurably changed how they work.

  • Range – You're proactive and self-organising, happy running several projects at once and switching between strategy and pixels in the same afternoon.

Bonus if you've worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or operational workflows – but absolutely not a requirement.

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 We're looking for the best and will compensate accordingly

  • 🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. This is clearly particularly important for this role but you'll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what we can learn, and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

title: Lead Project Manager Dual Use In-Orbit Services

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, humans. Nyx is being developed with the capabilities required for safe, reliable and repeatable rendezvous, proximity operations and docking, including missions to the International Space Station.

Building on this heritage, our Future Projects activities are developing new orbital services and spacecraft applications for institutional, commercial and defence customers. We are seeking an experienced Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager to lead the complete development and delivery of orbiters for defence and dual-use applications.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced spacecraft project manager who can translate customer needs into executable programmes and lead multidisciplinary teams from early concept and proposal phases through design, qualification, launch, commissioning and operations. The successful candidate will combine strong spacecraft engineering understanding with a proven record of delivering flight hardware and managing demanding institutional and defence stakeholders.

  • Lead the complete development of orbiters and associated in-orbit service capabilities for defence and dual-use missions, from mission definition and early concept studies through qualification, launch, commissioning, flight and operations.

  • Translate customer objectives and operational needs into clear mission, system and programme requirements.

  • Establish and maintain the project baseline, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, technical performance and quality objectives.

  • Define the project organisation, work breakdown structure, milestones, reviews and decision gates.

  • Drive disciplined decision-making, issue resolution and change control throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Ensure successful delivery against commitments in terms of technical performance, schedule, cost, quality and customer satisfaction.

  • Monitor industrialisation, procurement, manufacturing and supply-chain activities, ensuring that critical path items and long-lead equipment are actively managed.

  • Work closely with engineering and industrial teams to ensure the timely delivery of flight and ground hardware, software, documentation and operational products

  • Act as the main point of contact for institutional and defence customers throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Support and lead the preparation of proposals, responses to Invitations to Tender, Requests for Proposals and other business opportunities related to defence and dual-use in-orbit services.

  • Coordinate and lead multidisciplinary teams across programme management, systems engineering, spacecraft engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, quality and business functions.

What We Would Love to See from You

In the role of Dual Use In-Orbit Services Project Manager, ideally, you will have the following:

  • Master’s degree in aerospace engineering.

  • Typically 10 or more years of professional experience in the aerospace or space sector, including substantial responsibility for project or programme management and technical delivery.

Skills and Behaviors

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork

  • Space enthusiast: ready to change the global space industry

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

title: M&A Intern
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an M&A Intern to join manda, iwoca's M&A platform. This is a paid off-cycle internship of up to 6 months, for someone who wants to build a long-term career in fintech - Hybrid in London.

manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions. Over the last months we've built a proposition for buying and selling UK small businesses. Our first deals are done, and our pipeline is growing across both sell-side and buy-side. Most M&A firms shy away from the sub-£10m EV segment because information asymmetry, lack of knowledge, and low transaction sizes make it hard to serve profitably. iwoca has 150,000+ SME customers in the UK and a track record of building clean, automated processes, and manda is leveraging that to build an M&A platform that serves this market properly.

Your edge as an intern: you'll work on live sub-£10m transactions from week one, not pitch books for deals you'll never touch. You'll see the full deal lifecycle (origination, diligence, execution, close) inside a venture small enough that the work you do moves the business, and you'll have AI and automation as leverage rather than as a side project.

The team

You'll sit inside the manda Deal Team and work directly with the people running the platform: our sell-side and buy-side Transaction Managers, our Due Diligence Manager, and the Venture Lead. The team is small enough that you'll be in the room for real decisions on live deals, and the tooling we use (CRM, VDR, AI automated workflows) is being built in parallel by the same people you'll be working alongside.

The role

The internship is split into two phases to give you both breadth across the deal engine and depth on a project you own.

Phase 1: Core M&A Operations (first 2 months). You'll get to try out several of our live workstreams, and we'll decide your final placement based on deal flow, team priorities and where you add the most. You'll do real day-to-day work supporting the team where it matters most. Workstreams include:

  • Sell-side execution: supporting our sell-side Transaction Managers across the deal lifecycle. Qualifying inbound and outbound vendor leads, preparing materials, populating Virtual Data Rooms, and coordinating buyer Q&A.

  • Buy-side execution: supporting our buy-side Transaction Manager managing the live pipeline of searchers and acquirers. Qualifying buyer mandates, matching them to live sell-side opportunities, and helping move deals through to LOI.

  • Due diligence support: working with our DD Manager on company valuation and diligence for live sell-side mandates. Turning raw SME data into clear reports on business model, financial position, and fair valuation.

  • Origination: identifying SMEs likely to sell, running our "likely seller" models against iwoca's customer base, and converting matches into mandates.

  • Product, data & AI: turning manual workflows into automated ones, mapping the data schema for our "Digital IM", and building AI-enabled tooling that gives our Transaction Managers leverage. You'll work closely with the Venture Lead on this.

Phase 2: The project (months 3-6). Once you've built the foundation, you'll scope a project with the Venture Lead to solve a real problem or seize an opportunity you've identified during Phase 1. You'll spend the rest of the internship executing it end-to-end with full ownership and regular check-ins. Examples of the kind of project we'd back: a model that scores acquisition targets against a buyer's mandate, an AI workflow that drafts a first-pass IM from raw accounts, or a structured outbound channel into a new vendor segment.

Who you are

You're interested in M&A, FinTech, or building things from scratch, and you want to do all three at once. Most importantly, you're smart, motivated, humble, and have a growth mindset.

  • You are need-driven. You take whatever is in front of you and move it forward, whether that's fixing a broken spreadsheet, calling a vendor, or cleaning up CRM data. You don't wait to be told what's important.

  • You are financially literate. You can read a P&L and a balance sheet, spot what's odd, and ask the question that surfaces the real story behind the numbers.

  • You are tech-curious. You bring your own stack, you're already using AI tools to multiply your output, and you treat any manual workflow you see as a candidate for automation.

  • You are a clear communicator. M&A runs on trust. You write professional emails, you're not afraid to pick up the phone, and you can hold a conversation with a business owner about the company they spent 30 years building.

The requirements

  • Available for a full-time, off-cycle placement of up to 6 months.

  • Strong academic background, open to all disciplines.

  • Any experience, projects, or initiatives that show genuine M&A, FinTech, or entrepreneurial interest. We care more about evidence of initiative than a polished CV.

  • Bonus: experience working with SME data, financing, or M&A workflows.

The salary & conversion

This is a paid internship with annual compensation of £30k. If it goes well and there's a fit on both sides, we'd convert you into a permanent role on the manda team, with compensation re-benchmarked against the new position.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Operations Excellence team sits within the COO organization and serves as a strategic partner to managers, team leads, and colleagues across Stark. By delivering data-driven insights, leading critical projects, and driving continuous process improvement, we help the organization operate more efficiently, scale effectively, and achieve its goals faster. As an individual contributor, you will take end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives with significant business impact. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence key decisions, shape core operating processes, and contribute directly to the success of one of Europe’s fastest-growing unicorns.

YOUR MISSION

As Machine Learning Engineer, you own the data infrastructure and ML model development for the OAA team's AI use cases. You build the pipelines that feed models with clean, reliable data from both operational systems and back-office sources, deploy models into production, and ensure they perform reliably — from yield prediction on the line to anomaly detection in financial data.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Collaborate with the Automation Engineer to integrate model outputs into automated workflows
  • Maintain and improve deployed models as data distributions and operational conditions evolve
  • Document data pipelines, model architectures, feature definitions, and deployment configurations

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 4–7 years in data engineering or ML engineering
  • Demonstrated experience deploying ML models to production: not just research or notebook-level work
  • Python: core language for data engineering and ML development
  • SQL: data extraction, validation, and pipeline development
  • ML frameworks: scikit-learn, PyTorch, or equivalent
  • MLOps fundamentals: model versioning, serving, monitoring, retraining
  • MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or equivalent

NICE TO HAVE

  • Data pipeline tooling: Airflow, dbt, or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

  

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Developed Vetting (DV) and willing to work on site with our clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.

 

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.

  • Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.

  • Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.

  • Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

  • You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.

  • You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.

  • You've worked with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.

  • You're an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve and delivery solutions

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for challenges within an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? If so, now is the time to apply for our 4 months paid Internship Program in London.

About us

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

As part of our Internship Program in London, you will rocket launch your career in a high-paced environment with a continuously steep learning curve. In short, we offer the brightest talents:

  • An opportunity to fast-track your career through responsibility for high-impact projects that constantly push you out of your comfort zone
  • Hands-on experience building and scaling ventures together with the sharpest minds
  • An amazing network and the possibility of reporting directly to C-level staff and Managing Directors
  • Given the opportunity to collaborate on projects with industry leaders 
  • Mentorship and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the founder of our company, Mads Faurholt
  • Potential for permanent employment after the internship

Your responsibilities

You’ll be part of building and scaling companies, which, depending on the role you’ll take, could entail responsibilities such as:

  • Supporting our recruitment function covering everything from candidate sourcing to speaking with potential candidates
  • Being part of creating connections with key players from the industry, like CEOs, entrepreneurs, for example, co-founders of Airbnb, Starbucks etc. building and maintaining valuable relationships with them.
  • Working on marketing and SoMe content creation by developing, implementing and managing social media and marketing strategy
  • Data analysis; extracting the correct data for analysis, and ability to interpret and relay the data.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • Have or are in the process of finishing your bachelor's with outstanding results
  • Have experience from part-time work and/or from extracurricular activities
  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken.
  • Have exceptional attention to detail
  • Possess exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills

Starting day

January 2024. Monday - Friday we work from our office (next to Victoria station) and do not offer remote work.

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities.

  • Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention.

  • Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value.

  • Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

  • Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

You'll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Manager/Associate Director - Project Management
descriptionHtml:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward.

Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence.

You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with Programme, Project Leaders and sponsors to understand the strategic objectives and delivery requirements across the programme.

  • Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication.

  • Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery.

  • Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate.

  • Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles.

  • Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones.

  • Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves.

  • Identify and manage risks across the programme, working with team leads to mitigate blockers before they affect delivery.

  • Coordinate joint governance bodies (steering committees, working groups, technical committees) — agendas, materials, minutes and follow-ups — and ensure decisions are documented and actioned.

  • Communicate status clearly to internal leadership and external partners, surfacing decisions and trade-offs as they arise.

  • Maintain project documentation, decision logs and operational hygiene to a standard that supports a multi-year, partnered effort.

  • Coordinate resource allocation and operational support across the computational and wet lab teams where required.

  • Identify and embed improvements to ways of working as the programme evolves.

Professionally, you will have

  • A degree in life sciences, project management, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent industry experience welcome.

  • Significant Programme/Project management experience in biotech, pharma, or comparable scientific R&D settings, ideally including early-stage discovery programmes (target ID through to candidate selection), sufficient to operate as the senior Project manager for a major, multi-year effort.

  • Comfort managing a programme where scope and workstreams may evolve significantly as science matures from exploratory biology through to a defined lead series.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly with discussions spanning wet lab biology, single-cell omics, and machine learning, and enough grounding in the discovery pipeline (target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimisation) to track progress and flag risk without needing to do the science yourself.

  • Familiarity with stage-gate or portfolio governance frameworks as applied to early discovery programmes (e.g. go/no-go criteria, TPP evolution, milestone-based progression).

  • Experience overseeing third-party or outsourced work packages (e.g. CROs, academic collaborators, specialist service providers) — tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality against agreed scope, and escalating issues appropriately.

  • Fluency with modern project management methodologies, artifacts and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira; Gantt, RAID logs).

  • Strong organisational skills with a record of managing complex, interdependent works treams in matrixed environments. Comfort with the operational realities of R&D projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clearly for senior external audiences.

    Bonus Experience:

  • Awareness of the discovery-to-IND pathway and its major inflection points (IND-enabling tox, CMC/formulation, DMPK, regulatory strategy) sufficient to anticipate future PM needs, even if this programme doesn't reach that stage during the role's tenure.

  • Any exposure to pre-IND regulatory interactions or translational/preclinical handover

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

Recruitment Agencies

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

title: Manager, Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
Modalités de travail:  
Chez GoDaddy, l’organisation du travail varie selon les équipes : certaines travaillent au bureau, d’autres en mode hybride, et d’autres entièrement à distance. 
 
Sur Site: Ce poste s’exerce à temps plein sur site. Vous devez donc résider à une distance permettant de vous rendre régulièrement dans les locaux auxquels vous êtes rattaché(e). Vous travaillerez sur ce site dès votre premier jour 
 
Rejoignez notre équipe : 
Chez GoDaddy, notre infrastructure est au service de millions de clients à travers le monde. Nous recherchons un(e) Data Center Manager expérimenté(e) pour piloter les opérations, les équipes, la performance financière et la qualité des services de notre centre de données de Strasbourg. 

 En tant que membre de l’équipe de management du site, vous déclinerez la stratégie de l’entreprise en actions concrètes à travers la planification des effectifs, le développement des talents, la gestion financière, la gouvernance opérationnelle et l’amélioration continue. Vous collaborerez avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les différentes équipes internes afin de garantir des opérations sûres, fiables et évolutives dans un environnement fonctionnant 24 h/24 et 7 j/7. 

Votre expérience doit inclure …. 

  • Expérience confirmée en management et leadership, notamment dans l’encadrement de managers, le développement d’équipes responsabilisées et la conduite du changement organisationnel. 
  • Expérience dans le pilotage d’opérations au service de clients Enterprise et de services critiques pour l’activité. 
  • Expérience en gouvernance opérationnelle, gestion des risques, continuité d’activité, gestion budgétaire, prévisions et reporting auprès de la direction. 
  • Expertise technique dans au moins deux des domaines suivants : administration système (Linux et/ou Windows), réseaux, architecture des centres de données, programmation/scripting ou automatisation. 
  • Expérience dans la mise en place de programmes de formation, de développement des compétences et de planification de la relève. 

  
Idéalement, vous disposez également de… 

  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans les opérations de centres de données, d’infrastructures ou d’environnements critiques, avec des responsabilités croissantes en management d’équipes. 
  • Bonne connaissance des environnements Linux et Windows. 
  • Expérience avec Python, Bash, PowerShell, Java, Perl, Ruby, PHP ou des technologies de scripting similaires. 
  • Connaissance de RAID, SAN/NAS, de l’architecture x86, des processus de démarrage, des systèmes de fichiers et d’exploitation, des réseaux, des technologies de stockage et du diagnostic d’infrastructures. 
  • Expérience dans la mise en œuvre d’initiatives d’automatisation, d’excellence opérationnelle ou d’amélioration des processus. 
  • Expérience avec ServiceNow, CMDB, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365, Workday et des outils de gestion des stocks.
    Nous vous encourageons à postuler même si votre expérience ou vos compétences ne correspondent pas à tous les critères. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours et les compétences transférables, et favorisons le développement et l’apprentissage. 

Nos avantages 

Nous proposons une offre globale de rémunération et d’avantages pouvant inclure des congés payés, des dispositifs d’épargne retraite, des bonus ou primes, des actions, la participation à notre programme d’achat d’actions pour les salariés, une couverture santé compétitive ainsi que des avantages favorisant l’équilibre familial, notamment le congé parental. Les avantages proposés par GoDaddy varient selon le poste et le lieu de travail et pourront être présentés plus en détail au cours du processus de recrutement. 

À propos de nous 

GoDaddy accompagne les entrepreneurs du monde entier en leur fournissant les outils et le soutien nécessaires pour réussir en ligne et rendre les opportunités accessibles au plus grand nombre. GoDaddy permet à chacun de donner vie à son idée, de créer un site web professionnel, d’attirer des clients, de vendre ses produits et services et de gérer son activité. Notre mission est de donner à nos clients les outils, les informations et l’accompagnement nécessaires pour transformer leurs idées et leur initiative en succès. Pour en savoir plus, consultez notre page About Us. 
Chez GoDaddy, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des équipes contribue à créer de meilleurs produits. Notre culture valorise la diversité et l’inclusion des idées, des expériences et des perspectives. Nous intégrons les principes de diversité, d’équité, d’inclusion et d’appartenance dans notre façon de travailler, pour nos collaborateurs comme pour nos clients et nos activités. Pour en savoir plus sur nos engagements ainsi que sur nos données en matière de représentation et d’équité salariale, consultez notre rapport annuel Diversity Careers page. sur notre page dédiée à la diversité. Nous célébrons également cette diversité au travers de nos Culture)

GoDaddy est fier d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Les candidatures de personnes qualifiées ayant des antécédents judiciaires seront examinées conformément aux exigences légales locales et fédérales. Consultez notre politique complète en matière d’égalité des chances.  Refer to our full EEO policy.

Notre équipe de recrutement est à votre disposition pour vous accompagner dans votre candidature. Si vous avez des questions, contactez . 

GoDaddy n’accepte pas les candidatures spontanées transmises par des recruteurs ou des agences de recrutement.

title: Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:

title: Marketing Graduate at HRtechX
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Marketing Graduate.

About us

HRtechX is a world leading HRtech community, connecting industry executives, entrepreneurs and professionals. We are a start-up on a growth journey who help leaders evolve and create stronger businesses through people and technology. We aim to address the challenges and opportunities for HR and HR Tech. We bring together the most influential executives, investors, and entrepreneurs to share their insights on how technology will shape the future of HR, as well as forge long lasting partnerships and client relationships.

HRtechX is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Marketing Graduate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;

  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Marketing Manager - KI & Automation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

Begeistert dich der Gedanke, Marketing nicht nur zu betreiben, sondern es mit KI neu zu erfinden? Du denkst in Systemen, liebst Automatisierung und weißt, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?

Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.

Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an allein verantwortlich für unser gesamtes Marketing. Du baust die Infrastruktur auf, nutzt KI konsequent als Hebel für Output und Effizienz und prägst, wie Omnora nach außen wahrgenommen wird.

Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Keine Abteilung, die dir vorgibt wie es geht - dafür maximaler Freiraum, es so zu bauen, wie du es für richtig hältst.

What's in it for you

  • Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du bist vorerst die einzige Person im Marketing - was du entscheidest, zählt. Was du aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck.
  • Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
  • Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren und eigene Wege zu gehen.
  • Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
  • Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.

How you can make an impact

  • KI & Automation: Aufbau eines KI-getriebenen, hocheffizienten Marketings: Du brennst für KI und hebst unsere Output-Produktivität auf ein neues Level, indem du alle zeitgemäßen Automations- und Analysemöglichkeiten konsequent ausschöpfst.
  • Performance Marketing & ABM: Du planst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine täglichen Steuerungsgrößen - ergänzt durch gezielte ABM-Kampagnen für Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region.
  • Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Kanäle zusammen (Paid, Organic, Content, Email) und priorisiert sinnvoll.
  • Daten & Reporting: Du analysierst Ergebnisse, erkennst Muster und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Funnel-Konversion, ROI und Leadqualität sind dein wichtigstes Steuerungsinstrument.
  • Agentur & Sales-Alignment: Du koordinierst externe Partner und bist aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb - Leads sollen nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.

Skills to be successful

  • Berufserfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Track Record im B2B Marketing, idealerweise SaaS oder Tech mit starkem Fokus auf Marketing Automation, Performance-Marketing und Content.
  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder überdurchschnittliche Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä.
  • KI-Affinität als Muss: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich und kreativ - zur Automatisierung, Kampagnenoptimierung und Steigerung deines Outputs. Erfahrung mit Claude ist ein klares Plus.

title: Marketing Project Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Project Management meets Hands-on Marketing & AI

📍 München, Maxvorstadt | Hybrid | Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche)

💰 50.000–60.000 € brutto/Jahr, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation

Ein neues Kundenprojekt kommt rein. Unterschiedliche Anforderungen, neue Herausforderungen, viele Möglichkeiten.

Während andere erst einmal überlegen, wer sich darum kümmern könnte, denkst du schon: „Spannend. Ich übernehme das. Let's go!“

Du verstehst, was der Kunde braucht, entwickelst passende Lösungen, kalkulierst ein Angebot und bringst das Projekt auf den Weg. Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten, packst selbst mit an und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee ein richtig gutes Ergebnis wird.

Dabei ist KI für dich nicht einfach ein nettes Extra. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, baust dir eigene Workflows und hast den Anspruch, dich in neue Tools schnell einzuarbeiten und sie wirklich auszureizen.

Ob Kampagne, Website oder Content: Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können. Aber du weißt, wie du die richtigen Menschen, Ideen und Technologien zusammenbringst.

Du bist nicht nur dabei. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst mit und machst Dinge möglich.

Was du bei uns machst

Du übernimmst abwechslungsreiche Marketingprojekte von A bis Z – von der ersten Anfrage bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du machst Kundenprojekte zu deinen eigenen, führst sie eigenständig von Briefing und Konzeption bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass alles läuft.

  • Du berätst und entwickelst Lösungen. Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Kunden, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst passende Konzepte und Maßnahmen.

  • Du kalkulierst und planst. Du erstellst Angebote, schätzt Aufwände ein, planst Ressourcen und behältst Budgets, Timings und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick.

  • Du packst selbst mit an. Ob Konzepte, Präsentationen, Texte, Briefings oder andere Marketing-Deliverables: Du setzt Aufgaben auch selbst um, statt ausschließlich zu delegieren.

  • Du nutzt KI und entwickelst neue Workflows. Mit Tools wie ChatGPT und Claude optimierst du deine Arbeit, automatisierst Prozesse und probierst neue Wege aus, von denen auch das Team profitiert.

  • Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten. Du steuerst interne Teams, Kreative, Entwickler und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für klare Briefings und gute Ergebnisse.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden. Du führst Meetings, präsentierst Ergebnisse, steuerst Erwartungen und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit.

Dich erwartet ein bunter Mix aus Kunden, Branchen und Marketingdisziplinen. Langfristig kannst du je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen auch eigene Schwerpunkte entwickeln.

KI ist für uns kein Buzzword

Wir gehören zu den Agenturen, die KI-Tools gezielt, geplant und mit echtem Mehrwert einsetzen – nicht als Experiment, sondern im Arbeitsalltag. Darauf sind wir stolz, und genau das bauen wir weiter aus.

Schon heute nutzen wir eigene KI-Workflows, zum Beispiel für Projektsteuerung, Konzepte, Umsetzung und interne Prozesse.

Du musst dafür kein Entwickler oder Automatisierungsexperte sein. Aber du solltest KI-Tools sicher beherrschen und Lust haben, unsere Workflows weiterzuentwickeln und neue zu bauen, von denen das ganze Team und unsere Kunden profitieren.

Dafür bekommst du bei uns die Tools, den Freiraum und die Zeit.

Was diese Stelle NICHT ist

Kein reines Projektmanagement. Wenn du am liebsten ausschließlich Aufgaben verteilst, Timelines aktualisierst und Statusmeetings organisierst, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Du sollst Projekte auch inhaltlich voranbringen.

Keine reine Kundenberatung. Wir suchen niemanden, der Konzepte entwickelt und die Umsetzung dann vollständig an andere übergibt. Bei uns bleibst du dran, bis das Ergebnis steht.

Keine reine operative Marketingrolle. Du arbeitest nicht einfach nur Briefings ab, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für das große Ganze und steuerst die Umsetzung.

Keine Spezialistenrolle für nur eine Marketingdisziplin. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, solltest aber Lust auf unterschiedliche Marketingthemen und neue Herausforderungen haben.

Und definitiv keine Rolle, in der KI nur bedeutet, gelegentlich ChatGPT nach einem Text zu fragen. Wir suchen jemanden, der neue Möglichkeiten aktiv erkundet und eigene Ideen entwickelt.

Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen keinen reinen Verwalter, Berater oder Umsetzer. Sondern jemanden, der all das sinnvoll miteinander verbindet.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast idealerweise 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing, vorzugsweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast bereits eigenständig Kundenprojekte betreut.

  • Du bringst ein breites Marketingverständnis mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Themen, Branchen und Aufgabenstellungen einarbeiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Aufwandsschätzung und Budgetsteuerung und verstehst die wirtschaftliche Seite von Projekten.

  • Du bist organisatorisch, konzeptionell und operativ stark, kommunizierst souverän mit Kunden und kannst Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen.

  • KI ist fester Teil deiner Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, hast bereits eigene KI-Workflows aufgebaut oder Arbeitsabläufe damit spürbar verbessert und kannst uns konkret zeigen, wie.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch, findest Lösungen statt Probleme weiterzugeben und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

  • Du hast Spaß an Abwechslung, denkst über deinen eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus und möchtest dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln.

Was uns wichtiger ist als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marketing, denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge zuverlässig ins Ziel. Und du hast richtig Lust darauf, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie modernes Marketing mit KI noch besser funktionieren kann.

Warum Effecticore?

Weil gute Arbeit Spaß machen darf. Und das Leben neben der Arbeit genauso wichtig ist.

Wir verbringen einen großen Teil unserer Zeit miteinander. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass wir nicht nur gut zusammenarbeiten, sondern auch menschlich auf einer Wellenlänge sind. Wir mögen unkomplizierte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitige Unterstützung und eine ordentliche Portion Humor.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird. Zwei bis drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind bei uns ganz normal. Wann du sie nutzt, stimmen wir flexibel miteinander ab. Auch private Termine zwischendurch oder kurzfristiger Urlaub sind kein Problem. Unsere üblichen Arbeitszeiten liegen ungefähr zwischen 9 und 18 Uhr – mit genügend Spielraum für das echte Leben.

  • Verantwortung und Freiraum. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, kannst eigene Entscheidungen treffen und Projekte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Raum für KI und neue Ideen. Du bekommst Zugang zu professionellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, damit zu experimentieren, neue Workflows zu entwickeln und Prozesse zu optimieren – ausdrücklich während deiner Arbeitszeit.

  • Ein Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und lachen viel. Freiwillige Teamabende und gemeinsame Aktionen gehören auch dazu.

  • Workation in Kroatien. Einmal im Jahr tauschen wir unser Büro gegen eine Villa in Kroatien und verbringen dort eine gemeinsame Woche mit Arbeiten, Sonne und Teamzeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung, die zu dir passt. Wir unterstützen individuelle Fortbildungen und geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen und neue Themen für dich zu entdecken.

  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen. Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige Ausstattung, gute Erreichbarkeit, kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks. Und auch Hunde sind bei uns willkommen.

  • Wellpass für deine Gesundheit. Ob Gym, Yoga, Schwimmen oder Wellness – mit Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, auch außerhalb der Arbeit etwas für dich zu tun.

Und vielleicht das Wichtigste: Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst, aber nicht wichtiger als alles andere.

Natürlich wollen wir für unsere Kunden richtig gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind Dienstleister, wir übernehmen Verantwortung und manchmal muss auch etwas kurzfristig möglich gemacht werden.

Aber wir glauben nicht daran, dass gute Kundenarbeit bedeutet, ständig erreichbar zu sein, regelmäßig Überstunden zu machen oder das eigene Privatleben hintenanzustellen.

Wir wollen gemeinsam erfolgreich sein, gute Arbeit leisten und dabei auch noch Spaß haben.

Denn am Ende sollen nicht nur unsere Kunden gerne mit uns arbeiten. Sondern wir auch gerne miteinander.

Klingt nach dir?

Du hast beim Lesen schon überlegt, welche Projekte du bei uns übernehmen und welche Prozesse du mit KI verbessern könntest?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, zu erfahren, welche Projekte du bisher umgesetzt hast und welche Ideen du mitbringst.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We’ll want to see this on your resume. 
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

Total Rewards

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

title: ML Compiler & System
descriptionHtml:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

 

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

 

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

 

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

 

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.
