[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as an Operations Tooling Engineer to turn Qonto's Operations Enablement run into a self-improving system — one where every recurring request becomes an opportunity to automate, and where AI and scripting progressively replace manual, repetitive work.

You will join the Operations Engineers team, part of Central Operations Enablement — the transversal pillar that equips Qonto's Operations factories with the tools, data access, and technical standards they need to scale. Our team acts as a Technical Product Partner to those factories: we own the architecture and data flows behind our back-office platform, our ticketing tool (Zendesk), and our telephony tool (Aircall), and we scale what one factory builds into something every factory can rely on.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Handle the run with rigor: triage and resolve day-to-day requests from the run backlog — operational tooling access/config issues, dashboard requests, and ad hoc data queries — with speed and quality, helping Operations Engineers, and Operations Enablement more broadly, scale.

  • Spot the patterns: identify recurring request types within the backlog and quantify their volume, time cost, and risk to prioritize what's worth automating.

  • Design and ship automations: turn repeatable manual tasks into supervised automations via low-code, scripts, and AI tools, documenting how each one is designed, used, and maintained so the team can rely on them without you — reducing lead time and manual effort on the run.

  • Run a continuous improvement loop: for each automation, scope the solution, estimate the expected gain, deploy it, measure the actual impact, keep the documentation up to date, and move to the next candidate; following a "treat → detect pattern → automate → measure → repeat" cycle.

  • Grow into department-wide improvement projects: as you build expertise in AI and operations automation, take on small improvement initiatives, complete with guides and how-tos, that extend the tools and automations built for our team to other Operations factories.

title: Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

France's solution partner ecosystem is an important lever for Dust's growth. As Partner Account Manager, Solution Partners (France), you'll own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic. You'll turn those relationships into qualified opportunities and repeatable commercial motions, working closely with Dust's Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

This is a hands-on, commercially accountable role. You'll help assigned partners identify the right customer problems, shape clear joint propositions, and move opportunities forward. You'll enable partner teams to explain Dust and support customers effectively, drawing on Dust's technical and delivery teams where needed. Your focus is activation and follow-through for your assigned French solution partner portfolio, in coordination with colleagues who own strategic partner relationships and broader ecosystem programs.

Key Responsibilities

Grow and activate the partner portfolio

  • Own activation and follow-through for assigned new and existing Tier 1 solution partners in France that are not yet strategic, including digital transformation and AI consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners

  • Agree on focused joint plans with each priority partner, including target accounts, customer problems, sellable offers, measurable outcomes, owners, and next steps

  • Identify promising new solution partner relationships and qualify them on customer access, strategic fit, delivery capability, and willingness to invest in a joint motion

  • Help partners turn their existing expertise and customer relationships into a clear path to working with Dust

Generate and progress partner-led opportunities

  • Work with partners and Dust Account Executives to identify, qualify, and advance partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities

  • Map stakeholders and account entry points, clarify the partner's role, and coordinate next steps across the customer, partner, and Dust teams

  • Support deal strategy, value articulation, and partner participation in sales cycles, escalating product, commercial, or delivery questions to the right teams

  • Maintain a reliable view of partner pipeline, deal progress, risks, and expected contribution in Dust's CRM and reporting processes

Enable partners to sell and support Dust

  • Run practical partner onboarding and enablement so partner teams can explain Dust, identify relevant use cases, and participate confidently in customer conversations

  • Coordinate product, sales, and deployment guidance with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner Delivery; help partners become increasingly self-sufficient without taking on delivery ownership

  • Share relevant customer stories, use cases, and sales materials, and identify gaps in the enablement partners need to move opportunities forward

  • Help partners understand how Dust connects to customer systems and supports teams using multiple AI models and agents

Build a repeatable solution partner motion

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews, action tracking, and timely escalation of blockers

  • Monitor partner activation, qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, closed revenue, and partner readiness; use the evidence to focus time and investment

  • Identify patterns in successful partner-led deals and feed practical recommendations into the broader Partnerships and GTM teams

  • Surface customer and partner feedback from the French market to inform positioning, offers, enablement, and go-to-market priorities

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or commercial account management in B2B SaaS or a related technology business

  • A track record of creating measurable commercial outcomes through partners, such as qualified pipeline, co-sell opportunities, partner activation, or revenue

  • Strong understanding of the French B2B partner ecosystem, including consultancies, systems integrators, and implementation partners, with the ability to qualify them on customer access and fit

  • Fluent French and professional English, with the ability to lead partner and customer conversations in both languages

  • Commercial judgment and operating discipline: you can prioritize a partner portfolio, build actionable joint plans, manage a pipeline, and maintain clear follow-through

  • Confidence coordinating multi-party sales opportunities and aligning external partners with internal sales and technical teams

  • Strong communication and enablement skills: you can make a technical product understandable and help others present its value credibly

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership, raises risks early, and builds practical processes as the motion develops

  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to use agents and AI tools to improve how you work

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with digital transformation agencies, AI consultancies, regional systems integrators, or implementation partners

  • Experience activating solution partners and progressing partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities in France

  • Familiarity with AI agents, enterprise software, SaaS integrations, or technology-enabled consulting and delivery

  • Existing relationships with relevant French solution partner firms

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct commercial impact: Your work will contribute to qualified pipeline, partner-led opportunities, and revenue in France

  • A focused growth mandate: Activate assigned new and existing French Tier 1 solution partners that are not yet strategic, with clear prioritization and commercial accountability

  • Cross-functional ownership: Connect partners with the right Dust commercial, technical, and delivery teams to make joint opportunities actionable

  • Room to build: Help shape a repeatable way for partners to introduce, sell, and support Dust as the ecosystem grows

  • A fast-moving category: Work with a product and market that are evolving quickly, alongside a team that values customer outcomes, accountability, and practical execution

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Partner Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the role

Light doesn't implement Light alone anymore. Accounting and consulting firms, from regional champions to global names, are building Light implementation practices. Someone has to make sure those practices deliver to Light's standard on every deal. That's you.

You'll be one of the first Partner Solutions Architects at Light, sitting between our partners, their clients and our own implementation team. Most of your week goes on running a portfolio of partner-led implementations. You know which deals are on track and which are drifting. You know whether each partner has the people and capacity to take on the next one, and you're the person Light goes to for an answer on any partner deal. You also get new partner consultants trained and certified. When a partner hits something new, hard, or beyond their capacity, you step in and do the work yourself.

This is not a training role. We want a consultant with commercial instincts, someone who has delivered finance implementations, can hold their own with a Financial Controller, and can manage a book of delivery the way a good account manager manages a book of revenue. Your audience is partner implementation teams, the leaders who run them, and their clients' Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs. They're senior, technical and short on time, and they expect you to tell them straight when something won't work.

Key responsibilities

Own partner delivery across your portfolio

  • Check every deal through Light's delivery gates: did the partner get through it, on time, to the right standard?

  • Run weekly check-ins with each partner on progress, blockers, risks and upcoming go-lives

  • Track partner capacity and staffing: who they have, who's certified, what they can take on next, and when

  • Build and own the partner delivery forecast so Sales can always tell a customer yes, with a start date we can stand behind

  • Represent Light on partner deals from day one: run kickoffs with the partner and client, and drive data collection until the partner team is ready to take over

  • Spot deliveries going off track before the client does, and intervene

  • Report clearly to Light leadership on partner delivery health, capacity and quality, so nobody ever has to ask "who owns this deal?"

Get partner teams trained and certified

  • Bring new partner consultants through Light's enablement path, from self-paced curriculum and instructor-led sessions through to certification

  • Schedule the training, track progress and hold the certification bar firm

  • Teach clearly, whether the room holds a partner associate or a client CFO

  • Feed what you learn on live deals back into the curriculum, the playbooks and the product

Step in as the expert when partners can't

  • Take on consulting work directly when a partner meets something new or complex, or runs out of capacity: a consolidation edge case, an unusual migration, a tricky entity structure

  • Coach partners on turning finance requirements into platform design: chart of accounts, entity structure, consolidation logic, reporting

  • Know Light well enough to demo any workflow credibly and answer the hard configuration and accounting questions partners bring you

Experience & qualifications

  • Degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field

  • 5+ years in finance transformation, ERP implementation or finance advisory: Big 4, a finance-focused boutique, or a vendor-side professional services team (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday Financials)

  • You've done the work: hands-on roles on real implementations, not "I've used an ERP"

  • You're fluent in accounting and can hold your own with a Controller on multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, accruals, and statutory vs management reporting. A qualified accountant is a plus, not a requirement

  • You've managed a portfolio, not just a project: many moving deals, many stakeholders, one clear view of where everything stands

  • Commercial or client-facing experience beyond delivery is a strong signal, for example account management, client services, or a pre-sales or sales role

  • You're highly organised and analytical. You like a good forecast, keep clean data, and spot the deal that's quietly going wrong

  • You're a strong communicator and a confident presenter, and you've trained or coached other consultants at some point in your career

  • You work well through people who don't report to you, and build trust with partner leadership and client finance teams through clear communication and consistent follow-through

  • You use AI tools daily, and have specific opinions on where they help in delivery work and where they don't

  • Fluent English; additional European languages a plus, German especially

  • Bonus: a go-live with your name on it as the accountable lead; multi-jurisdiction experience (IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAPs); experience at or with an implementation partner; experience losing a customer or missing a go-live and learning from it

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was in Piemonte, next time is in Provence)

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining motion

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

title: Partnerships Manager - M&A Platform
descriptionHtml:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

title: Platform Deployment Engineer (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.


That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.

 

What you will do

  • The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.

  • Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.

  • The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.

  • The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.

  • The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.

 

Where you will do it
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.

 

If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 

Who you are

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.

  • Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.

  • Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.

  • Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.

  • Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.

  • Professional customer-facing English, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.

Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 

You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 

Where You Will Be

  • Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich;

  • Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe

  • Start date: ASAP

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

  

About the role

 

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to build the backbone of applied artificial intelligence for our customers. Who we're looking for:

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. title: Post-doctorant.e "Influence de l’irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire dans un acier faiblement allié" - CDD 24 mois
descriptionHtml:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacuna l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.

Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.

Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de cinq ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Les travaux de la chaire incluent plusieurs doctorats et post-doctorats visant à faire progresser la connaissance du phénomène de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les aciers faiblement alliés et de la fragilisation associée, ainsi qu’à développer de nouvelles méthodologies de mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire, ou à améliorer les méthodologies existantes.

Le post-doc proposé ici, financé par EDF, vise à déterminer l'effet de l'irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire, pour les matériaux suivis dans le cadre du programme de surveillance des effets de l'irradiation sur les matériaux des cuves REP d'EDF. Il est en effet important de savoir si de la fragilisation intergranulaire peut intervenir à forte fluence pour prévoir correctement l'évolution des propriétés de rupture. C'est donc une caractérisation qui vient en appui de l'interprétation des fragilisations mesurées dans le cadre du programme de surveillance. Le travail consistera à mesurer les états de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les états non irradié et irradié en utilisant la microscopie électronique en transmission (STEM-EDX). Contrairement à la spectroscopie Auger, la microscopie électronique ne nécessite pas l'obtention d'une surface de rupture sous ultra-vide, ce qui constitue un avantage pour des matériaux dont la tendance à la rupture intergranulaire est faible. L'acier de cuve a une certaine hétérogénéité de composition chimique locale à cause de la présence de mésoségrégations enrichies en solutés majeurs et en impuretés fragilisantes comme le phosphore. Pour juger des seuls effets de l'irradiation, les zones d'analyse en microscopie électronique devront donc être équivalentes en termes d'intensité de mésoségrégation dans les états non irradié et irradié. Ceci nécessitera une caractérisation préalable des mésoségrégations et un prélèvement ciblé des lames minces en zone ségrégée ou en zone non ségrégée par faisceau d'ions focalisés (FIB). Les travaux de microscopie électronique seront réalisés à Saint-Etienne (microscope Jeol NeoARM) pour l’état non irradié, et au laboratoire d'analyse des matériaux irradiés d'EDF à Chinon (microscope FEI Osiris) pour l’état irradié. Une méthodologie d'analyse des ségrégations intergranulaires a été développée pour ce type de microscope au cours de la thèse de C.Y. Hsu (2023) et fait actuellement l’objet d’un développement dans le cadre d’un des post-docs de la chaire (mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire du carbone par STEM-EDX).

Le poste est basé sur le campus de Saint-Étienne, avec des déplacements réguliers au LIDEC d’EDF (CNPE de Chinon, 37420 Avoine).


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes :

Vous êtes doté(e) des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes :

· Bonne connaissance de la science des matériaux

· Expérience en microscopie électronique en transmission et FIB

title: Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About the role
(Hybrid)

As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences.

This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning.

What you’ll be doing

  • Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions.

  • Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers.

  • Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated.

  • Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability.

  • Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against.

  • Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.

  • Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community.

About you

  • Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners.

  • Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure.

  • An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed.

  • Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table.

  • End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest.

  • Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab.

  • Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter.

What it's like here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

title: Principal Machine Learning Scientist, Recommender Systems
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Every courier who works with Relay chooses their day. A day is a set of routes that have to fit together, and every courier's ideal day competes with everyone else's. Work is finite and every route still has to be covered, so matching thousands of couriers to the work they want is a recommendation problem with few precedents.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. There's no existing recommender to iterate on. You'll build it.

Recommender Systems Highlights

  • Combinatorial, constrained and competitive: every recommendation has to be feasible for the whole network, not just right for one courier.

  • Your models power large-scale optimisation that balances thousands of couriers' preferences against the constraints of a physical network.

  • Price is part of the recommendation, so economics, personalisation and optimisation have to work as one.

  • Our apps collect millions of data points every day.

The Opportunity

As a Principal Machine Learning Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for recommender systems at Relay.

  • Lead the evolution of Relay's recommender from research to production.

  • Design and build the recommender systems that power Relay's key decisions.

  • Partner with Operational Research to unite recommender models and optimisation.

  • Contribute to Relay's research culture, and develop our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have built recommender systems at scale, owned them in production, and led their direction.

  • Bring deep expertise in recommender systems, reinforcement learning and LLMs, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Think in experiments, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open-ended problems, and know how to make them tractable.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant autonomy and visibility. You will lead through expertise rather than formal authority, working alongside senior specialists and leaders across SEO, Product, Engineering and Analytics to shape decisions across the organisation.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

  • Commercial and strategic thinking- able to translate complex technical findings into priorities based on expected value, risk, effort, confidence and opportunity cost, connecting technical decisions to organic and commercial outcomes.
  • Principal-level influence- experienced in influencing Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders without direct authority, challenging constructively and communicating complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A builder's mindset- intellectually curious, technically self-sufficient and comfortable remaining deeply hands-on while creating systems, standards and capabilities that increase the impact of teams beyond your own individual contribution.

The Interview Process:

1st: Initial chat with our Talent Partner - 30 minutes via Zoom.

2nd: Interview with our Chief Gaming Officer - 60 minutes via Zoom.

3rd: Technical SEO interview with senior members of our SEO team - 60 minutes via Zoom.

4th: Case presentation and Principal peer interview - 90 minutes via Zoom, including a technical SEO assessment prepared ahead of the interview.

Dabei geht es um mehr als Depot, Finanzierung oder Vorsorge. Es geht um den Menschen hinter dem Unternehmen, seine persönlichen Ziele und oft auch um die nächste Generation. Denn als Volksbank Lübeck denken wir Beziehungen nicht von Quartal zu Quartal, sondern von Generation zu Generation. Genau das soll man in unserer Beratung spüren.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle:

Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für die privaten Finanzthemen unserer Firmenkundschaft. Gemeinsam mit der Firmenkundenberatung und den passenden Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten entwickelst du Lösungen, die private und unternehmerische Lebenswelten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.

Deine Aufgaben:

Ganzheitlich beraten und Beziehungen entwickeln. Du betreust vermögende und sehr vermögende Kundinnen und Kunden, gewinnst neue Kundenbeziehungen und entwickelst bestehende Verbindungen nachhaltig und ertragsorientiert weiter.

Bedarfe wirklich verstehen. Im partnerschaftlichen Dialog entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis für die persönlichen Ziele und die finanzielle Situation deiner Kundinnen und Kunden. Daraus entstehen individuelle Lösungen und ein Beratungserlebnis, das in Erinnerung bleibt.

Vermögen strategisch planen. Du führst ganzheitliche Vermögensplanungen durch und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Anlagestrategien einschließlich einer langfristig ausgerichteten Vermögensstruktur und strategischen Asset Allokation.

Privat und unternehmerisch verbinden. Du verstehst die Wechselwirkungen zwischen Unternehmen, privatem Vermögen, Liquidität, Vorsorge und Finanzierung und arbeitest eng mit der Firmenkundenberatung zusammen.

Die richtigen Menschen zusammenbringen. Du bindest interne Fachbereiche sowie unsere Partner in der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe ein und führst die verschiedenen Kompetenzen zu einer ganzheitlichen Lösung zusammen.

Qualität sicherstellen. Du erfüllst die regulatorischen Anforderungen der Anlageberatung, berücksichtigst Nachhaltigkeitsaspekte und stellst eine hochwertige, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation über alle Beratungswege hinweg sicher.

title: Product Designer, AI-Native Products (Staff-Level / L6)
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The role:

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to lead design for some of Synthesia's AI-native, agentic Sessions product surfaces.

Sessions are the experiences where employees learn through conversation, companies lrun a survey at scale, and AI becomes a direct participant in how work gets done - not just a tool behind the scenes.

This area is central to redefining what a video platform can be: moving upstream from content creation into workforce development, and making complex AI capabilities feel natural, trustworthy, and effective for everyday users.

You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions, shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the craft bar.

In practice, this role is about solving AI-native design problems, for example:

  • Designing real-time, conversational avatar experiences that feel engaging and natural - not robotic or gimmicky - for employees learning and practising skills at work.

  • Creating interaction patterns for AI-driven workflows that give users the right amount of control, transparency, and trust without overwhelming them with complexity.

  • Improving output quality through better structure, guidance, and feedback loops - helping users understand what the AI is doing, catch issues early, and iterate with confidence.

  • Working at the frontier where AI changes what "interaction" means, and the best patterns are genuinely still being invented.

In this role you will:

  • Own major AI-native bets end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration.

  • Set a design vision for our "Sessions" surface, and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to define what "great" looks like (principles, quality bar, success metrics) and then drive toward it.

  • Prototype and test interaction models quickly - including novel agentic and conversational patterns - and know when high-fidelity matters.

  • Raise the bar on craft: interaction design, UI quality, systems thinking, and consistency across AI-native experiences.

You should apply if you bring:

  • Significant experience designing complex, high-usage product surfaces - ideally including AI-native products, agentic features, conversational interfaces, or products where the system takes meaningful autonomous action.

  • Strong craft in interaction design and visual design, and a track record of shipping work that measurably improves the product experience.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can turn unclear and fast-moving problem spaces into crisp direction, and you do not wait for perfect clarity.

  • Systems thinking: you understand how AI capabilities, model constraints, and product architecture shape what's actually possible in the UX - not just what looks good on a screen.

  • Excellent communication in design reviews and cross-functional decision-making contexts.

  • Experience designing workflows where trust, transparency, and user control are central - helping users feel confident in AI-driven outputs rather than confused or excluded.

  • A track record of tackling novel problems in maturing product spaces, and shaping the product from early-stage bets through to execution.

  • The ability to leverage feedback from users and customers to ensure the product continues to meet real needs - including enterprise users with high stakes around quality, compliance, and scale.

At Synthesia we expect everyone to:

  • Put the Customer First

  • Own it & Go Direct

  • Be Fast & Experimental

  • Make the Journey Fun

title: Product Development Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA:

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Product Development Lead at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.

You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.

What you will do:

  • Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

  • Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

  • Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

  • Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

  • Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

  • Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

  • Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

  • Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

What you bring:

  • A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience developing mechatronic or hardware products, including experience in product development or technical project/program management.

  • A proven track record taking products from requirements through development to production readiness.

  • Strong requirements management and a solid understanding of systems engineering.

  • Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary teams without direct line authority.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and time-to-market.

  • A hands-on, structured approach and the ability to move between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus.

Bonus

  • Experience in robotics, drive technology, gripping technology, or other highly integrated mechatronic systems.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or a corporate spin-off.

  • Familiarity with relevant robotics, machinery or functional safety standards.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein neues Brokerage-Angebot entsteht nicht auf dem Papier. Sondern durch die richtigen Produktentscheidungen. Was brauchen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich? Welche Funktionen schaffen Mehrwert? Und was entwickeln wir als Nächstes?

Bei GENO Broker bauen wir ein neues digitales Brokerage-Angebot mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe auf. Als Product Owner gestaltest du unsere Brokerage- und Digital-Assets- Angebote von der Produktidee bis zum Marktstart und darüber hinaus.

Du verbindest Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktchancen und technologische Möglichkeiten mit den Anforderungen eines regulierten Finanzumfelds. Dabei setzt du Prioritäten, triffst Produktentscheidungen und arbeitest eng mit IT, UX/UI und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen. Hier verwaltest du nicht einfach ein bestehendes Produkt. Du gestaltest mit, was daraus wird.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktvision, Produktstrategie und Roadmap für Brokerage- und Digital-Assets-Angebote weiter und übersetzt sie in konkrete Entwicklungsschritte.

  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung deiner Produkte entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der ersten Idee über die Umsetzung bis zur Markteinführung und Optimierung.

  • Du analysierst Markt, Wettbewerb und Kundenbedürfnisse, erkennst relevante Entwicklungen und leitest daraus neue Produkt- und Funktionsanforderungen ab.

  • Du priorisierst Anforderungen, entwickelst User Stories und steuerst das Product Backlog, damit aus Produktideen umsetzbare Lösungen werden.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit IT, UX/UI, Operations, Compliance, Risk und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass fachliche, technische und regulatorische Anforderungen zusammenpassen.

  • Du nutzt Kundenfeedback und Nutzungsdaten, um unsere digitalen Produkte und die Customer Journey kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du begleitest Produkteinführungen gemeinsam mit Marketing und Vertrieb und sorgst dafür, dass neue Funktionen erfolgreich in den Markt kommen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle gesammelt und digitale Produkte eigenständig weiterentwickelt.

  • Du kennst agile Produktentwicklung aus der Praxis und hast bereits mit Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban sowie der Priorisierung und Steuerung von Product Backlogs gearbeitet.

  • Du bringst ein fundiertes Verständnis von Kapitalmärkten, Handelsplattformen oder digitalen Finanzprodukten mit und kannst dich sicher in fachliche Zusammenhänge einarbeiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu bewerten, Prioritäten zu setzen und Produktentscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu treffen.

  • Du denkst analytisch und unternehmerisch, hast ein gutes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und verlierst auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen das Wesentliche nicht aus dem Blick.

  • Du hast bereits mit interdisziplinären Teams und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammengearbeitet und kannst fachliche und technische Perspektiven miteinander verbinden.

  • Du bringst Entscheidungsfreude, Umsetzungsstärke und Lust darauf mit, neue Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung im Brokerage-, Banking-, FinTech- oder Krypto-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse regulatorischer Anforderungen im Finanzsektor.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau neuer digitaler Produkte oder Geschäftsfelder.

  • Kenntnisse in UX/UI-orientierter Produktentwicklung.

  • Zertifizierungen wie PSPO, CSPO oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Raum für deine Ideen: Hier kannst du nicht nur mitreden, sondern mitgestalten. Deine Ideen sind gefragt und du hast die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

  • Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln.

  • Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbruchstimmung treffen auf die Sicherheit und Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Deine Benefits

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten.

  • Bis zu 50 % mobiles Arbeiten inklusive Bereitstellung der notwendigen technischen Ausstattung und Hardware

  • Kostenfreies Deutschlandticket

  • JobRad-Angebot

  • EGYM Wellpass für 30 € Eigenbeitrag monatlich

  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen (VL)

  • Zugang zu den DZ BANK Corporate Benefits

  • Attraktive Sonderkonditionen innerhalb der genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe

  • Bezuschusste Mitarbeiterkantine der DZ BANK

  • Kostenloses Angebot an Kaffee und Wasser im Büro

  • Regelmäßige Firmenevents

title: Project Manager – IT & AI Projects
descriptionHtml:
You enjoy turning a set of open questions into a shared plan and seeing a team bring it to life, step by step. You keep an eye on dates and numbers while noticing when someone needs support. At XALT, you will keep the customer and project team connected and help turn commitments into dependable results.

You will take over one or more customer projects after sales scoping and own scope, budget, timelines and quality through to completion. You will coordinate consultants and engineers and use AI for work such as reporting and documentation. You will report to the delivery lead.

What we are working towards

We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.

What you will do

  • Take over one or more projects after sales scoping and plan scope, budget, timelines and resources realistically.
  • Coordinate the project team and the use of AI agents, set priorities and remove day-to-day obstacles.
  • Align with the customer on status, risks and changes, escalating budget or schedule deviations early.
  • Review and approve timesheets as a clear basis for customer invoices, and automate reporting and documentation in Jira and Confluence with AI.
  • Review projects after completion, including delivery lessons and financial performance, and work with Key Account Management on customer feedback and further needs.
  • We will assess your work through delivery against timelines and budgets, customer satisfaction, timely timesheet approvals and early identification of risks.

What you bring

  • Experience managing IT or consulting projects, ideally in Atlassian, DevOps or software environments
  • Confidence using Jira, Confluence and time-tracking tools such as Tempo
  • Experience leading teams day to day without necessarily having line-management authority
  • A reliable grasp of budgets and timelines and a willingness to raise problems early
  • At least one project-management process you have automated yourself with AI and can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”)
  • Very good German and good English

What we offer

  • Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
  • €70,000–90,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • The opportunity to follow projects throughout their lifecycle and achieve results together with the team
  • Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution

Your working arrangements

We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.

  • Full-time
  • Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York

Our professional community

Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.

Your AI example

We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code.

Your application

Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to -----

title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) - Digitalisierung, KI & Prozesse
descriptionHtml:
Leipzig | Vollzeit (40 Std.) | Unbefristet | Homeoffice nach Vereinbarung

4.500 € pro Monat brutto zum Einstieg – 4.850 € pro Monat nach 6 Monaten

Du verstehst betriebliche Abläufe, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Freude daran, Prozesse mit digitalen Lösungen und KI zu optimieren? Du arbeitest gerne mit modernen Technologien, denkst analytisch und kannst Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen in praktische Anwendungen übersetzen?

Dann suchen wir dich! Für ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der digitalen Weiterbildung, suchen wir einen Projektmanager (m/w/d) für Digitalisierung, KI & Prozesse.

Die zentrale Lern- und Verwaltungsplattform hat das Unternehmen selbst entwickelt – KI-gestützt und direkt aus den Anforderungen der Fachabteilungen heraus. Heute bildet sie zahlreiche Unternehmensprozesse ab und wird kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Gemeinsam mit der bisherigen Projektverantwortlichen sorgst du dafür, dass die Plattform zuverlässig funktioniert, neue Anforderungen umgesetzt und die digitalen Prozesse des Unternehmens weiter verbessert werden.

Deine Aufgaben – kurz & klar:

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du analysierst betriebliche Abläufe, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen digitale Lösungen.

  • Digitale Plattformen: Du betreust die selbst entwickelte Lernplattform, optimierst bestehende Funktionen und setzt neue Anforderungen mithilfe moderner KI-Werkzeuge um.

  • Projektkoordination: Du koordinierst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen, stimmst Prioritäten mit der Geschäftsführung ab und begleitest die Umsetzung.

  • Technik & Qualität: Du analysierst Fehler, unterstützt einen stabilen Systembetrieb und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Qualitätsanforderungen.

  • Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit der bisherigen Projektverantwortlichen zusammen, dokumentierst Prozesse und entwickelst die digitalen Systeme kontinuierlich weiter.

Perspektivisch kannst du auch Verantwortung für das selbst entwickelte CRM-System übernehmen.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Prozessverständnis: Du kannst betriebliche Abläufe analysieren, Zusammenhänge erkennen und daraus sinnvolle digitale Lösungen entwickeln.

  • KI-Affinität: Du arbeitest gerne mit KI-Tools und hast Interesse daran, damit Anwendungen und Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Technisches Grundverständnis: Du kennst die grundlegende Funktionsweise von Webanwendungen, Datenbanken und digitalen Systemen.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei komplexeren Aufgaben den Überblick.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst mit und bleibst an Herausforderungen dran.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Umgang mit technischen Anwendungen und Dokumentationen.

Du musst kein Softwareentwickler sein. Entscheidend ist nicht, wie viele Programmiersprachen du beherrschst, sondern wie gut du Prozesse verstehst, technische Möglichkeiten einschätzt und mithilfe von KI funktionierende Lösungen entwickelst.

Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Prozessoptimierung oder in der Bildungsbranche ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das wird dir geboten:

  • 4.500 € brutto monatlich während der ersten sechs Monate

  • 4.850 € brutto monatlich ab dem siebten Monat – die Gehaltserhöhung wird bereits im Arbeitsvertrag fest vereinbart

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Arbeitsplatz in Leipzig, Homeoffice nach individueller Vereinbarung möglich

  • Täglich ein warmes Mittagessen im Büro – kostenlos ab dem ersten Arbeitstag

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – der Arbeitgeber verdoppelt deinen Eigenbeitrag

  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung nach der Probezeit

  • Moderne KI-Werkzeuge und die Möglichkeit, neue Technologien unmittelbar in der Praxis einzusetzen

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen

Warum du hier richtig bist:

title: Psychologue | Operations & Community Manager (FR)
descriptionHtml:
Starting position designed to grow fast in a Mental Health Startup | Psychology background | French & English must | Join a mission driven Team | Passion needed | 100% | Office in the heart of Zurich with potential day trips to Romandie, remote only not possible

Why we do what we do

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. Every day, each of us has the power to shift our perspective and experience reality in a new way. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

  • Help with client support, translations and content in French

  • Spot what's not working yet and come up with better ways to do it

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

  • Full-time position (100%) on-site in Zurich, with potential day trips to Romandie

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology

  • Work experience or projects that demonstrates your dedication (customer-facing, sales, student association…)

  • Structured, proactive and independent, and a natural relationship builder

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in French (spoken & written)

  • Good English (spoken & written) to work and communicate with our team every day

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. (Yes, we will read it carefully, so please don’t send us generic templates, ChatGPT building blocks, or anything similar—there are so many better things to do.) Include your resume, and we look forward to hearing from you!
