title: QA Automation Lead
descriptionHtml:
Role: QA Automation Lead

Location: London, Bristol

Level: C3

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Senior QA Manager

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

The QA Automation Leads are part of a leadership team and they work closely with QA Leads and Staff Engineers to enable Development Engineers to test the code that they produce.

The QA Automation Leads will be an authority on test data creation, test tools, and test automation best practice. They will coach Engineers through test automation, provision tools, and automate controls to ensure the quality of code delivered to client-facing teams and clients.

They will work with the Quality Enablement Team to embed automation frameworks, as well as automation that will audit AI generated code and tests. They will be the conduit between Engineering teams using these tools and the Enablement Team.

The QA Automation Leads will support QA professionals in the Forward Deployed Engineering Teams in the creation and validation of End to End tests that involve their domains.

 

  • Coach and enable development engineers to write automated tests at service and domain level, and to test their own products and solutions.

  • Provide the tooling for creating test data, building test automation and reporting test results.

  • Partner with QA and development engineers in Forward Deployed Engineering teams to define and implement automated handovers between teams, and support their end-to-end testing.

  • Implement innovative automation of testing, defect management and release processes for Global Product Teams, using AI where it adds value.

  • Work with the Enablement Team to build intelligent automated testing solutions (such as testing the tests) and roll them out.

  • Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine and scale internal testing tools and frameworks, and build AI-driven tools that remove bottlenecks in code and architecture and speed up test-and-deploy cycles.

  • Lead by example as a technical leader: champion best practice in test automation, AI code validation and agent tooling, write clean, testable code, perform code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior engineers.


What you’ll bring

  • Experience building, maintaining and enhancing test automation frameworks, using tools and languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Playwright or Cypress.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, API design, data structures) in Python, TypeScript or similar, with experience automating tests using APIs.

  • Knowledge of improving test data management, users and scenarios for ease of testing, and of working with developers to review automated unit and integration tests.

  • Previous management experience, leading and coaching engineers across test cases

  • A solid understanding of the SDLC, Agile methology and QA process.

  • Experience using AI tools, such as LLM-based coding assistants and agent frameworks, as part of a pipeline, along with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge), since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to AI agent testing.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate with multiple stakeholders towards a common goal.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a solution-oriented mindset, with the willingness to speak up, highlight areas for improvement and suggest solutions.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, such as LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks or MCP-based tooling.

  • Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, models or agents, covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct?) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI’s behaviour acceptable?).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Knowledgade of Jira and test management tools such as XRay.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Quantum Processor Development Lead
descriptionHtml:

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Quantum Processor Development Lead you own people management and project leadership for our quantum processor developement. You rapidly grow the team by recruiting key members, while maintaining a high level of care and support for the team members. You report to the VP of Product and work closely with them to shape the team that defines the direction of key technical development at QuantWare. You will work with some of the smartest and most passionate people in the field, helping us build the world's most powerful quantum processors, as fast as possible.

  • Manage uncertainty and technical risk

    • Identify technical risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

  • Develop engineering practices within the team

    • Develop a deep technical understanding of quantum processor technology to guide sound, well-informed decisions.

  • Support growth and development of the team

Your Profile

  • Leadership experience

    • 4+ years delivering complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a project management capacity.

    • Show people-management experience: hiring, coaching, and performance management.

    • Lead projects as part of a larger program, with control over one’s own domain.

    • Run smaller projects directly, without needing dedicated program-management support.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Draw a clear line between technical leadership and program management, and partner with Program Managers instead of duplicating their function.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating technical ideas.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. title: Engineering Manager, SSCS: Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add-On engineering team as it develops core capabilities including Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.

You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long-term delivery and quality.

What you’ll do

  • Guide a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.
  • Be responsible for Drive engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.
  • Develop the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
  • Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.
  • Advance engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.
  • Coordinate quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.
  • Work with Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add-On scales.
  • Represent the SSCS Add-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Over 3 years of experience guiding backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.
  • Ability to hire and grow backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.
  • Technical credibility to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.
  • Experience managing predictable delivery across multi-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross-team dependencies.
  • Comfort working in an asynchronous, documentation-driven organization with clear written communication.
  • Familiarity with supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.
  • Working knowledge of concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.
  • Ability to build credibility with engineers, product partners, and customer-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.

About the team

The SSCS Add-On team is a product engineering team within GitLab’s Software Supply Chain Security stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability. For more on how related teams work, see Team Handbook Page.

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

title: Senior Design Engineer | Deel
descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

  • Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

  • You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

  • You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

  • You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

  • You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

  • You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

  • Stock grant opportunities, depending on your role, employment status and location.

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

  • Optional flexible working office membership with IWG.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Majors (UK/Nordics/Netherlands)
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.
  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives 
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are: 

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences 
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious 
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth: 

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale.   • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing.

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO.

title: Senior TechOps Architect
descriptionHtml:
We’re really excited to be building a small, thoughtful and effective TechOps team at Octopus. We’re looking for a knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Architect to help shape how we support people across the business - someone who can lead with clarity, build with empathy, and bring a mix of technical depth and sound judgment. There’s loads to get stuck into, from identity management and scripting to device management and scalable tooling, areas where most of our work sits and where we need thoughtful, sustainable solutions. You’ll play an important role in shaping how we work: setting direction without overcomplicating things, supporting the team with care, and balancing technical curiosity with a down-to-earth mindset. We’re after someone who can spot where things could be better, help others grow, and make improvements that stick. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems and shaping how TechOps supports a growing, people-first business – we’d love to chat. What is TechOps? A more modern, more lean version of a traditional enterprise IT team. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. We focus on advising rather than enforcing, and give people the autonomy to work with technology to solve their problems in the way that works best for them. We’re an autonomous team who look after a wide range of technology across the business. We empower teams to do the best work they can whilst keeping things running efficiently in the background. We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company. We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here! About the role As a TechOps Architect, You will be responsible for high-level strategic and architectural technical decisions around the business. We also strongly believe that no matter what role you have within TechOps, it’s still important to keep your ear to the ground and see, first hand, the problems our users are facing, and the impact that decisions you make have on everyone at Octopus. This means you’ll spend some of your time helping out with day-to-day “1st, 2nd and 3rd line” support. You’ll have a wide breadth of knowledge and experience across all areas of IT, but also an immensely deep understanding of many of those areas too. You’ll likely be an acknowledged expert among your peers in Identity and Access Management, and have a passion for hacking and building. You will have interest and/or experience in related areas like software engineering, security, platform architecture, UI/UX design etc. Roles that you might currently be in: IAM Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead/Senior Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Systems Architect, Systems Designer, Senior Systems Engineer, Workplace Technology Architect, Solutions Architect.
What you'll do...
  • Define what good looks like for a small and lean TechOps team.
  • Tackle some of the toughest technical issues as we scale to tens of thousands of people.
  • Make wide-scale strategic technical decisions across the whole Octopus Energy Group, globally.
  • Design, build and continually improve processes, automations and systems that will improve user experience, remove inefficiencies, allow us to scale quickly and keep our team small.
  • Mentor the wider TechOps team, providing support and guidance for any technical project they may be working on. (This role will not involve directly managing people).
  • Support the rest of the team in providing delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems.
  • Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience.
  • Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware.
  • Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business.
    • Examples of some TechOps projects include…
  • Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider mac OS and Windows MDM migration
  • Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution
  • The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors
  • Office fit-outs, including tech like network infrastructure, AV and access control SaaS migrations for acquisitions, including Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace

    • What you'll need...
  • Experience leading on a range of technical projects across various technologies and platforms.
  • Experience with scripting, using APIs and automating mundane, error-prone repetitive tasks.
  • To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time.
  • Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting, managing and deploying applications to macOS, Windows, iOS and Android devices.
  • Understanding at the API level of Mobile Device Management systems and principles.
  • Experience with modern Identity & Access Management systems, including Okta, Microsoft Entra, JumpCloud, PingIdentity.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML and Identity provisioning technologies such as SCIM.
  • Understanding at a protocol level of Single Sign-On (SSO) and identity provisioning technologies such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML and SCIM
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical, senior stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring less experienced team members.
  • A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing.
  • Strong opinions on best practice and you challenge traditional norms, advocating for more modern, novel approaches.
    • Should have:
  • Experience with email gateway administration and email routing.
  • Understanding of email security protocols and standards e.g. SPF, DKIM, DMARC etc.
  • Experience using git and GitHub for code changes and CI/CD.
  • Experience with Munki and AutoPkg for macOS software deployment
  • Experience with Chocolatey and PowerShell for Windows software deployment
  • A foundational understanding of programming and software engineering.
  • Experience integrating different identity providers
    • Nice to have:
  • Familiarity with frontend and backend engineering, including languages such as TypeScript and Python, and frameworks such as React, Remix and Django.
  • Familiarity with our security tooling - CrowdStrike EDR, Kolide, osquery, Zscaler
    • Don’t think you check off all of the above? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn so get in touch and let us know which areas you don’t currently have confidence and/or experience with, we’d love to hear from you!
    Why else you'll love it here 💚:
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
  • 🎁 Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.

We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.

  • Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.

  • Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.

  • Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.

  • Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.

  • Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team.

  • Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment.

  • Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships.

  • Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours.

  • Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation.

  • Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates.

  • Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo.

  • Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site.

 

This Role Is For You If

  • You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome.

  • You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer.

  • You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself.

  • You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute.

 

This Role Is NOT

  • A people management role away from the code

  • A program or project management role

  • A pilot position or vehicle operator role

  • Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly)

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability

  • Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery

  • Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy

  • Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements

  • Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments

  • Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams

  • Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++)

  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: NAT, DNS/mDNS, UDP/TCP protocols, multicast, and firewall configuration

  • Experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting

  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with U.S. government and military customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including to remote or restricted-access locations

  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active U.S. Secret security clearance or higher

  • Prior defense, intelligence community, or aerospace software experience, especially with the U.S. Navy

  • Experience integrating C2 or autonomy software onto third-party vehicles

  • Familiarity with unmanned systems and C2 interoperability standards (UMAA, MAVLink, STANAG 4586, OMS, UCI, or A-GRA)

  • Background in multi-vehicle C2, track management, sensor fusion, or sensor-to-shooter software

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and Protobuf

  • Comfort operating in non-permissive or resource-constrained environments

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $220K – $300K • Offers Equity

title: Territory Account Executive - Germany
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Southern Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts, from established Mittelstand to larger companies, and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart or Munich, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Knowledge of the industrial, financial and Mittelstand landscape in Western and Southern Germany.

descriptionHtml:

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future.   • Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
descriptionHtml:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

title: Responsable de projet - Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect H/F
descriptionHtml:
L'Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, elle contribue à sécuriser les échanges de données de santé, à développer l'interopérabilité et à promouvoir des services numériques au bénéfice des professionnels et des usagers.

Au cœur de ces enjeux, Pro Santé Connect (PSC) est le service de fédération d'identité du secteur de la santé. Il permet aux professionnels d'accéder de manière sécurisée aux services numériques de santé grâce à une authentification adaptée à leurs besoins. Pour accompagner le développement de cet écosystème, l'ANS développe l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect (EDC PSC). Ce dispositif vise à permettre aux solutions numériques en santé de se raccorder à Pro Santé Connect et à leurs utilisateurs d'accéder aux services numériques dans des conditions maîtrisées de sécurité et de confiance. Il repose sur plusieurs dimensions complémentaires : interopérabilité technique, exigences de sécurité, référencement, qualification, accompagnement des acteurs et surveillance dans la durée.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable de projet transverse, chargé(e) de porter la vision globale de l'Espace de confiance et d'en coordonner le développement et le fonctionnement.

🎯 Vos missions

En tant que Responsable de projet transverse, vous êtes garant(e) de la cohérence globale de l'Espace de confiance Pro Santé Connect. Vous définissez sa trajectoire, coordonnez les différentes expertises mobilisées et veillez au bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble du dispositif.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Définissez et portez la vision du dispositif : construisez la vision cible et pilotez la feuille de route de l'Espace de confiance.

  • Garantissez sa cohérence globale : veillez à l'articulation entre les référentiels, les parcours de référencement, les services techniques et le fonctionnement opérationnel.

  • Coordonnez les différents chantiers : organisez les dépendances, facilitez la collaboration entre les parties prenantes et veillez à la bonne articulation de leurs contributions.

  • Pilotez le fonctionnement du dispositif : consolidez les indicateurs de suivi, identifiez les points de vigilance et préparez les décisions et arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Animez la gouvernance : organisez le fonctionnement global de l'Espace de confiance et contribuez aux instances de pilotage.

  • Pilotez l'amélioration continue : organisez la collecte et la prise en compte des retours des éditeurs et partenaires afin de faire évoluer le dispositif.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement qui distingue volontairement la définition des exigences, l'accompagnement des acteurs, l'évaluation de conformité, l'expertise et la décision de référencement. Cette organisation vise à garantir l'impartialité et la confiance dans le dispositif.


💼 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée d’au moins 5 ans dans le pilotage de projets, produits, services ou programmes numériques complexes, impliquant plusieurs expertises et parties prenantes.

Vous êtes notamment reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à :

  • Construire une vision cible, définir des orientations et élaborer une feuille de route

  • Piloter des sujets transverses et coordonner plusieurs chantiers interdépendants

  • Faire travailler ensemble des équipes et des organisations aux expertises variées

  • Identifier les dépendances, prioriser les actions et préparer les arbitrages

  • Assurer le suivi d'un dispositif à travers des indicateurs pertinents et des instances de gouvernance

  • Communiquer avec clarté, synthétiser des sujets complexes et adapter votre discours à des interlocuteurs spécialistes comme non spécialistes

Vous disposez également d'une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à l'identité numérique, à l'authentification, à la cybersécurité et à l'interopérabilité

Les connaissances suivantes seraient un plus :

  • Le secteur du numérique en santé et ses principaux acteurs institutionnels

  • Les mécanismes de fédération d'identité et les services d'authentification

  • Le standard OpenID Connect

  • Les environnements réglementaires et de sécurité : PGSSI-S, RIE, règlement eIDAS et directive NIS2

title: Responsable Financier
descriptionHtml:
Description du poste :

En tant que Responsable Financier chez PLAZA PREMIUM LOUNGE PARIS, vous serez responsable de la gestion des rapports financiers, des audits, de la conformité fiscale, des opérations de trésorerie et de l'analyse financière. Votre rôle veillera à l'exactitude et à la rapidité des états financiers, à la tête du processus d'audit, à la gestion des déclarations fiscales et à la supervision des fonctions comptables clés telles que les comptes à vendre, les comptes à payer, les chefs de gestion et les activités de clôture de fin de mois. Vous gérerez également la trésorerie et la liquidité, garantissant la stabilité financière de l'entreprise.

Missions principales :

  • Rapports financiers : Préparer et examiner les états financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels, en veillant à la conformité aux IFRS et aux politiques de l'entreprise ;
  • Gestion de l'audit : Diriger et coordonner les processus d'audit internes et externes, en veillant à la réalisation et à la résolution rapide des problèmes d'audit. Veiller à ce que les rapports financiers respectent les PCGR locaux et les exigences réglementaires applicables.
  • Conformité fiscale et stratégie : Superviser les déclarations fiscales des sociétés et garantir le respect des lois fiscales locales, en travaillant avec des conseillers fiscaux externes pour optimiser la situation fiscale de l'entreprise.
  • Gestion de trésorerie : Gérer la trésorerie, le fonds de roulement et la liquidité afin de garantir que les besoins opérationnels et stratégiques en financement sont satisfaits. Surveillez les soldes de trésorerie et optimisez l'utilisation de la trésorerie.
  • Contrôles internes : mettre en œuvre et surveiller les contrôles financiers afin d'assurer le respect des exigences réglementaires et de protéger les actifs de l'entreprise.

  • Clôture de fin de mois : Examinez et approuvez les écritures et rapprochements de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que toutes les données financières soient correctement reflétées dans le grand livre général.
  • Analyse financière : Réaliser une analyse détaillée des écarts et fournir des informations exploitables à la haute direction sur la performance financière.
  • Amélioration des processus : Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus comptables, de reporting et de trésorerie afin d'accroître l'efficacité, la précision et la conformité.
  • Communication avec les parties prenantes : Communiquez les résultats financiers et conseillez la direction sur les stratégies et la performance financières.

Gestion de trésorerie : Développez des modèles de prévision de trésorerie et assurez-vous que l'entreprise maintient des niveaux optimaux de liquidité.

D'autres responsabilités connexes et des projets spéciaux ou ad hoc, selon les critères assignés.

  • 5 ans d’expérience en audit / comptabilité, plus au moins 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en hôtellerie ou domaine similaire
  • CPA, capable de conseiller sur les GAAP français, les IFRS et les dernières taxes sur les sociétés
  • La maîtrise des outils et techniques d'analyse de données est un atout.

  • Autonomie, proactivité et capable d'obtenir des résultats de qualité dans des délais serrés.

Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit. Le français est un plus.

Maîtriser Microsoft Office, y compris des compétences avancées en Outlook, Word et Excel, est indispensable.

Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français, écrit et oral

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Cosuno digitalisiert die Beschaffung in der Baubranche, einer der größten und zugleich am wenigsten digitalisierten Branchen weltweit. Als Berliner Startup unterstützen wir Bauunternehmen dabei, ihre Beschaffungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Unser Team ist ambitioniert und verfolgt ein gemeinsames Ziel: die digitale Transformation der Baubranche voranzutreiben.

Deine Rolle

Als Revenue Operations Analyst entwickelst du dich Schritt für Schritt zum Architekten unseres Go-to-Market-Setups. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership Team zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere kommerzielle Effizienz weiter zu steigern. Dabei verwaltest du Prozesse nicht nur, sondern optimierst sie gezielt mithilfe moderner KI-Technologien und datengetriebener Analysen.

  • Prozessoptimierung & Skalierung: Du analysierst unsere Sales-Prozesse End-to-End, identifizierst Engpässe und automatisierst Workflows.

  • Reporting & Forecasting: Du verantwortest Teile unseres Reportings und Forecastings und lieferst datenbasierte Insights für die Entscheidungen des Leadership Teams.

  • KI-Automatisierung: Du evaluierst neue KI-Tools und überführst manuelle Prozesse in automatisierte, intelligente Abläufe.

  • Full Project Ownership: Du verantwortest eigene Projekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live und arbeitest dabei eng mit Sales, Customer Success und Finance zusammen.

  • Tool-Stack: Du arbeitest mit Salesforce, Salesloft, Avoma, Chargebee und BigQuery.

Projektbeispiele

Beispiele für Projekte, die unser RevOps-Team zuletzt umgesetzt hat:

  • Automatisierung der Kundendatenpflege: Konzeption, Umsetzung und unternehmensweite Einführung einer KI-gestützten Lösung, die Kontaktdaten aus eingehender E-Mail-Korrespondenz automatisch erfasst und im CRM-System aktualisiert, einschließlich Erfolgsmessung und laufender Überwachung

  • KI-gestütztes Forderungsmanagement: Auswahl, Aufbau und Optimierung eines KI-Telefonassistenten für automatisierte Zahlungserinnerungen sowie Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalyse im Vergleich zur manuellen Bearbeitung

  • Automatisierung von Recruiting-Prozessen: Erstellung standardisierter Kommunikationsvorlagen für Bewerbungsprozesse und Mitarbeit an einem einheitlichen Bewertungssystem für Vorstellungsgespräche

  • Vertriebsreporting: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Reports und Kennzahlenübersichten für Vertrieb und Management sowie Erstellung eines Leitfadens für neue Mitarbeitende

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup, SaaS-Unternehmen oder in der Beratung.

  • KI-Affinität: Du bist Early Adopter neuer KI-Tools und setzt sie souverän im Arbeitsalltag ein.

  • Analytische Denkweise: Du übersetzt Daten in klare Handlungsempfehlungen und hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch.

  • Lösungsorientierung: Du gehst Herausforderungen eigenständig und strukturiert an.

  • Excel-Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets.

  • Growth Mindset: Du möchtest dich in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen weiterentwickeln und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System (idealerweise Salesforce), SQL oder Python.

Warum Cosuno?

  • Gestalte die Go-to-Market-Engine eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens mit

  • Arbeite in einem aufgeschlossenen, kooperativen, dynamischen und internationalen Team

title: Sales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.

This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues.

Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down.

Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed.

Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries.

Your main responsibilities

  • Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants.

  • Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help.

  • Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals.

  • Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria.

  • Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team.

  • Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap.

  • Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time.

  • Travel to plants and conferences, around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product.

What a great fit looks like

  • Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry, such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar.

  • Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation, presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years.

  • Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem.

  • Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations.

  • Willingness to travel regularly.

You’ll excel if

  • You build trust easily. You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities.

  • You’d rather diagnose than pitch. Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck.

  • You thrive in dynamic environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work.

  • You have experience working in heavy industry, particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar.

Success in This Role Means

  • Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities.

  • Deployments are set up to succeed. We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live.

  • Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems.

  • Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer. Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time.

    💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

    We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

    We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

  1. Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role.

  2. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you.

  3. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day):

    1. Technical interview

    2. Data analysis & presentation

  4. Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other.

  5. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

Compensation: £60K – £85K

title: Sales Mitarbeiter – Teilzeit / Werkstudent
descriptionHtml:

Deshalb entwickeln und installieren wir unsere eigenen Wärmepumpen. So machen wir nachhaltiges Heizen intelligenter, bezahlbarer und für immer mehr Haushalte zugänglich.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen und bauen aktuell unser Geschäft in NRW aus mit einem neuen Standort in Düsseldorf. Wir leben kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und einen starken Teamgeist. Dir wird Vertrauen und Verantwortung entgegengebracht – und gleichzeitig die Unterstützung, die du benötigst, um erfolgreich zu sein.

 

Deine Aufgaben

Wir wachsen rasant und immer mehr Menschen finden den Weg zu uns. Deshalb suchen wir eine/n Mitarbeiter/in für die Leadqualifizierung, der/ die dafür sorgt, dass jeder interessierte und bestehende Kunde schnell und kompetent betreut wird.

 

Du stehst mit Kunden in Kontakt, hauptsächlich telefonisch und per Video. Du hörst gut zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hilfst dem Kunden, den logischen nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Manchmal bedeutet das, einen Termin für eine digitale Inspektion zu vereinbaren. Manchmal stellt sich heraus, dass unsere Lösung nicht passt.

Du musst bei deinem Einstieg kein Wärmepumpen-Experte sein. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und Energie aus dem intensiven Kundenkontakt schöpfst.

 

Du befasst dich mit:

  • Bestehende Kunden bei Fragen weiterhelfen und für eine gute Nachbetreuung sorgen

Für diese Position ist uns deine Arbeitsweise wichtiger als ein bestimmter Abschluss oder eine bestimmte Anzahl an Jahren Berufserfahrung. Du knüpfst leicht Kontakte, hörst gut zu, stellst gezielte Fragen und kannst Informationen auf einfache Weise erklären. Außerdem verfügst du über kommerziellen Ehrgeiz. Es macht dir Spaß, ein Gespräch in die richtige Richtung zu lenken und du traust dich, einen konkreten nächsten Schritt vorzuschlagen. Du bist überzeugend, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Du findest schnell heraus, was jemand sucht, wie die Situation aussieht und ob es sinnvoll ist, den Prozess fortzusetzen. An einem geschäftigen Tag sprichst du mit verschiedenen Kunden. Das gibt dir eher Energie, als dass es dich abschreckt. Und du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig. Wenn du jemandem versprichst, am Donnerstag zurückzurufen, dann tust du das auch.

Erfahrung im Vertrieb ist schön, aber sicherlich nicht der einzige Weg zu dieser Stelle. Vielleicht hast du im Inbound-Vertrieb, im Telefonverkauf, in einem Callcenter, in der Energiebranche oder in der Telekommunikation gearbeitet. Aber auch Erfahrungen im Gastgewerbe können sehr relevant sein, wenn du dort gelernt hast, schnell Kontakt aufzubauen, gut zuzuhören und kommerziell zu denken.

title: Scientist - Functional Genomics
descriptionHtml:
Location: Oxford, London or RTP (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

Role Purpose

A genetic association tells you where in the genome a disease signal lives. It doesn’t tell you why. That’s the question you’ll answer.

As a Scientist in Functional Genomics, you’ll turn genetic associations into biological understanding. You’ll work out which genes and variants are likely to be causal, and through which cell types, tissues and pathways they act. The Life Sciences team then uses that to triage targets and build the evidence behind a development programme. Your work will span the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new uses for existing drugs.

This is an early-career role in a highly collaborative team. You’ll have the support to develop and run innovative, rigorous science, and the visibility to share it with internal and external stakeholders.

A Day in the Life

  • Prioritising causal variants and genes at disease-associated loci, bringing together statistical fine-mapping, colocalisation with molecular QTLs (eQTL, pQTL), functional annotation and variant-to-gene evidence

  • Mining our in-house data resources alongside single-cell, bulk expression, epigenomic and proteomic datasets to understand the causal biology of diseases with unmet need

  • Triaging and ranking potential targets, and telling programme teams honestly how strong (and how limited) the genetic evidence is

  • Writing reproducible, well-documented code and methods that feed into the growth of our technology

  • Presenting your findings, in writing and in person, to colleagues and partners at every level of seniority

Who You Are

You’ll bring:

  • A PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • Solid foundations in genetics and molecular biology

  • Solid foundations in statistics (modelling, regression)

  • Statistical programming in Python or R

  • Clear spoken and written communication, the ability to manage your own objectives and deliver on time, and a team-player mindset that puts your work in the bigger picture

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • A broad range of statistical genetics approaches (GWAS, colocalisation, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomisation, polygenic risk scores)

  • Experience with functional genomic data (eQTL/pQTL resources, single-cell or epigenomic data, CRISPR screens)

  • Software engineering practices (Git and GitHub, testing, documentation, agentic coding, containerisation)
