title: Security & Privacy Lead
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace.

You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them.

You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design.

As a certification body, we hold ourselves to high standards for information security and data privacy. Your work will help us meet them without slowing anyone down.

Responsibilities

  • Own and improve Scarlet's ISO 27001-certified ISMS.

  • Own and improve Scarlet's GDPR-compliant data privacy programme.

  • Be hands-on with implementing and maintaining controls.

  • Perform information security and data privacy risk assessments for vendors and AI tools.

  • Help build Scarlet's internal ecosystem of AI tools, so that it is secure by design and lets colleagues use AI freely and safely.

  • Lead threat modelling with our engineers, commission external penetration tests and drive their findings to resolution.

  • Represent Scarlet's security and privacy to customers.

  • Proactively monitor our systems and operations to spot real vulnerabilities with practical consequences.

Required qualifications

  • Experience owning an ISMS through ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits.

  • Experience running a GDPR compliance programme.

  • A track record of being hands-on, implementing security controls yourself, not only advising others on them.

  • Evidence of building a programme that scales. You've turned recurring compliance work, such as policy reviews, evidence collection or security questionnaires, into a repeatable process that handles growing volume without a matching increase in manual work.

  • Experience assessing the information security and data privacy risks of third-party services.

  • Experience working with engineers on threat models and penetration test remediation, with the technical judgement to read an architecture and challenge it.

  • Experience explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and customers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in a highly regulated environment, such as medical devices or conformity assessment.

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security attestations.

  • Knowledge of AI regulation and standards, such as the EU AI Act or ISO 42001.

  • Experience administering or securing AI platforms or agent tooling in a business setting.

  • Experience automating compliance work.

Mit einem weitreichenden Netzwerk an Ihrer Seite begleiten wir Sie in jeder Phase Ihres Erfolgswegs und bieten Ihnen die nötige Unterstützung, um Ihre Ziele zu erreichen.

title: Senior Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Account Executive in our EMEA region, you are responsible for developing relationships and closing new business opportunities with online brands and retailers with a focus on the EMEA Region. You are responsible for driving revenue within our Core Business clients by managing the sales process from start to finish including prospecting, identifying and establishing relationships with key decision makers, product demonstrations, contract negotiations, and closure of deals. As a Senior Account executive, you take a truly strategic, consultative sales approach with a hunter mentality partnering closely with the Sales Manager and Sales Director to ensure revenue forecasts and client acquisition targets are met or exceeded quarterly. 

Responsibilities

  • Drive sales, expand the client base, and generate new revenue from new leads and existing clients;
  • Build a self-sourced pipeline to improve the book of business constantly. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects;
  • Lead in-person client presentations including qualifying discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and proposals;
  • Engage with prospects to understand their unique and specific "pain points" and produce compelling business cases to meet their needs, while delivering factual and insightful feedback to marketing, product, and client success teams;
  • Leverage Salesforce data to construct, forecast, and manage your own sales activity and drive pipeline to meet revenue targets and company goals;
  • Collaborate with internal product teams and provide feedback from the frontline of the business to help shape future product developments;
  • Work closely with your manager to provide input on the growth of the business and align revenue strategies with overall company objectives.
  • Learn and put into practice all areas of the Rithum selling methodology

title: Senior Account Executive - Berlin (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Berlin zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als Senior Account Executive (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Berlin und Umgebung für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

  • Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

  • Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

  • Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebserfahrung im Vertrieb von komplexen Praxissoftware-Lösungen (SaaS) mit und verstehst, was Deine Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen beschäftigt. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Berlin (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Unser Doctolib Parent Care-Programm

  • Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

  • Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner Moka.com

 

Job Details

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit (40h / Woche)

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Startdatum: so schnell wie möglich

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

title: (Senior) Account Executive, DACH (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our Commercial Development team is seeking a (Senior) Account Executive, DACH (f/m/d). This role will be crucial in managing the entire sales cycle, from finding a potential client to finalising the deal.

In close collaboration with the SDR and CSM team, you will be key in driving growth of our customer base and market revenue. 

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more of what you can expect:

  • Qualifying inbound leads, as well as reaching out to your own list of leads.

  • Presenting solutions to prospects via discovery and demo calls, tailoring them to their specific needs in order to clearly communicate value. 

  • Maintaining relationships with prospective customers and the multiple stakeholders within their organisations to guide them through contract negotiations and signing

  • Creating a great onboarding experience for customers by guiding them through the sign-up process and seamlessly introducing them to Customer Success Managers. 

  • Staying current on company developments through inter-departmental relationships (marketing and product etc) and keeping yourself up to date on market trends. 

  • Accurately reporting and tracking your activity in our CRM system

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • You have proven experience as Sales Manager or Account Executive, preferably in the B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) or FinTech field, and ideally in a full sales-cycle and/or solution sales capacity

  • You are fluent (C2) in German and English (C1)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Ownership - You take full responsibility for your pipeline, your targets, and your deals — from first touch to close. You drive momentum, solve problems proactively, and keep pushing even when it gets tough.

  • Structured Selling - You bring the method to sales - value-based selling, or your own proven system. You communicate clearly, lead discovery with purpose, and close with control. You know when to challenge, when to listen, and how to create urgency.

  • Customer Empathy - You take the time to understand what matters to each prospect — their pain points, context, and goals. You don’t just pitch features; you connect the dots. You’re consultative, curious, and focused on delivering real value.

  • Resilience - You thrive in high-volume, fast-paced environments without losing quality. When deals fall through or the workload spikes, you stay focused, bounce back fast, and keep standards high. You're hungry, coachable, and resilient.

  • Team Player - You’re not just here to hit quota — you bring energy, support your peers, and contribute to a positive, high-performance culture. You share what works, collaborate across teams, and care about how we win, not just that we win.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Jij zet AI-projecten op vanuit de inhoud en leidt ze tot een tevreden klant.

Een sterk model bouwen is één ding. Een klant laten zien wat AI voor hem kan doen, de juiste oplossing bedenken en die betrouwbaar in productie krijgen: dat is jouw vak.

Als Senior AI Engineer combineer je diepgang in machine learning en MLOps met diepgang in generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bent erbij vanaf het eerste klantgesprek en bent als delivery lead eindverantwoordelijk voor de oplevering.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Nieuwe projecten opzetten: van eerste gesprek tot proposal, met steun van sales. Je inspireert de klant vanuit de inhoud, bedenkt de oplossing en zet een degelijke projectplanning neer.

  • De oplevering leiden: als delivery lead doe je het projectmanagement, geef je dagelijks leiding aan de uitvoering en voer je het stakeholdermanagement.

  • Technische keuzes maken en meebouwen: je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen en bouwt zelf mee. Met een FDE in het team werk je het agentic ontwerp samen uit.

  • Naar productie en draaiend houden: MLOps, monitoring, security en onderhoudbaarheid zijn bij jou geen bijzaak.

  • Het team optillen: je begeleidt collega's en helpt standaarden te ontwikkelen.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Diepgang in ML engineering en MLOps én in GenAI, LLM's en agents, met oplossingen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden.

  • Je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen, met oog voor evals, monitoring, security en de EU AI Act.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Ervaring met business development én als delivery lead of projectleider.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

  • Goede pensioenregeling

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

title: Senior Business Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Over Ockto

Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.

Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).

Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

In deze rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een commerciële blik. Je verdiept je in de behoeften, processen en uitdagingen van klanten en onderzoekt hoe Ockto's technologie hierop kan aansluiten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de directe vraag van een klant: je begrijpt de achterliggende behoeften en weet deze te vertalen naar mogelijkheden die zowel voor de klant als voor Ockto waarde toevoegen.

Je bent een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor verschillende stakeholders en weet complexe onderwerpen helder te maken. Je bouwt relaties op, signaleert kansen en draagt bij aan de verdere groei van Ockto. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere sales, marketing, account management en consulting.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen, klantbehoeften en complexe business vraagstukken om kansen voor Ockto's oplossingen te identificeren.

  • Adviseren van klanten over de mogelijkheden van het platform en de waarde die digitalisering en datagedreven processen kunnen opleveren.

  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met stakeholders en besluitvormers bij potentiële en bestaande klanten.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete business cases en passende oplossingen.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van nieuwe zakelijke kansen en bijdragen aan de commerciële groei van Ockto.

  • Begeleiden van gesprekken en trajecten met klanten, van de eerste behoefteanalyse tot het verder ontwikkelen van een mogelijke samenwerking.

  • Samenwerken met interne teams om klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar haalbare oplossingen en commerciële resultaten.

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en mogelijkheden om Ockto's positie in de markt verder te versterken.

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen om Ockto’s positie in de markt verder te versterken, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan het benutten van sales mogelijkheden en het uitbouwen van klantrelaties.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren professional die analytisch en strategisch kan denken, maar ook begrijpt hoe je zakelijke kansen realiseert. Je weet de juiste vragen te stellen, kunt snel tot de kern van een vraagstuk komen en voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met uiteenlopende stakeholders.

Je combineert sterke consultancy vaardigheden met commercieel inzicht. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe organisaties werken, begrijpt complexe processen en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete mogelijkheden. Daarbij neem je initiatief, bouw je gemakkelijk relaties op en verlies je de praktische en commerciële doelstellingen niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring in business consulting, consultative sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met het adviseren van zakelijke klanten en het analyseren van complexe business vraagstukken.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.

  • Het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en zakelijke kansen.

  • Een combinatie van analytisch vermogen, strategisch inzicht en commerciële slagkracht.

  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding, met oog voor resultaat en samenwerking.

  • Affiniteit met SaaS, fintech, data oplossingen of digitale dienstverlening is een pré.

Wat biedt Ockto?

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van een Nederlandse SaaS scaleup met een bewezen platform en een groeiend klantenbestand.

  • Een inhoudelijk uitdagende functie waarin strategisch advies, klantrelaties en business development samenkomen.

  • Veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, kansen te signaleren en mee te denken over de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Samenwerking met collega's uit verschillende disciplines, waaronder sales, marketing, account management en consulting.

  • De kans om te werken aan technologie die complexe klantprocessen eenvoudiger, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder maakt.

  • Een salaris tussen de 4250 - 5.250 bruto per maand en arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw ervaring.

Interesse?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met business vraagstukken en klantadvies inzetten om organisaties verder te helpen én bij te dragen aan de groei van Ockto? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams.

  • Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen.

  • Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

  • Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum.

  • Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

  • Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

AI-native arbeiten

AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse.

  • Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks.

  • Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

  • Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast.

  • Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen.

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up und ein Hintergrund in Food, Retail, Logistik oder einem anderen operativ geprägten Geschäftsmodell sowie Erfahrung mit einem Data Warehouse (z. B. Snowflake), SQL oder einem Semantic Layer.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen.

  • Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

  • Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Ein Team, das gerade neu aufstellt, wie FP&A mit AI und Semantic Layer arbeitet, und dich dabei mitgestalten lässt.

  • Ein Unternehmen, das Hardware, Food und Software verbindet, mit Büro in München.

UNSERE BENEFITS

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

ÜBER UNS

Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. title: Senior Campaign Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering, editorial and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Campaign Operations Manager, your role will be split roughly equally between two areas: campaign delivery, and ad tech.

Campaign delivery (around 50%): You’ll own the delivery and optimisation of client advertising campaigns across Carwow Studio brands and Carwow. You’ll make sure campaigns launch accurately, perform against their KPIs and give clients an excellent experience after the sale.

Ad tech and data (around 50%): You’ll be the team’s go-to expert for our advertising technology and campaign data. You’ll lead the troubleshooting of ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and data discrepancy issues. You’ll also maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows that power our reporting. Working with Product, Engineering and Data teams, you’ll help develop and integrate new tools, features and automated reporting.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while building a reliable, efficient and scalable ad tech and data foundation for Campaign Operations. The role offers a clear path to progress to IC4 Campaign Operations Specialist.

  

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Campaign delivery

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of advertising campaigns across channels, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

  • Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives and KPIs.

  • Monitor performance and lead optimisation with internal teams and clients to meet and exceed campaign KPIs.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients after the sale, covering campaign performance and technical questions.

  • Produce high-quality reports and post-campaign analysis decks, and present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, such as upweights, extensions and optimisations, that deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.

Ad tech and data

title: (Senior) Consultant Financial Services (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

EMPA ist eine Beratung für Data & Management Consulting mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Im Bereich Financial Services unterstützen wir Banken, Asset Manager, Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften, Depotführer und Verwahrstellen dabei, ihr Geschäft weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe zu verbessern und neue Lösungen einzuführen.

Bei uns bringst du deine Erfahrung und deine Ideen in Kundenprojekte ein. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung beim Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte zu setzen, neue Beratungsangebote zu entwickeln und unseren Financial-Services-Bereich mit aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Als (Senior) Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden von der fachlichen Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung. Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung arbeitest du als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, Scrum Master oder im PMO. Perspektivisch kannst du auch als (Teil-)Projektleiter oder Product Owner Verantwortung übernehmen.
  • Du analysierst Abläufe im Banking, Asset Management und Depotgeschäft und entwickelst Vorschläge, wie sich diese verbessern lassen.
  • Du übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in verständliche Konzepte und konkrete Anforderungen, die du mit Fachbereichen und IT abstimmst.
  • Du gestaltest digitale Produkte und Onboarding-Prozesse mit und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Plattformen und Schnittstellen.
  • Du arbeitest an Daten- und KI-Vorhaben, verbesserst die Datenqualität und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, regulatorische Anforderungen in ihren Prozessen und Systemen umzusetzen.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, führst Workshops durch und begleitest Tests sowie die Einführung neuer Lösungen.
  • Du entwickelst mit uns Beratungsangebote, Methoden und Fachbeiträge und bringst dein Wissen in Kundengespräche ein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende berufliche Qualifikation.
  • Du bringst erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Banking oder Asset Management mit – aus einer Linienfunktion bei einem Finanzinstitut oder aus Beratungsprojekten für Banken, Asset Manager oder andere Finanzdienstleister.
  • Du kennst dich in mindestens einem unserer Themenfelder aus – Depotgeschäft, Investment Operations, digitale Plattformen, Datenmanagement oder Projektsteuerung.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im fachlichen Test, etwa bei der Erstellung von Testfällen, der Durchführung von Tests oder der Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Fehlern.
  • Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen ein, erkennst Zusammenhänge und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, stimmst dich mit deinem Team ab und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist bereit, abhängig vom Projekt auch vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten.

Erfahrung mit Atlassian-Tools wie Jira und Confluence sowie ALM Octane ist willkommen. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Kenntnisse in BPMN, SQL oder Power BI. Wünschenswert sind Zertifizierungen in Scrum, PRINCE2, Requirements Engineering oder im Softwaretest, etwa ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) oder ISTQB Certified Tester Acceptance Testing (CT-AcT).

  • Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte, in denen du Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung begleiten kannst.

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung, die deine Erfahrung und deine Fähigkeiten berücksichtigt.
  • Moderne Ausstattung, ein zentral gelegenes Büro in Frankfurt, regelmäßige Teamevents und eine Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft.

Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. Gemeinsam besprechen wir, ob der Einstieg als Consultant oder Senior Consultant zu deiner Erfahrung passt.

title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.

Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.

You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.
  • Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.
  • Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
  • Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.
  • Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.
  • Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
  • Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
  • Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
  • Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
  • Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
  • SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
  • A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
  • Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
  • Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).
  • Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.

Preferred: 

  • Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

WHY QUINCE?

descriptionHtml:
About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill.

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.


    • Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (100% Remote, Worldwide)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud, Terraform and Kubernetes. If you enjoy the challenge of working with globally distributed clusters in an environment where security and scalability are taken seriously, this role is for you.

Our team has invested in a stable, observable platform. The next step is to scale that foundation. That means moving more workloads onto IaC, hardening our security posture, and preparing our services for rapid user growth. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior, fully remote team. You will own services end to end, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help other teams become self-sufficient. If you like keeping things simple, standard, well automated and monitored, come talk to us.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain our Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with the goal of having all production infrastructure defined as code and reviewed through pull requests.

  • Run and evolve our Kubernetes (GKE) clusters, including cluster upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, networking and workload isolation.

  • Migrate remaining manually deployed services onto Kubernetes, with documented and repeatable deployment flows.

  • Consolidate configuration, access and user management across Google Cloud projects into a single source of truth.

  • Keep separate, clearly bounded environments for internal services, partner workloads and future community facing services.

  • Partner with the other internal teams to move their infrastructure onto infrastructure as code and Kubernetes.

  • Keep GitHub Actions secure and efficient: pinned dependencies, least privilege tokens, sensible runner usage and controlled costs.

  • Maintain and extend our metrics, logging and alerting stack so that every service has metrics, logs and actionable alerts.

  • Apply least privilege access across Google Cloud, Kubernetes and GitHub, and review temporary admin rights regularly.

  • Contribute to the team's quarterly and yearly roadmap and give realistic estimates, including proposing discovery periods for complex projects.


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering roles, including at least 2 years running production workloads at a senior level.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, including deployments, networking, upgrades, autoscaling and troubleshooting.

  • Strong experience with Terraform, including module design, state management and managing multiple environments.

  • Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (GKE, IAM, networking, Pub/Sub or similar managed services).

  • Experience setting up and operating observability tooling for metrics, logs and alerting in Grafana (or similar) stack.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions, and building and running containerised services with Docker.

  • Good understanding of security best practices, including secrets management, IAM and least privilege access.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals comfortable scripting Bash.

  • Experience migrating manually managed services onto infrastructure as code.

  • Able to work independently in a fully remote, async team, prioritise your own work and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Google Cloud certification (for example Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) or a Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKS).

  • Experience running infrastructure for environments with strict security requirements.

  • Experience with push notification infrastructure (Firebase Cloud Messaging, APNs) at scale.

  • Familiarity with peer-to-peer or distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Node.js services and how to run them in production.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Director, Central & Eastern Europe
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Central & Eastern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across Germany and the wider DACH region, Poland, the Baltics, and the Balkans. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.

About the role: The Senior Director of Sales, Central & Eastern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.

  • Own the Central & Eastern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across Germany and the wider DACH region, Poland, the Baltics, and the Balkans, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.
  • Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.
  • Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.
  • Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.
  • Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ 
  • Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.
  • Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.
  • Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.
  • Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.
  • Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.
  • Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.
  • Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.
  • Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Central & Eastern Europe.
  • Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.
  • Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.
  • 8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.
  • A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.
  • Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.
  • Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.
  • Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.
  • Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.
  • Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
  • The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.
  • A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.
  • Fluent English and German language skills.
  • The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.

Preferred:

  • Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.
  • Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.
  • Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.
  • Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.
  • Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.
  • An additional Central or Eastern European language.
  • An established executive and technology network across Germany, DACH, Poland, the Baltics, or the Balkans.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.
  • You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.
  • You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.
  • You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.
  • You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.
  • You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer
