title: Senior Engineer I - EngEx AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Engineer I - EngEx AI Engineer

● Location: UK Hybrid (London, Bristol, Edinburgh)

● Level: C3

● Team: Engineering Experience & AI Foundations

This role is based in the UK and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll be joining the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation. As a collective we strive for engineering greatness and support others to deliver engineering best practice with every commit.

In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and evolving our Internal AI engineering platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll be building the infrastructure—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows supporting the ways users interact with LLMs — that empower our software teams to move faster and more securely.

Our tech stack is very fluid, but broadly you can find yourself working with: LLMs (Claude, GPT, etc.), writing & deploying custom tools (APIs, user-interfaces, custom agents, bots), AWS, Kubernetes, MCP servers, Typescript, Scala, Go,, and modern observability tools.

Key responsibilities include:

  • AI Foundations & Tooling: Design, plan, build and evolve our AI platform foundations and tooling. This includes the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC) and associated infra, AI Governance layer (MCP & LLM gateways), introducing and evolving shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards.

  • AI Tooling Eval & Deployment: Support the trials, evaluation and deployment of next-generation engineering tools keeping Kaluza at the forefront of new technologies in the fast moving AI space.

  • Agentic SDLC: Working with different stakeholders and disciplines to build and evolve the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework and get it into the hands of our Engineering teams helping everyone adopt the best practices of those at the forefront of agentic tooling. Taking learnings and feedback from engineers/ stakeholders, coupled with metrics and advances from industry and applying them to improve and scale our software development capabilities safely and securely.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Security & Usage Optimization: Partner with security and operations teams to ensure our AI usage reinforces our security safeguards and maximise our investments.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Systems Thinker: You possess a solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems and understand how to integrate third-party AI APIs (like Claude or OpenAI) without compromising system reliability or latency.

  • LLM know-how: You have extensive experience working with LLMs and kept pace with developments and trends in the space such as prompt, context and harness engineering as well as experience of multi-agent systems, evals / LLM-as-a-judge test suites.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance: You understand the risks of AI (data leakage, prompt injection) and can design approval processes and security guardrails that protect the business without slowing down innovation.

  • Data-Informed: Comfortable authoring and interpreting metrics to help guide work, inform priorities, measure success —like tracking AI-generated code volume or PR velocity—to prove the value of the tools you deploy.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity: The AI landscape changes weekly. You are motivated to continuously trial new tools and aren't afraid to pivot when a better solution emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Engineering Manager, IaaS
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the IaaS group builds the layer they stand on: Kubernetes, networking, and storage, running on our own bare metal.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. The org hires about ten engineers a month, and this group carries one of the largest shares.

The Role

You will lead three teams: Managed Kubernetes, Network, and Storage. Managed K8s and Network run today, each with its own lead. Storage is yours to build: charter, first lead, first hires, first systems in production. The group is about a dozen engineers today and roughly doubles this year.

Your reports are team leads. The work is direction, staffing, and the seams between the teams: where Kubernetes meets the network, where both meet storage, and where the group meets the metal underneath. You stay technical enough to challenge architecture calls and to know when to trust the people making them.

This is a second-line seat for an engineer who moved into management to build world-class organisations. Opportunities like this don’t come up often.

What You Will Do

  • Own delivery and health across three teams' roadmaps. Projects ship with the reliability that finance, healthcare, and public-sector workloads demand.

  • Manage and grow team leads. Set the standard, hold it, and grow the ones who want your seat one day.

  • Build the Storage team from zero: define its charter (object and block storage, capacity planning, tiering, backup), hire its lead and engineers, and put the first systems into production.

  • Own the seams: architecture that crosses Kubernetes, network, and storage, and the boundary with the fleet and hardware-design groups below you.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities and make the tradeoffs between what customers need now and what the platform has to become.

  • Hire. Your group carries a big block of the org's openings; you build the machine that fills it and onboards people fast.

  • Raise the engineering bar through mentoring, feedback, and the standard your leads copy.

What We're Looking For

  • You have led multiple engineering teams in production infrastructure as a second-line manager. Managing managers, running several teams at once, is the experience we need.

  • Your ground is orchestration: you have run Kubernetes or compute orchestration at real scale, shipped systems in Go, and worked on Linux itself, below the managed-service layer.

  • You know network and storage well enough to challenge specialists and tell a sound design from a lucky one.

  • You are comfortable next to hardware. This group runs on Mistral's own metal, and you will work with the fleet and hardware teams every week.

  • You have built a team from nothing: written the charter, made the first hires, shipped the first system.

  • You have grown leaders, not only engineers. People you managed now run teams of their own.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level French proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in French.

The role is based in Paris.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Withings

Based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Withings designs connected health devices that measure what your body is already saying: smart scales, hybrid smartwatches, blood pressure monitors, sleep analyzers, a connected stethoscope, and Withings+, the service that turns everyday data into a long-term reading of your health. Our products are sold around the world.

The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle.

Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it.

Your Role

As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world.

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.

Your Missions:

Art direction and creation

  • Imagine visual concepts and key visuals for product launches and campaigns.
  • Design print and digital assets: packaging, retail and point of sale, social media, website, CRM emails, event booths such as CES, and presentations.
  • Direct or support photo shoots and visual productions, from moodboards to selection and retouching.
  • Own your projects end to end, from understanding the brief and setting creative directions to execution and final files.

Exploration and ideas

  • Continuously explore new visual directions, formats and techniques, without waiting for a brief.
  • Propose innovative ideas for the brand and carry them through to production.
  • Challenge briefs from the marketing teams against their objectives before production begins.

Brand identity

  • Help build and evolve the Withings brand guidelines toward a strong, premium and demanding universe worthy of our products.
  • Ensure visual consistency across every touchpoint, including work delivered by our agencies and freelancers.
  • Create and maintain organized, accessible templates and asset libraries.

AI and new tools

  • Use generative AI tools for image and video, including Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, to speed up research and production: exploring directions, generating visuals, adaptations and retouching.
  • Build and share AI ways of working with the studio, including prompts, workflows, best practices and quality control.
  • Keep an eye on new tools and test them for the studio.

Production and collaboration

  • Adapt creations across formats and languages, down to the final production file, in line with the Brand Book.
  • Collaborate closely with the motion designer and 3D artist, and share your practices with the graphic design apprentice.
  • Brief and manage freelancers or vendors on selected projects.
  • Work with the Head of Creative and with marketing, product and communications teams in France and internationally.
  • Respect brand rules and health claims requirements in partnership with the legal and regulatory teams.
  • Manage your own priorities and deadlines.

Requirements

About You:

You have at least 4 years of experience in art direction or graphic design, gained in an agency, an in-house studio or a brand.

Must have

  • A real passion for creation: you need to imagine, experiment and make, and you want to stay at the heart of creative work rather than move toward project or budget management.
  • A portfolio that shows your ability to bring a brand to life across many touchpoints with flawless execution, along with your creative explorations, including personal projects.
  • Experience with premium or luxury brands in tech, beauty, lifestyle, design or health.
  • A strong graphic culture, with solid layout and composition skills.
  • Command of the Adobe suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.
  • Advanced, regular use of generative AI tools (Krea, Nano Banana, Higgsfield or equivalent), demonstrated in your portfolio.
  • Professional English, as our campaigns and teams are international.

Nice to have

  • Motion design (After Effects), video editing or 3D skills.
  • Experience in health or wellness.
  • Comfort using Notion to stay organized.

How you work

  • Autonomous, reliable and organized across several projects at once.
  • Curious and proactive with ideas, and comfortable defending and presenting them internally.
  • Demanding on detail, and open to feedback and teamwork.
  • Able to bring the same passion and standards to a moodboard as to a flyer.

Benefits

Joining the Withings adventure means:

  • Becoming part of one of the global pioneers and leaders in connected health, recognized with multiple awards at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES).
  • Contributing to innovative, ambitious projects that are shaping the future of healthcare.
  • Working in an international environment, with teams based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong and Shenzhen, among other locations.
  • Playing a direct role in improving our products and services, including testing them before they launch.
  • Deepening your medical knowledge through the Withings Med Academy and regular talks from healthcare professionals.
  • Enjoying a wide range of perks: stock options, the smartphone and laptop of your choice, a company restaurant, cultural and sports benefits, and much more.
  • Above all, joining passionate teams who want to make a real impact on how health will be monitored and managed in the future.

In this role, you will also have:

  • A real hand in building the Withings visual identity, with work seen around the world, from product launches to brand campaigns.
  • A small, close-knit team where your voice counts.
  • Room to explore new tools, AI and ways of working, where your ideas and experiments matter as much as production.

title: Senior Growth Manager (Contract)
descriptionHtml:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.

This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.

This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.

The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.

Responsibilities:

  • User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities. 
  • Growth Experimentation: Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.
  • Scaling and Repeatability: Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.
  • Data & Performance Analytics: Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.

Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
    • 7+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.
    • Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.
    • Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.
    • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.
    • Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.
    • Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.
    • Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.

title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR-afdeling en administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR-processen, toepassing van arbeidsvoorwaarden en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR-medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Senior IA Inference Engineer (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power Doctolib's AI-driven healthcare products — from Consultation Assistant to Phone Assistant and Health Companion — by owning the self-hosted LLM serving platform that keeps the most sensitive patient data within infrastructure Doctolib controls. You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers — define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration

  • Own the model registry and promotion path — establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team

  • Optimize inference performance and efficiency — operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)

  • Own production reliability and disaster recovery — define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response

  • Make serving performance and costs measurable — build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency

  • Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving — work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) — ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults

  • Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU

  • Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset — you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers

  • Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role

  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters on shared base models

  • Have GPU kernel experience or deep profiling skills (CUDA, Triton, Nsight), or have contributed to open-source inference projects

  • Have experience in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, public sector) and with frameworks such as GDPR, HDS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2

Our stack

  • Programming languages: Python, plus comfort reading/debugging a systems language (C++, Rust, or Go)

  • Cloud providers: GCP / AWS / Azure

  • Serving orchestration: Ray Serve / Anyscale (GCP), with Kubernetes (GKE) + GPU scheduling as an emerging parallel target

  • LLM serving engines (in production): vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM (also evaluating SGLang and other emerging engines)

  • Models: Self-hosted open-weight LLMs (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen), fine-tuned in-house

  • Experiment tracking & model registry: MLflow

  • GenAI gateway: LiteLLM

  • LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust

  • GPUs: NVIDIA L4, A10G, L40S, RTX 6000 Pro, A100 (40GB/80GB), H200

  • Container / Infra as code: Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Data warehouse / storage: GCP BigQuery / GCS / AWS S3

  • And any other tool you deem relevant!

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • HR interview by phone (45 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (1 hour)

  • Technical case study (1 hour)

  • Behavioral interview (1 hour 30 minutes)

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Tech stack: Python, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Ray Serve

  • Full-time

  • Paris, France

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Senior Immigration Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Senior Immigration Specialist to manage our UK sponsor licence and oversee the end-to-end immigration lifecycle for sponsored workers. In this role, you will manage visa applications and compliance requirements, advise recruiters, managers, and employees on complex immigration matters, and support related needs across our UK and Ireland offices.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Level 1 User on the Home Office Sponsorship Management System (SMS)
  • Prepare and assign Certificates of Sponsorship (CoS) and prepare Skilled Worker and dependant visa applications through the UKVI portal
  • Submit CoS allocation requests and support sponsor licence and allocation renewals
  • Advise recruiters, managers, and employees on immigration options, case procedures, and processing timelines
  • Support business visa applications for our UK and Ireland offices, including invitation letters and supporting documentation
  • Maintain accurate immigration case records, databases, and internal visa reports
  • Track work authorisation expiry dates and filing deadlines
  • Review eligibility documents and assess potential immigration options and benefits
  • Support immigration compliance, research, and ad hoc projects across the UK and Ireland

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • At least 10 years of UK immigration experience, including case management responsibilities
  • Experience with the Skilled Worker and Government Authorised Exchange (GAE) routes, Appendix D, Appendix Skilled Occupations, and UKVI compliance
  • Experience developing visa strategies, assessing job categories, preparing defined CoS applications, and assigning CoS
  • In-depth knowledge of procedural and filing requirements across UK visa processes
  • Experience using the Home Office SMS and UKVI websites

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. You will own the hands-on configuration and rollout of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Device Trust and Unified Access while delivering tailored, high-impact training that drives deep adoption and long-term customer value. Partnering with a Project Manager, Technical Account Managers, and Solutions Architects, you will be the trusted authority in each engagement, bringing both advanced product expertise and sharp business acumen to complex, high-visibility deployments. You will approach your work as an AI builder by actively developing AI-powered workflows and automation to scale your impact, accelerate outcomes for customers, and raise the standard for what implementation excellence looks like at 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

What we're looking for:

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to engage and develop relationships, sharing information effectively across all professional levels.

  • Excellent communication in Spanish is a plus

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, customer onboarding, or related B2B SaaS function, with a demonstrated track record of leading enterprise software deployments for large, complex, or strategically critical organizations

  • Advanced technical expertise and hands-on experience deploying SaaS products in enterprise environments, including deep working knowledge of identity providers (IdPs), SSO, SCIM, Active Directory, MDM, device trust, and Zero Trust security frameworks

  • Expert-level understanding of the business cases for enterprise security, IT operations, and SaaS governance tools and able to fluently navigate both technical and strategic conversations with IT administrators, security teams, and C-suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, high-visibility enterprise engagements with multiple competing priorities, maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines

  • Proven ability to design and deliver advanced, engaging virtual training and enablement programs for enterprise customers, including technically sophisticated administrators and executive audiences

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leadership and serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders

  • Strong judgment in identifying and resolving technical issues, with the ability to lead de-escalation efforts and drive outcomes autonomously

  • A builder's mindset toward AI. You actively develop with AI tools and automation, creating workflows, solutions, and accelerators that meaningfully improve how you and your team work; you are not a casual user but a practitioner who builds

  • Experience mentoring and coaching peers and junior team members, sharing expertise and elevating the capability of those around you

  • Familiarity with SCIM, AD/LDAP, CLI, SSO, BYOD, MDM, SaaS discovery, and device posture concepts

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 1Password or experience deploying identity and access management, password management, device trust, or SaaS management solutions at enterprise scale

What you can expect:

  • Drive the successful technical implementation and deployment of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, and Device Trust (and Unified Access as it becomes available) for large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, owning hands-on configuration, integration, and validation through to a successful launch

  • Partner with the assigned Project Manager to align on timelines, dependencies, and internal coordination. You own the technical delivery and customer enablement while the Project Manager owns project coordination; together you ensure a seamless, high-quality customer experience

  • Collaborate closely with Technical Account Managers and Solutions Architects to assess customer environments, align on architectural decisions, and design implementation approaches that meet both technical requirements and business objectives

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's environment, security posture, business goals, and user workflows in order to design deployment strategies and training plans that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Deliver advanced, customized virtual training sessions for enterprise administrators and end users across all deployed 1Password products while adapting instructional approaches to technically diverse audiences and highly complex organizational environments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for customers and internal stakeholders alike, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from IT and security teams to executive leadership

  • Manage escalated situations on complex or sensitive implementations, working cross-functionally with internal teams and engaging directly with customers to de-escalate and drive the best possible outcome

  • Exercise independent judgment in identifying and mitigating implementation risks, developing and executing resolution strategies proactively and keeping all relevant stakeholders informed

  • Stay ahead of product updates, new features, and evolving integrations across our products and applying that knowledge immediately in customer engagements and sharing it with the broader team

  • Develop and maintain advanced implementation playbooks, training curricula, and enablement resources (including configuration guides, deployment frameworks, and possibly video content) that elevate the capabilities of the entire Implementations and Onboarding team

  • Mentor Implementation Managers and other junior team members, sharing deep product expertise, enterprise deployment strategies, and insights gained from working with our most demanding customers

  • Influence team operations by leveraging lessons from complex engagements to recommend and drive improvements to team practices, processes, documentation, and the overall customer journey

  • Build with AI not just use it. Actively develop AI-powered workflows, automation, and tools that improve your own delivery, help customers achieve faster time-to-value, and create scalable solutions the broader team can adopt

  • Contribute significantly to the growth strategy of the Implementations function, identifying opportunities to evolve how we deploy and enable customers at scale

  • Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £61,000 GBP and £88,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. descriptionHtml:

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

title: Senior Lab Technician
descriptionHtml:
Senior Lab Technician | Precision Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK

Reward and Benefits

  • £40,000 - £50,000 (depending on experience)
  • Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service and private health care benefits BUPA, EMI Share scheme.

If you are a Senior Lab Technician who keeps a busy engineering lab running smoothly and enjoys building things with your hands, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and take ownership of the lab behind our advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

We are looking for a practical, well-organised Senior Lab Technician to join our Development Engineering team, reporting to the Development Engineering Manager. You will own our lab space, keeping it safe, tidy and well equipped, and support our engineers with hands-on build work for existing and next generation Metron3D products. You will work comfortably alongside electronics, mechanical and software engineers, and take pride in how the lab looks and runs. If your passion is making things and keeping a workspace working properly, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Keep every lab area clean, tidy and organised, applying 5S principles
  • Be the day-to-day health and safety lead for the lab, covering risk assessments, COSHH, signage, incident reporting and safe waste disposal, and brief new starters and visitors on lab rules and safe working practice
  • Monitor, order and restock materials, consumables, tools and PPE so teams never run short, and track tools and test equipment, coordinating calibration, PAT testing and servicing
  • Work with the electronics, mechanical and other teams to set up, maintain and improve their working spaces
  • Build cables and harnesses to drawing, including crimping, soldering and testing
  • Build sub-assemblies, prototypes and test rigs for engineers, carry out simple machining, drilling, cutting, fitting and finishing, rework or repair as needed, and support applications, manufacturing and service with hands-on tasks

Education and experience

  • A technical qualification in engineering or similar, or a clear equivalent through an apprenticeship and hands-on technician experience

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • More than 5 years’ experience as a lab, workshop or production technician
  • Hands-on cable and harness assembly, including crimping and soldering
  • Confident use of hand tools and basic mechanical assembly
  • Working knowledge of workplace health and safety practice
  • An organised approach to stock, tools and housekeeping
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Able to work independently, setting priorities based on company goals and targets, and happy to support colleagues across all functions
  • Takes ownership, spots problems early and acts on them, with pride in neat, accurate and well-documented work

We’d love to see:

  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 or J-STD-001 training or certification, or IOSH, first aid or fire marshal training
  • Experience in ESD-controlled or cleanroom environments, or in a precision instrumentation or semiconductor-related business
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality systems and stock or ERP systems

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st stage: (45 minute) Remote meeting to evaluate your experience and technical ability

2nd stage: (2.5 hours) Face to face onsite evaluating technical, presentation and communication skills along with your ways of working and your opportunity to to know more about us

If you're not comfortable with eye contact, let us know at the start of your interview and if REMOTE, once we've said hello, feel free to turn your camera off until the end.

We dress casually so informal attire is absolutely fine for onsite interviews. We want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know. 

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

Location and working pattern:
Due to the nature of the role, you will need to be onsite Monday to Friday

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. Please do not submit candidate details in response to this advert or solicit any Infinitesima Ltd employees. Infinitesima Ltd is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

 

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

 

Problems you'll work on

  • Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback.

  • Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter.

  • Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

  • One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

  • Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

  • Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

  • Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

  • Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

  • Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

  • Take prototypes from your research-focused teammates and turn them into shipped features

  • Contribute to platform design decisions, take part in design reviews and help us hire

  • Work with Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Kubernetes and GCP/AWS

     

Who we're looking for

  • An owner. You take ambiguous product needs, make the architecture calls and carry the work all the way into production.

  • A systems thinker. You design for scale and reuse, and you know when a simple, solid baseline beats a clever solution.

  • A great collaborator. You enjoy working across research, product and engineering, and you make it easier for everyone to ship.

  • A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time building and operating ML systems or model-backed products in production at scale

  • Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience deploying modern deep learning models in production, with a strong understanding of model serving, inference optimisation, GPU utilisation and performance trade-offs.

  • Experience designing and operating scalable, distributed production systems, ideally involving GPU workloads, high-throughput data processing or low-latency inference.

  • The ability to reason through an ML system end to end, from data and model choices to offline and online evaluation, deployment, monitoring and retraining

  • A track record of personally owning complex systems from design through to production

  • Bonus: computer vision or multimodal deployment experience (not required), model-serving frameworks, or experience with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Daily company lunches

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

Putting People First.

We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time.
