title: Senior Manager Retail & Products met I&L/FMCG-ervaring
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met Groothandel, FMCG, (Maak-)industrie of Logistieke ervaring en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou!

Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products help je onze klanten in de Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en FMCG-sector om (digitale) koplopers te worden. Je begeleidt hen bij het klantgerichter maken van hun strategieën en proposities. Of het nu gaat om het ontwerpen van een nieuwe omnichannel-strategie of het ontwikkelen van een innovatief deliveryconcept: jij zorgt dat onze klanten transformeren en relevant blijven.

Je werkt hierbij met multidisciplinaire teams, gespecialiseerd in strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie, organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Je begrijpt de strategische aspecten van bedrijfsverandering en weet anderen uit te dagen om buiten de gebaande paden te denken.

Bij IG&H groei je continu in een inspirerende omgeving, dankzij de diversiteit aan klanten en vraagstukken. Als senior manager leid je grote klantprojecten, werk je nauw samen met senior stakeholders op C-level, en krijg je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor het project en account development.

Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het ontwikkelen van het Retail & Products-team en onze proposities en ben je een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?
Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken?

Wat zeggen je toekomstige collega's?

“IG&H is echt anders dan andere strategieconsultants. Wij hebben een warme benadering en een zorgzame cultuur. De scherpte van IG&H-consultants en de state-of-the-art digitale oplossingen, die leiden tot daadwerkelijke resultaten bij onze klanten, halen het beste in mij naar boven – elke dag.” Cazijn Langeler – Managing Director Retail & Products

“De huidige groeifase van IG&H biedt een geweldige kans om mezelf te ontwikkelen op een breed spectrum aan vaardigheden, omringd en ondersteund door heel veel intelligente mensen.” Guus Boonstra – Manager Retail & Products


Wat neem jij mee?

· Afgeronde universitaire master.

· Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in strategie en digital consulting.

· Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren.

· Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken.

· Een relevant netwerk in de Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector.

· Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde businessmodellen en langetermijnstrategieën.

· Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden:

· Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige werksfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen.

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

· Direct een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

· Uitstekend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden.

· Auto van de zaak / goede mobiliteitsregeling.

· Een fulltime dienstverband, maar indien gewenst ook de mogelijkheid om (al dan niet tijdelijk) parttime te werken (80%), minimaal 4 dagen per week.

· Wij ondersteunen incidenteel werken in het buitenland voor maximaal 4 weken per jaar.

· 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er meer op te nemen.

· De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar dienstverband een sabbatical op te nemen.

· IG&H faciliteert een Healthy Human-programma, waarbij je begeleiding krijgt bij alle aanpassingen in het leven, zoals het krijgen van een kind of het verzorgen van een ziek familielid.

· Royale bonusregeling.

· En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen.


Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.


Ben je enthousiast?

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met één van onze recruiters via

We willen dat onze werknemers de diversiteit van de maatschappij weerspiegelen. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is er trots op een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een baan, ongeacht hun afkomst, religie, geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit! Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat we allemaal trots zijn op onze prestaties bij onze klanten en daarom zijn we niet voor niets een Great Place to Work.

descriptionHtml:

Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐

We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. 

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.


🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

  • Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.
  • Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.
  • Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.
  • Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.
  • Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.
  • Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.
  • Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.
  • You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.
  • You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.
  • You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.
  • You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

title: Senior Marketplace Integrity Manager
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Marketplace Integrity team protects trust on GetYourGuide by safeguarding the platform from fraud and abuse, so that travelers, suppliers, and partners can rely on every transaction and interaction.

We’re building a new Marketplace Abuse Prevention function within Marketplace Integrity to strengthen our ability to detect abuse patterns and stop them before they cause harm. The work brings together investigation based on data, policy design, and close collaboration with Product, Tech, and Business to create prevention mechanisms that scale. We’re looking for someone who thrives on building from the ground up and is excited by the chance to shape a function with real impact.

Your mission

  • Define the vision, structure, and operating model for GetYourGuide's Marketplace Abuse Prevention function; establishing how abuse is identified, prioritised, and governed across the company

  • Set clear KPIs, targets, and frameworks that bring rigour and focus to a newly built function

  • Lead the discovery and risk mining of new and emerging abuse patterns across the marketplace and acting as the detective who surfaces what others miss

  • Distill insights from data analysis and internal escalations into comprehensive mitigation strategies, translating these into scalable prevention mechanisms in collaboration with Product and Tech

  • Build and maintain continuous monitoring systems and AI-powered detection workflows that proactively flag emerging threats at scale

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of experience in marketplace integrity, trust & safety, fraud, or risk management

title: Senior Mechanical Analysis Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

You will be responsible for mechanical calculations for all systems or part of the system in Thorizon’s reactor design. As a key member of the calculation expertise center, you will provide mechanical calculation expertise to the teams responsible for reactor design studies and ensure the delivery of mechanical calculation work within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints.
 
You will develop mechanical calculation expertise to meet the needs of the Thorizon project and its future developments, ensuring the quality and validity of the studies and work performed across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK.
 
You will hold a functional leadership role over the team of structural analysis engineers and will be integrated into a broader, multidisciplinary group of mechanical design engineers and materials experts, reporting to the Head of Mechanics and Materials.


In this role you will:
  • Define, execute, and deliver mechanical calculation work, including calculation specifications, strategies, assumptions, and calculation notes, within the project’s performance, cost, and time constraints.
  • Lead a group of mechanical calculation engineers across projects, from PILOT to FOAK/NOAK, providing in-depth calculation engineering input and ensuring that design choices are technically sound and consistent with requirements and applicable Codes & Standards.
  • Ensure the correct use of calculation tools, develop specific tools, and maintain high-quality, reliable studies.
  • Prioritize work according to project needs and recommend any necessary actions within your area of expertise.
  • Participate in external networks, including international initiatives, to stay at the forefront of industry developments.
  • Put your knowledge to use, develop your ideas, explore different aspects of mechanical engineering, and play a crucial role in the company’s growth



About you:
  • You hold a master’s degree and bring more than 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering calculations.
  • You have at least five years of experience in FEM simulation and analysis, covering linear structural analysis, structural seismic response, thermal stress and fatigue, with advanced or expert proficiency in ABAQUS and/or ANSYS.
  • You bring at least three years of experience applying ASME III and/or RCC-M.
  • You lead by listening and supporting your team, with at least five years of experience managing a team of fewer than 10 people.
  • You combine a strong understanding of calculation-based design engineering with a practical approach to supporting the design team.
  • You have good knowledge of CAD practices and experience using them.
  • You are proficient in office applications.
  • You enjoy working with people who bring different experiences and backgrounds. You adapt your working style to the situation and the people involved, while maintaining technical rigour.
  • You enjoy tackling challenging problems and developing your knowledge.
  • You look at problems from different angles, reducing unnecessary complexity to find practical solutions. Your approach is pragmatic and constructive.
  • You work independently and rigorously within your area of expertise.
  • You exercise sound engineering judgement, considering both your discipline and the wider project. You prioritise your work according to the key issues at stake.
  • You listen before responding, communicate concisely and respectfully, and remain calm under pressure. You write clearly and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written; French or Dutch is also preferred.
  • You produce work that serves as a reference for your colleagues.

What you can expect from us:
  • The opportunity to help realize the most promising reactor technology and advance Europe's energy future.
  • Being part of an exceptional team that combines engineering rigor, scientific excellence, and entrepreneurial drive.
  • Working in multidisciplinary teams on ambitious missions, with responsibility and meaningful impact from day one.
  • A fast-moving deep-tech environment where initiative is valued and people are trusted to make decisions.
  • Complex, multidisciplinary challenges that will stretch you and accelerate your growth.
  • Competitive compensation and participation in our employee profit-sharing plan.
  • An international workplace with offices in the heart of Amsterdam and Lyon.

title: Senior Motion Planning Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role:

As Senior Motion Planning Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping how our autonomous ground systems navigate safely, efficiently, and robustly through complex environments. You will develop motion planning capabilities that transform perception, localization, maps, mission objectives, and vehicle constraints into decisions and trajectories that our autonomous vehicles can execute in the real world.

You will take strong technical ownership of motion planning systems, architecture, and engineering decisions. You will contribute hands-on to complex technical challenges, challenge existing approaches, evaluate trade-offs, and continuously improve the reliability, scalability, and real-world performance of our planning capabilities.

As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with teams across perception, localization and mapping, control, simulation, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex autonomy challenges into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces, requirements, and technical priorities across teams and support the transition of motion planning capabilities from development and simulation onto physical vehicles operating in the field.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of motion planning capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the systems that enable autonomous ground vehicles to navigate complex environments.

  • Design and develop robust motion planning solutions, translating perception inputs, localization data, maps, mission objectives, and vehicle constraints into safe and executable decisions and trajectories.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating planning failures, improving algorithms, debugging system-level issues, and optimizing performance for real-world vehicle operation.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate operational and product needs into technical solutions, working with relevant stakeholders to define clear requirements, priorities, interfaces, and implementation plans.

  • Drive collaboration across the autonomy stack, working closely with perception, localization and mapping, control, simulation, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration teams to establish robust interfaces and shared technical priorities.

  • Keep motion planning closely connected to the real system, using simulation results, automated testing, field testing, vehicle data, operational feedback, and real-world failures to improve performance and reliability.

  • Improve verification and validation coverage, contributing to scenario-based testing, simulation workflows, performance metrics, and automated evaluation methods for motion planning capabilities.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing software and system designs, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards and development practices.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address integration, performance, safety, scalability, and maintainability challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for motion planning, communicating architectural decisions, technical challenges, dependencies, and improvement opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.



What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in autonomous driving, robotics, motion planning, controls, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in autonomous systems and motion planning, with experience designing, developing, and evolving planning capabilities for complex robotic or autonomous systems.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience developing complex production systems for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or other cyber-physical systems.

  • Solid understanding of motion planning methods, such as trajectory generation, path planning, search-based planning, optimization-based planning, sampling-based methods, behavioral planning, or comparable approaches.

  • Experience working with vehicle and system constraints, including vehicle dynamics, kinematics, safety margins, collision avoidance, environmental uncertainty, and real-time performance requirements.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around reliability, scalability, maintainability, and system quality.

  • Proven ability to solve complex engineering problems hands-on, including debugging system-level behavior, analyzing field failures, evaluating technical trade-offs, and developing pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience with simulation and scenario-based testing, using virtual environments, automated evaluation, recorded vehicle data, or comparable methods to develop and validate motion planning capabilities.

  • Experience delivering complex systems across team boundaries, managing technical dependencies and balancing engineering quality, operational constraints, verification requirements, and delivery commitments.

  • Experience working across the autonomy stack, particularly with perception, localization and mapping, control, simulation, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship, supporting other engineers through design discussions, code and architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

  • Excellent judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, influence engineering decisions, align stakeholders, and drive technical topics across organizational boundaries.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Senior Network Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal ein gewachsenes Netzwerk neu geordnet:
Segmente getrennt, Standorte sauber angebunden und alles so dokumentiert, dass auch andere damit arbeiten können? Und Sie möchten genau das jetzt über mehrere Standorte und mit voller Verantwortung umsetzen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel und Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis.

Warum diese Rolle

Das Netzwerk ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird jetzt neu strukturiert. Die Netze werden getrennt und segmentiert, die Produktionsnetze abgesichert, und es entstehen verbindliche Standards. Ziel ist eine performante, ausfallsichere und gegen Angriffe belastbare Netzwerklandschaft, auf der alle IT-Services aufsetzen.

• Weil Sie die Netzarchitektur über mehrere Standorte selbst prägen.

• Weil Ihre Arbeit sichtbar wird: in stabilen Verbindungen, sauberen Segmenten und einer Doku, mit der andere arbeiten können.

• Weil eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen Rückhalt gibt, auch wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb klappt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von LAN, WAN und Backbone an allen Standorten

• Routing und Switching inklusive VLAN-Konzept und Redundanz

• Standortvernetzung per VPN und sichere Remote-Zugänge

• Betrieb der Firewalls (Fortinet) und Neuordnung gewachsener Regelwerke

• Segmentierung der Netze und Trennung von IT und OT, damit die Produktion geschützt läuft

• WLAN und Access Points

• Netzpläne, IP-Adressverwaltung und Standards, die das Netz für alle nachvollziehbar machen

Zur Einordnung: Security-Monitoring und SIEM betreibt ein externer Partner, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Clients, Server und Anwendungen betreuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im IT-Team. Ihr Schwerpunkt ist das Netzwerk selbst, von der Verkabelung bis zum Routing.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Netzwerkadministrator oder Network Engineer, idealerweise inhouse in einem Industrie- oder Produktionsunternehmen

• Sie haben Netze konzipiert, strukturiert und dokumentiert, gern auch als Allrounder mit klarem Netzwerkschwerpunkt in einem kleineren Unternehmen.

• Fundiertes Know-how in Routing und Switching sowie Erfahrung mit der Vernetzung mehrerer Standorte, idealerweise international

• Praxis mit Fortinet oder vergleichbaren Enterprise-Lösungen, etwa Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco oder Sophos

• Erfahrung mit Produktionsnetzen und der Trennung von IT und OT

• Sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit den Standorten

• Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Cisco CCNA/CCNP oder vergleichbar

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Dazu kommen projektbezogene Reisen zu den Standorten.

• Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Bikeleasing

• Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Hersteller-Zertifizierungen

Gehalt

60.000–70.000 € brutto im Jahr plus Tantieme, je nach Erfahrung

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin. Stefan Schulz meldet sich bei Ihnen für ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.

title: Senior Optical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Optical Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK.

Position Overview

London · Full time · On-site

You'll own optical design across our laser ranging stations, optical tracking systems and retroreflector products. This is a hands-on senior role. You'll set the architecture, run the analysis and be in the lab when it's built.

What you'll do

  • Lead optical design for transmit and receive paths, from requirements and tolerancing through to verified hardware

  • Design and test optics for tracking satellites in daylight and at night

  • Support the design and test of retroreflector arrays for LEO and MEO missions

  • Run trade studies with suppliers on telescopes, windows, coatings and filters

  • Mentor graduate and junior engineers, and set our standards for optical design and test

  • Write technical content for ESA and customer programmes

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in optical engineering, ideally on astronomical, laser, defence or space instruments

  • Strong skills in optical design software (Zemax OpticStudio, CODE V or similar) and in tolerance analysis

  • Hands-on alignment, metrology and test experience (interferometry, wavefront sensing, radiometry)

  • A working knowledge of high-power laser optics: coatings, contamination and damage thresholds

  • Clear technical writing for design reviews and bids

Nice to have

  • Experience with satellite laser ranging, lidar, free-space optical comms or adaptive optics

  • Stray light analysis

  • Observatory or telescope experience

  • ECSS or ESA project experience

What We Offer

  • A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

  • EMI share options (UK employees)

  • 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Cycle to work schemes

  • Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

We actively champion underrepresented groups and seek to bridge gaps in our workforce. If you're excited by the role but don't match every point, or you’re seeking a part time role, please apply anyway and add a note into your application. Building the best team is our priority.

title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.



Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at

title: Senior Product Designer, International Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

Our mission at Oura is to empower every individual to own their inner potential. The Oura Ring and its accompanying app help our global community gain a deeper understanding of their health, lifestyle, and sleep. The Commerce team makes that experience easy to discover, evaluate, and purchase across our direct-to-consumer website and other commercial channels.

Oura is looking for a Senior Product Designer to help make our international DTC experience first-class. This is an e-commerce-focused product design role with a clear growth mandate. You will take global DTC product work and make it relevant and compelling for non-US markets. That means more than translating pages or swapping images. You will design the local experience across content, creative, merchandising, experiments, payments, shipping, and checkout.You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Research, and market stakeholders. You will help us learn what should be consistent across markets, what should be adapted locally, and where local customer needs should change the product itself.This role reports to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

What You Will Do:

  • Adapt global DTC journeys for international markets, balancing shared foundations with local customer needs, behaviors, and cultural context.
  • Design market-specific experiences across discovery, merchandising, product evaluation, product detail, purchase, membership, and post-purchase.
  • Partner with local market, Creative, and Marketing teams to localize campaigns, imagery, content, offers, and brand expression.
  • Translate local customer insights, competitive patterns, and business needs into global product decisions and reusable market-launch patterns.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, average order value, attach rate, and customer confidence across international funnels; seek to reduce time to purchase cycle
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, and experiments across acquisition, landing pages, product pages, bundles, upsells, membership, and checkout.
  • Use qualitative research, quantitative data, funnel analysis, customer feedback, and experiment results to prioritize work and guide product decisions.
  • Design and evolve cart and checkout experiences that support local payment methods, currencies, taxes, duties, shipping, delivery estimates, returns, and regional requirements.
  • Create clear experiences for availability, inventory constraints, payment and authentication states, order confirmation, and other operational edge cases.
  • Ensure localization improves relevance without changing the meaning of the transaction, price, product, or order state.
  • Produce user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and implementation-ready specifications within Oura’s design system, responsive, and accessibility standards.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Operations, Payments, and Customer Care through critique, implementation, QA, launch, and post-launch iteration.

This role is a hybrid role out of our London office, with a preference for in-office 2 times a week.

This role will work across UK, EMEA, and US time zones, with a focus on our priority markets and creating a repeatable playbook for our emerging ones.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products, with meaningful experience for e-commerce, DTC, marketplaces, or other transactional products.
  • Experience designing for international or multi-market products. This may include localization, internationalization, regional content, multi-currency, local payment methods, shipping, tax, duties, or returns.
  • A portfolio that shows strong end-to-end product design, from problem framing and exploration through launch and iteration.
  • Experience using AI tools like Figma Make, Claude, Cursor to accelerate research, exploration, prototyping, documentation, or production work is a plus.
  • Able to connect design decisions to funnel behavior and business outcomes without reducing design to a single conversion metric.
  • Experience designing and learning from experiments, A/B tests, or other structured product tests.
  • Strong interaction and visual design craft, including responsive web design, content hierarchy, prototyping, and design systems.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to build strong working relationships with market partners
  • Curiosity about customer behavior across cultures and markets, with the humility to learn from local experts and customers.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends & family
  • Flexible working hours and remote working arrangements
  • Wellness Time-Off
  • Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

title: Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph | United Kingdom | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph

This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. 

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success.

As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best.

Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences.

You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user
  • Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity
  • Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives
  • Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team
  • Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations 
  • Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements
  • Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users
  • A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them
  • Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind
  • Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space
  • Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity
  • Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain
  • Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring
  • Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact

When you apply, please:

  • Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 83,726 - GBP 100,470. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
🤝 Qui sommes-nous ?

Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.

Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale :

Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.

Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.

Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care, bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.

Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.

La culture n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs mais incarnons nos valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.

🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi !

Nous cherchons un(e) Product Designer passionné(e) pour imaginer l’expérience de nos membres, clients, praticiens avec Moka.

Tu travailleras en collaboration avec l’équipe produit (2 Product Managers, 1 Product Designer, 1 Product Content Manager), et l’équipe tech (10 personnes) sous la responsabilité d’Eloïse, Head of Product & Operations.

Le produit Moka :

  • Pour les collaborateurs, une prise de rendez-vous avec le psychologue, coach ou thérapeute le plus adapté à leurs besoins, une application self-care avec des outils de développement personnel, méditation et respiration, et des parcours guidés personnalisés, du micro-learning
  • Pour les managers et les directions ressources humaines, des outils pour prendre soin des équipes, une plateforme d’administration pour élaborer des plans d’action concrets, organiser des sessions collectives
  • Une expérience disponible sur Web, Mobile, Slack & Microsoft Teams

Tes missions au quotidien :

  • Discovery & User Research :
    • Mener des recherches utilisateurs selon les méthodes adaptées à chaque projet, afin de comprendre les utilisateurs.
    • Tester les solutions en amont, améliorer l'adoption et l'utilisation des solutions en aval seul-e ou en collaboration avec un Product Manager.
  • Prototypage & UX Design :
    • Concevoir la solution la plus efficace pour résoudre un problème, en tenant compte des contraintes et du contexte.
    • Produire des prototypes basse et haute fidélité, mener des Design Review avec l'équipe Produit & Tech.
    • Contribuer à la construction et la maintenance du design system, capitaliser sur l’existant.
  • Delivery & Evangelisation :
    • Suivre la qualité pendant la phase de développement avec les développeurs, apporter des suggestions et des retours à l'équipe de développement.
    • Produire des écrans et visuels impactants pour permettre la communication autour des fonctionnalités du produit.

Exemples de projets sur lequel tu pourrais travailler :

  • Refonte des parcours coeurs de l’application pour améliorer l’usage sur l’application mobile.
  • Adaptation de l’interface à un usage multi-langues pour des clients internationaux.

Nos outils : Notion, Figma, Maze, Claude, Jimo, Slack

Notre organisation s’inspire de la méthodologie Shape Up.

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si :

  • Tu as 5-6 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Designer, de préférence sur des produits Web ou SaaS (conception, wireframe, prototype, tests utilisateurs, feedback loop).
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des méthodologies de design et recherche et sais appliquer une méthode pertinente à chaque projet. Tu es curieux(se) et tu as déjà testé des manières d’intégrer l’IA dans ton travail.
  • Tu connais la puissance de poser les bonnes questions, tu t’intéresses aux motivations des utilisateurs et de tes stakeholders.
  • On dit de toi qu’il est agréable de collaborer avec toi, que tu as de l’ownership, de la curiosité, une bonne capacité de delivery, que tu as le sens du détail, que tu sais proposer des compromis intelligents.
  • Tu parles français couramment et anglais avec une capacité professionnelle.

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas :

  • Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.
  • Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen des solutions de santé mentale B2B.
  • Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe exigeante.
  • Etre responsable de ses objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour nous emmener au niveau suivant.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi :

  • Accès à Moka.Care : selfcare, sessions individuelles et de groupe et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles features !
  • Work-life balance: 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois).
  • Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop.
  • Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois)
  • Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour
  • Gymlib, pour faire du sport
  • Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT
  • Leeto, pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE
  • Mutuelle : SideCare
  • 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo
  • Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise

🎤 Processus de recrutement

Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré.

  • 30 minutes - screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations
  • Who Interview pour comprendre ton parcours et tes réalisations de manière plus approfondie
  • Une étude de cas et un job focused interview pour te permettre de te projeter sur le quotidien que tu pourrais avoir
  • Et un Values fit interview pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront
  • Offre et reverse interview: l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision.

Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe.

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Senior Product Engineer, AI
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

We’re looking for Senior Product Engineers to join the AI Group to build Fin's AI-powered products. Product Engineers working in ML work closely with both our ML Scientists and product teams. They must deeply understand our product, our customers, our ML tech stack and our broader product stack. 

Our group is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.

We are an extremely product focussed team. We work in partnership with Product and Design functions of teams we support. Our team's dedicated Engineers enable us to move to production fast, often shipping to beta in weeks after a successful offline test.

We are very passionate about applying machine learning technology, and have productized everything from classic supervised models, to cutting-edge unsupervised clustering algorithms, to novel applications of transformer neural networks. We test and measure the real customer impact of each model we deploy.

If you are an experienced product engineer who takes an analytical approach to development and has some hands-on experience with ML systems, we'd love to hear from you! 

What will I be doing? 

Product Engineers in the AI Group

  • Build the systems that power Fin's flagship AI products. This usually means working in our ML Python tech stack, but at times also means working across the product on our Rails app too.
  • Work alongside our ML Scientists bring proof-of-concept code to production; ensuring it’s robust and scalable for real-world use.
  • Partner with product teams outside of our group, to shape the best AI-powered product experience for our customers..
  • Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, and implementation and testing.
  • Play an active role in the hiring, mentoring, and career development of other engineers.
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence within the group and across Fin.

Profile we’re looking for

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents.

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

👩‍⚕️Health:

  • Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children

  • Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide

title: Senior Radar Signal Processing Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Perception and AI team is responsible for how STARK's unmanned systems perceive their surroundings and know where they are. We are a multidisciplinary group of software and navigation engineers developing perception and navigation algorithms for resource-constrained platforms. As a member of this team, you will collaborate closely with sensor, autonomy and test engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Together, we make sure our systems navigate and operate reliably in contested environments, even when GNSS is not available.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Radar Signal Processing Engineer at STARK, you will lead the development of our radar processing chain: turning raw sensor data into reliable 3D detections, in real time, on embedded hardware. Your ultimate goal is to deliver radar measurements that our navigation and mapping algorithms can depend on in the most demanding conditions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

- Design and implement the full radar processing chain: range-Doppler processing, angle estimation and detection.
- Develop robust clutter suppression, multipath mitigation and detection methods for changing terrain, vegetation and weather.
- Deliver 3D detections with Doppler and quality metrics, and define the measurement interface with our radar navigation engineers.
- Evaluate radar sensors with our sensors team and integrate your work with embedded software, autonomy and test teams.
- Take algorithms from Python/MATLAB prototypes to production C++ on embedded compute, and analyse field data to characterise performance and failure modes.
- Constantly challenge requirements and take ownership of radar signal processing as a capability at STARK.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

- You have taken a radar processing chain from raw ADC data to detections on real hardware, not only in simulation.
- Deep understanding of radar signal processing range-Doppler processing, direction-of-arrival estimation, detection theory, clutter â€” and of the underlying radar physics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Physics or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

NICE TO HAVE

- MIMO radar and array processing
- Radar on moving platforms, including ego-motion compensation
- Embedded acceleration (GPU, SIMD, FPGA)
- Learning-based radar detection or classification
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
Vertrieb, Beauty und Verantwortung für deinen eigenen Standort.

Du hast Freude am Verkauf, kannst Menschen begeistern und möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team etwas bewegen? Dann werde Sales Manager / Standortleiter (m/w/d) bei hairfree in Düsseldorf.

Bei uns verbindest du persönliche Kundenberatung mit aktivem Vertrieb und der Leitung unserer Lounge. Du berätst Menschen, die sich bereits für dauerhafte Haarentfernung interessieren, begleitest sie bis zum Vertragsabschluss und entwickelst deinen Standort gemeinsam mit deinem Team weiter.

Dein Vorteil im Vertrieb: Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. So kannst du direkt an ihren Wünschen anknüpfen und dich auf überzeugende Beratung und erfolgreiche Abschlüsse konzentrieren.

Über uns

Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen.

Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Unser Ziel ist es, Menschen zu einem neuen Hautgefühl zu verhelfen, sicher, individuell und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Bei hairfree erwarten dich klare Strukturen, moderne Prozesse, ein starkes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung und gute technische Ausstattung.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte und Vergünstigungen.

  • Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkmöglichkeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beraten und verkaufen: Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, erkennst individuelle Bedürfnisse und gewinnst Kundinnen und Kunden für die passende Behandlung.

  • Vertragsabschlüsse erzielen: Du erklärst Angebote verständlich, beantwortest Fragen und führst Interessierte verbindlich bis zum Abschluss.

  • Kontakte nachfassen: Du bleibst an offenen Anfragen und Angeboten dran und vereinbarst konkrete nächste Schritte.

  • Deinen Standort steuern: Du behältst Umsatz, Vertriebskennzahlen und Terminauslastung im Blick. Daraus leitest du Maßnahmen ab, die deine Lounge voranbringen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst dafür Rückhalt: Mit einer persönlichen Einarbeitung, regelmäßigen Trainings und einem Team, mit dem du Fragen und Herausforderungen gemeinsam angehen kannst.
