title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Scientist — Organoid Model Development
descriptionHtml:
Job description

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them — and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

We are looking for a passionate, hands-on Senior Scientist to expand Orakl's biobank to new indications. Working with significant autonomy and reporting to Gizem Altay, Principal Scientist, you will own the establishment of patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — starting with NSCLC and extending to additional tumour types — from tissue receipt and dissociation through to stable, well-characterised lines ready for downstream applications. You will develop and optimise robust culture protocols, ensure reproducibility across donors, and generate the high-quality biological models that power our AI predictive engine and our partnerships with hospitals and pharma.

Preferred experience

Must have

  • PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, biotechnology, or a related field, as well as 5+ years of hands-on experience, including industry or translational settings.

  • Proven, hands-on experience establishing NSCLC patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — including tissue handling, dissociation, embedding, and long-term expansion.

  • Strong track record in primary tumour culture, including troubleshooting low take-rates, and donor-to-donor variability and other optimization including: media formulation, matrix selection, passaging strategies, cryopreservation etc.

  • Exceptional wet-lab fundamentals: sterile technique, routine culture, assay development, and QC.

  • Prior experience in building scientific direction, ownership of QC/characterisation strategy, and decision-making

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan, prioritise, and execute complex experimental pipelines with high quality and reproducibility.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative data-interpretation skills, with clear documentation and reporting.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience collaborating with hospitals, pathology departments, or surgical teams on biospecimen workflows.

  • Experience with drug-response profiling in organoids (dose–response, time-course, combination assays).

  • Knowledge of molecular biology techniques and NGS workflows (WES, RNA-seq) for organoid characterisation and tumour-organoid concordance.

  • Previous responsibility for managing CROs or academic collaborations.

  • Experience mentoring junior scientists or lab technicians, and establishing lab standards.

What will you find at Orakl

  • Mission: Work in a cutting-edge environment, on the bleeding edge of cancer research.

  • Growth opportunities: we’re rapidly expanding the scope of our work and you will be offered multiple opportunities to grow with it!

  • Impact: you’re going to be participating in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project with multiple opportunities to shape it according to your interests.

  • More about Orakl on our Welcome to the Jungle page and on our website

Recruitment steps

  1. Introduction call (20min) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  2. Technical Interview (45min) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  3. Case Interview (1h) – A case study or problem-solving exercise to assess your strategic thinking and analytical abilities. In-person when possible to meet the team.

  • Reference calls - 2-3 references including at least a direct manager.

  1. Culture Fit Interview (45min) – A conversation with our team to ensure alignment with our company culture, values, and ways of working.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Security Engineering team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working alongside our security operations team as well as the wider Kaluza software and platform engineering teams. Our mission is to equip teams with the necessary tools and guidance to build and innovate whilst upholding security best practices and safeguarding our clients’ data.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Integrating security platforms and tooling as well as harnessing AI to proactively prevent, accurately detect, and effectively respond to emerging security threats

  • Partnering with Platform Engineering and IAM teams to embed Zero Trust architecture and ensure the implementation of strong privileged access management (PAM) controls

  • Empowering Kaluza’s product teams to rapidly deliver secure systems by cultivating a strong, collaborative security culture

  • Delivering actionable guidance to product and engineering teams on identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating systemic risks and vulnerabilities

  • Be responsible for defining and evolving security best practices for our systems, and for helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Working closely with release engineering to embed security tooling into the Kaluza release process, ensuring that vulnerabilities are detected and prevented early in the development lifecycle

  • This is a varied role where you’ll be exposed to the full stack and will work across technologies including AWS, Cloudflare, Okta, Datadog, Crowdstrike and Kubernetes. You’ll be focusing on projects spanning infrastructure, release engineering and security detection

What you will have

 

  • Knowledge of AWS and/or GCP security best practices

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes security best practices

  • Extensive experience working with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., terraform)

  • Experience managing web application firewalls (e.g., Cloudflare)

  • Awareness of common software security flaws and web application security best practices (OWASP top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25)

  • Knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps principles and security considerations

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work and/or enabling others

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent, for workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Some scripting experience (Python, Go)

  • Experience of providing consultancy to other engineering teams, such as reviewing technical designs and facilitating threat modelling

Communication, quality & delivery

You’ll be…

  • Skilled at identifying gaps in requirements and contribute to the planning process

  • Able to demonstrate factoring in cost, industry standards and understanding of your organisation when making technical decisions

  • Experienced at coaching and/or mentoring other engineers

  • Proficient at quickly understanding problem areas and, through collaboration, forming a strategy to resolve issues

  • Good at communicating and collaborating effectively with engineers as well as stakeholders

  • Experienced at helping progress technical maturity within a team, working with them to balance strategic delivery with maintenance, innovation and tactical support work

 

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
About the role:

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. You will tackle complex technical challenges hands-on, challenge existing approaches, identify limitations, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our simulation environment.

As a senior engineer, you will also act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with engineers across autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex simulation needs into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces and requirements across teams and ensure that our simulation capabilities address real engineering challenges and become an integral part of autonomy development, continuous testing, and system-level verification.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of simulation capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the simulation systems used for autonomy development, testing, and verification.

  • Design and develop scalable simulation solutions, building realistic, reliable, and reproducible environments that enable autonomy software to be tested across complex scenarios before deployment on physical vehicles.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate autonomy and verification needs into technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into clear simulation concepts, priorities, and implementation plans.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating technical limitations, improving simulation fidelity and performance, and solving problems that require deep technical expertise.

  • Drive collaboration across the Land Domain, working closely with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams to identify where simulation provides the greatest engineering value.

  • Keep simulation closely connected to the real system, using field data, vehicle testing, real-world failures, and operational feedback to continuously improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing technical approaches, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards, development practices, and continuous improvement.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address scalability, maintainability, integration, and verification challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for simulation, communicating technical challenges, architectural decisions, dependencies, and opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.



What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous driving, physical systems, vehicle dynamics, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in simulation and autonomous systems, with experience designing, building, and evolving complex simulation environments used for development, testing, and verification.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience building or extending simulation infrastructure using technologies such as CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, or comparable simulation environments.

  • Solid understanding of physical simulation and autonomous systems, including areas such as vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), scenario-based testing, and the trade-offs between simulation fidelity, performance, determinism, and scalability.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around scalability, maintainability, reliability, and system quality.

  • Proven ability to solve complex engineering problems hands-on, including debugging system-level issues, evaluating technical trade-offs, challenging existing approaches, and developing pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across engineering disciplines, collaborating effectively with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams.

  • Experience connecting simulation with real-world systems, using vehicle testing, field data, operational feedback, and real-world failures to improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship, supporting other engineers through design discussions, code and architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, influence engineering decisions, align stakeholders, and drive technical topics across organizational boundaries.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

At FanDuel, our principle of “We Are One Team” runs through all our offices across the globe, and you can expect to be a part of an exciting company with many opportunities to grow and be successful.

THE POSITION
Our roster has an opening with your name on it

Our remit is to enable customers to easily sign up and manage all details of their user accounts across FanDuel products. We primarily use Java and some Python along with a lot of Terraform on AWS. It’s also important to be comfortable working on the frontend (React).

We’re looking for passionate technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will have the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work in empowered, multidisciplinary teams, autonomously tackling complex challenges that provide the very best experiences and products for a growing community of millions of players.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an Engineer unfamiliar with the system can understand. You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.).  

  • You own parts of product and technology & strive to become a subject matter expert.

  • You estimate stories/tasks accurately and deliver them in time. You keep yourself up to date with industry tools, utilities, and open-source frameworks.  

  • You participate in the interview process and help your team train other Software Engineers.

  • You will keep yourself up to date with market standards, open-source frameworks.

  • You participate in the on-call support rotation for your organization.

  • Most importantly, you are humble, pragmatic, self-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied and always challenging the norm. Responsible for the state of the code you both inherit and produce.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us build and operate the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Get to know our Engineering team, what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, EventBus and related streaming platforms.

  • Debug complex distributed systems issues, including performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production reliability challenges.

  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.

  • Contribute to incident response, operational readiness and continuous improvement for Tier-0 infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with EventBus, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams across US and EU regions.

  • Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo's event streaming platform.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.

  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.

  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.

  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.

  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do.

What you'll build and own

  • Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on.

  • Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction.

  • Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows.

  • Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness.

  • Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services.

  • Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions.

  • Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras.

Your experience

  • At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment.

  • A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not.

  • Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways.

  • Comfortable with the full lifecycle - design, build, operate, improve - with evidence of genuine end-to-end ownership rather than handing off to other teams.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI development tools in your daily engineering workflow; you validate AI output rather than blindly accepting it.

  • Strong opinions about system design, API contracts and service boundaries, backed by real examples you can walk us through.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to fintech, payments or identity/KYC systems.

  • Experience building SDKs or developer-facing platform services consumed by other engineering teams.

  • Prior work in a high-growth startup or scale-up (roughly 50-500 people) where you had to set standards, not just follow them.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Carbon and Environmental Models (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The team at Klim is building the operating system for regenerative agriculture. We help farms restore their soil - and we turn that into real, measurable business value for the food companies, banks and insurers who depend on it.

We’re a Berlin-based agritech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and ADM to build supply chain resilience through regenerative agriculture. Since 2020, we’ve supported +4,000 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

Join our incredible team of 80+ dedicated people across Germany, the UK, Poland and Czechia to help build a more sustainable, resilient food system and drive real climate impact.

Your mission:

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role:

As a Senior Technical Program Manager of Applied AI, you will sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and industrial-scale execution. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, effectively acting as the CEO of your customer's business to proactively drive success. You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.

  • Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.

  • Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.

  • High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.

  • End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.

Qualifications

  • Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up.

  • Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain).

  • Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

 

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • London, UK (highly preferred)

  • Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

title: Senior Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Underwriter to join our Underwriting team. As a Payment Facilitator, we onboard and oversee our merchants directly. You will assess and onboard a varied portfolio of these merchants, with a focus on marketplaces and platforms. You will own complex underwriting cases from start to finish. This includes reviewing ownership structures and financial health, setting risk exposure limits, and making clear recommendations that protect the business while helping our merchants grow.

This is a senior position. You will be expected to use sound independent judgement, guide less experienced colleagues, and help improve our underwriting policies, procedures and tools.

Key responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end underwriting and onboarding of merchants, including complex cases, ensuring decisions follow internal risk appetite, regulatory requirements and card scheme rules.
- Underwrite marketplaces and platforms, assessing the business model, flow of funds and customer journey.
- Onboard merchants with complex organisational structures, including multi-layered ownership, group entities and cross-border structures, identifying ultimate beneficial owners and controllers.
- Screen merchants, directors, UBOs and connected parties for PEP status, sanctions and adverse media using screening tools, and assess and escalate potential matches appropriately.
- Review merchant websites using third-party website monitoring providers to identify content violations, prohibited or restricted products and services, missing or inadequate terms and conditions, refund and privacy policies, and inconsistencies with the declared business model.
- Carry out credit risk analysis on merchants by reviewing financial statements, management accounts and bank statements to evaluate liquidity, profitability, solvency and trading patterns.
- Assess financial exposure, including chargeback, refund and delivery risk (e.g., future delivery and prepayment models), and recommend suitable mitigants.
- Write clear, well-reasoned underwriting summaries and recommendations for approval, setting out key risks, mitigants and the rationale behind each decision.
- Conduct periodic reviews and re-underwriting of existing merchants, monitoring changes in risk profile, processing behaviour and financial standing.
- Work with Sales, Risk, Compliance and other teams to give timely, commercially aware risk decisions.
- Coach and support junior underwriters, reviewing their cases and sharing knowledge across the team.

Requirements

Essential:

descriptionHtml:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute bench level tests according the validation plan during pre-silicon and post-silicon phases to ensure product meets functionality and performance as per the datasheet

  • Bench test and debug of embedded on-chip circuitry (amplifiers, data converters, power converters, etc.) to ensure functionality and performance as per the datasheet.

  • Work with Validation and Production Test engineering peers to implement best practices and continuous improvements to Cirrus Logic backend test methodologies.

  • Collaborate closely with Design, Systems, and Application Engineers to understand requirements and use cases.

  • Design, develop, and debug silicon validation board-level hardware and bring-up the platforms prior to first silicon.

  • Develop automated test framework and regression test suites in Python to optimize validation efficiency.

  • Analyse test results and identify failures/defects using business intelligence tools such as Spotfire

  • Write technical reports/summaries of all data collected.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Electronics or other related subject area, and relevant experience in a related field.

  • Advanced electrical engineering knowledge in audio electronics, analog, digital or power electronics.

  • Solid hands-on experience in lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, signal generators, audio analyzers, logic analysers, spectrum analysers for measurement and debugging issues

  • Sound electrical engineering knowledge in analog, digital, power electronics or audio engineering. This includes mixed signal building blocks such as ADC, DAC, PLLs, amplifiers, signal processing and measurement, IC control/communication protocols

  • Self-motivated with excellent problem solving skills and attention to detail - you will need to understand silicon, board and software interactions

  • A highly driven approach to problem solving


Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  • Experience in areas such as post silicon validation, mixed-signal IP block design/validation, audio related signal processing, power management and algorithm, validation related automation framework
  • Experience using simulation tools such as LTSpice to support circuit design
  • Experience in various automation framework hardware tools (FPGA, DSP, NI Data Acquisition) or software tools/languages (Scripting languages such as C and Python, SQL, test sequencers such as NI Teststand, Spotfire, schematic capture tools)
  • Shown Proficiency in system understanding of various industry interface standards such as I2C, SPI, USB, I2S, TDM or high-speed control/data bus as example
  • Experience in version control tools such as Git, SVN and Perforce

title: Software Engineer II - Code Context
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer

Location: London, UK

Join Code Context, a team helping to shape the future of AI-powered work at Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt. You'll solve challenging technical problems and build tools that help employees work smarter, move faster, and deliver better outcomes across a global business serving millions of customers, riders, and partners.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll join an engineering-led team focused on a fundamental challenge in AI-assisted software development: giving coding agents the right context to work effectively. As a Software Engineer on the Code Context team, you'll build developer tooling and infrastructure that connects AI agents with the knowledge, systems, and workflows they need. Your work will help every employee across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt make better use of AI in their day-to-day work.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Build Developer Tooling: Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and tooling that make relevant context accessible to AI coding agents across complex codebases and workflows.
  • Own Technical Projects: Independently take technical projects from design through delivery and adoption, evaluating approaches, making sound technical decisions, and measuring their impact. Contribute to the team's technical direction in a fast-moving AI landscape.
  • Build for Reliability & Scale: Ensure the systems behind our developer tooling remain reliable, performant, and secure as adoption grows. Use observability, feedback, and real-world usage to identify issues and continuously improve the developer experience.
  • Collaborate & Influence: Work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders across Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and drive adoption of AI-powered tooling.
  • Support Peers & Grow: Share technical knowledge, provide constructive feedback, help unblock colleagues, and contribute to engineering interviews and hiring as the team grows.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong Engineering Fundamentals: Experience building and operating production systems at scale, with a strong foundation in software architecture and a commitment to writing well-designed, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • AI-Native Engineering: Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) throughout the software development lifecycle, with a practical understanding of how agent harnesses manage tools, context, and execution.
  • Autonomy & Judgement: You independently solve complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and communicate clearly across teams and time zones. You hold all your work, AI-assisted or otherwise, to high standards of quality and correctness.

Customer-Driven Iteration: You enjoy working directly with the people using your tools, understanding their workflows, gathering feedback, and using data to measure impact and continuously improve the experience.

  • Dogfooding Mindset: You actively experiment with AI tools, build solutions to problems you encounter, and have informed opinions about what makes developer tooling good. You're curious about emerging capabilities and eager to put new ideas into practice.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

title: Special Projects Manager (Strategy & Operations)
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers allemand courant (Télétravail depuis Besançon) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información
