title: Vertrieb Industriewasseraufbereitung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes und wachstumsstarkes Unternehmen in der Umweltbranche mit den Geschäftsbereichen Industriewassermanagement und Entsorgung & Verwertung. Als führender Anbieter für Betriebsführungs- und Betreiberlösungen in der industriellen Abwasseraufbereitung und Prozesswasserbehandlung bietet das Unternehmen ein breites Portfolio für das Wassermanagement in der produzierenden Industrie – von Betriebsführungskonzepten über Wartung und Instandhaltung bis hin zu eigenen Betriebschemikalien.

Wir suchen keine Verwalter – wir suchen echte Macher mit Vertriebsgen. Menschen, die Chancen erkennen, Verantwortung übernehmen und den Anspruch haben, beim Kunden wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

Das Unternehmen ist Teil einer international aufgestellten, vertikal integrierten Unternehmensgruppe mit rund 45 Gesellschaften und entsprechendem Zugang zu Infrastruktur, Technologie und Verwertungswegen sowie echten Wettbewerbsvorteilen im Markt.

Am Standort München oder in der Filiale in Offenbach an der Queich arbeitest du nah am Markt und übernimmst eine aktive Rolle im Ausbau des Geschäfts. Du bist nicht nur Ansprechpartner, sondern Treiber: Du erkennst Potenziale, entwickelst Lösungen und bringst sie beim Kunden auf die Straße. Dabei kannst du dich auf ein erfahrenes Team im Hintergrund verlassen, das dich operativ unterstützt.

Aufgaben

  • Du gewinnst neue Industrie- und Gewerbekunden für unsere Lösungen im Bereich Industriewasser, Abwasserbehandlung und Entsorgung und betreust den bestehenden Kundenstamm; dabei berätst du zu wasserwirtschaftlichen und abfalltechnischen Fragestellungen.
  • Du analysierst Kundenprozesse (z. B. Prozesswasser, Abwasserströme), bewertest Stoffströme und entwickelst passende Lösungen – von der Aufbereitung über Kreislaufführung bis zur Entsorgung.
  • Du erstellst Kalkulationen sowie Angebote und bringst technische Lösungen wirtschaftlich sauber auf den Punkt; Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabengebiet.
  • Du verhandelst eigenverantwortlich Verträge, führst Preis- und Vertragsverhandlungen und schließt Verträge mit Neu- und Bestandskunden ab.
  • Du begleitest Projekte und Großaufträge, koordinierst interne Schnittstellen (Technik, Betrieb, Logistik) und stellst eine reibungslose Umsetzung sicher.
  • Du pflegst Kundendaten und Dokumentationen und stellst sicher, dass alle abfall- und wasserrechtlichen Vorschriften sowie Qualitätsrichtlinien eingehalten werden.
  • Du beobachtest den Markt, erkennst Trends im Bereich Industriewasser und Kreislaufwirtschaft und repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen.

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in der Abfall-/Wasserwirtschaft, Verfahrenstechnik, Umwelttechnik, Chemie beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare kaufmännische oder technische Qualifikation.
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Entsorgungs-, Umwelt- oder wassertechnischen Dienstleistungen sowie in der Projektbegleitung; idealerweise auch Erfahrung in der Wasser- und Abwassertechnik oder der industriellen Prozesswasserbehandlung.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis der Abfallwirtschaft, Kreislaufwirtschaft sowie grundlegender wasserwirtschaftlicher Prozesse; Fähigkeit, Stoffströme und Prozesszusammenhänge zu bewerten.
  • Ausgeprägtes Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsgeschick.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Teamfähigkeit und sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office-Anwendungen.
  • Erfahrung mit der Bestimmung der Trockensubstanzkonzentration (CTS) und Umgang mit entsprechenden Analyseverfahren ist ein Plus.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und umgangssprachliche Englischkenntnisse.
  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft.

Benefits

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer nachhaltigen Zukunftsbranche mit langfristiger Perspektive.
  • Transparente Vergütung mit erfolgsabhängiger Leistungsvergütung, Spesen und Corporate Benefits.
  • Dienstwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte.
  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit Home‑Office‑Möglichkeit und familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten.
  • Intensive Einarbeitung und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungs‑ und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Flache Hierarchien, ein motiviertes Team und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.

Fragen zur Position und zum Unternehmen beantwortet dir gerne Felix Wilhelm telefonisch oder per WhatsApp unter 0176 954 220 94. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung, möglicher Eintrittstermin).

Vous maîtrisez particulièrement :

→ SQL (indispensable) : requêtes complexes, optimisation et manipulation de données

→ PostgreSQL (indispensable) : modélisation relationnelle, restructuration et migration de bases de données

→ Architecture logicielle : conception de solutions backend, schémas d'architecture et choix techniques

→ API REST : conception, intégration, sécurisation et gestion de la compatibilité

→ Heroku : déploiement, configuration et maintenance d'applications

→ Git, CI/CD et tests automatisés : qualité du code et bonnes pratiques de développement

Une expérience avec Salesforce Service Cloud, NestJS ou des frameworks Python tels que FastAPI, Flask ou Django REST Framework serait appréciée.

title: VP Data & AI Platform Engineering
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Quantexa’s largest customer engagements are now enterprise platform transformations, and we want to replicate that success across strategic customers globally. We are establishing a dedicated platform function for the first time, and we are looking for a player-manager to lead it. Reporting to the SVP of Data & AI Platform Solutions, you will build and lead a small, senior, global team of platform architects. You will shape how Quantexa takes its Data & AI and Context Layer propositions to market, and you will personally lead support our most strategic pursuits, supporting large platform deployments from early technical engagement and proof of concept through to value realisation and expansion. Success means more platform deals won, larger and faster-moving pursuits, and customers who expand their use of the platform after go-live. That track record is what will earn the team its growth. The role is greenfield: you will define what the function owns, how it works and how it scales within the context of the wider operating model.

What You’ll Be Doing

Win strategic platform deals

  • Lead the technical and business narrative on targeted global accounts, working alongside field engineers and sales.

  • Map the customer’s enterprise ecosystem, uncover high-value use cases and data, build the business case for enterprise platforms and context layer, and take get buy-in from it to the C-suite.

Shape platform propositions and build support for transformational deals

  • Define and sharpen Quantexa’s platform propositions for target industries and buyer personas, drawing on what we learn in live customer engagements.

  • Give technical input to platform market positioning and messaging for the platform and context layer, working with Marketing so that what we say in the market is credible and differentiated.

  • Build the support that transformational deals need: executive narratives, reference architectures, business case materials and proof-of-concept approaches. Make these reusable across accounts.

  • Present the propositions at customer and industry events, as a credible technical voice on enterprise data platforms and agentic AI.

  • Work with the Alliances team, Marketing and Product so that partner and technology-ecosystem conversations reinforce the propositions.

Connect customer needs to platform strategy and the product roadmap

  • Identify the features, capability gaps and needs that customers and deals expose, and use them to inform platform strategy.

  • Define platform requirements and work closely with Product Management to ensure the necessary changes are incorporated into the product roadmap.

  • Test new platform uses, including agentic AI and the Context Layer, with Product Innovation and Delivery, and help turn proven ideas into market validated and technically de-risked features as candidates for introduction into product.

  • Build the demos and integrations that show customers the value.

Build and lead the team

  • Set the direction and standards for a global team of platform architects, and coach and develop them.

  • Launch the team with three new approved roles and use early wins to secure investment for further growth.

  • Shape how the team works with Field Engineering and regional account teams, and where it focuses its effort in line with strategic priorities.

Create a repeatable platform method

  • Own the methodology and toolkit that take a customer from a first use case to wider platform adoption.

  • Work with the Enablement and Marketing teams to enable partners, customers and colleagues to run platform engagements themselves for self-sufficiency in applying best practice approaches for platform and context layer – contributing content and helping coordinate execution.

What you’ll bring?

  • A record of C-suite, business and technical engagement, including running executive workshops.

  • Experience managing and influencing teams of architects and developing senior technical talent.

  • The ability to work with Product and Marketing: you can turn customer needs into clear requirements and explain technical differentiation to a market audience.

  • The agility of a player-manager: you can lead a senior executive meeting in the morning and be hands-on with a design or demo in the afternoon.

  • Broad architecture experience:

  • enterprise architecture, for vision and roadmaps

  • solution architecture, for shaping opportunities

  • data architecture, for designing data products

  • The technical depth to be credible with CTOs, CDOs and Chief Architects on data integration, platform architecture and secure deployment models.

  • Hands-on building experience. You can design systems and have built non-trivial components, ideally with AI coding tools such as Claude.

Nice to have

  • Experience of the Databricks or Snowflake ecosystems, or of hyperscaler data platforms.

  • Experience supporting large programmes delivered with systems integrators.

  • Experience of building a new function or team.

  • Experience in a product-facing role, such as defining requirements or contributing to a roadmap.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

descriptionHtml:
Have you ever found a voucher in a box from one of your online orders? Then you may have already met us without even knowing it!
For more than 15 years, we’ve been connecting e-commerce brands such as Outfittery, Wolt, UberEats, Mister Spex and MediaMarkt with their target audiences. Under our two brands, Affiliprint and ParcelDealz, we deliver targeted parcel insert and door-to-door mailing campaigns. As experts in media consulting, marketing and print, we make sure brand messages reach exactly the people they’re meant for.
With offices in Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium and Sweden, we run campaigns across Europe. Efficient, measurable and with passion.

As a Working Student (m/f/d) Data Operations & Process Support ...
you’ll find a meaningful job where you work with digital tools, improve processes in a structured way and make a real impact on the day-to-day of a dynamic company.

We’re looking for a working student (m/f/d) for up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately, to support our daily operations with campaign plans, calculations, and data preparation and maintenance.

Your responsibilities:

  • You help make processes more efficient and develop solutions for structured data preparation and maintenance.

  • You contribute ideas on how recurring tasks can be automated or simplified.

  • You take ownership of maintaining and developing spreadsheets, e.g. for our clients and partners, status tracking or data reconciliation.

  • You support incoming requests from the operations team, e.g. sheet adjustments, new automations or data validation.

  • You document functions, automations and workflows in a way others can easily understand.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fair pay for up to 20 hours per week

  • A meaningful role with direct impact. You take workload off our Product Owner and, with that, the entire operations team.

  • Varied tasks and individual onboarding. Every question is different, and so is every process. During your onboarding, you’ll get to know various methods and tools that make your daily work easier.

  • Flexible working. Work from our beautiful office at Oldenburg’s city harbour or, by arrangement, from home. After your onboarding phase, partial remote work is possible.

  • Access to the Linehub Academy as well as regular training and development opportunities.

  • Focus on People & Culture. Through various initiatives, we connect our teams online and offline. Get-togethers and events leave plenty of room for personal exchange.

  • A company in transformation, with you as a driver of digital processes.



  • You’re an enrolled student in business, business informatics, IT, data science or a similar field.

  • You already have hands-on experience with Excel, Google Sheets or other spreadsheet tools (formulas, pivot tables, possibly simple automations/scripting), or you can convince us of your skills in another way.

  • You work in a structured, independent, reliable and solution-oriented way.

  • You’re interested in tools, processes and data, and you enjoy making things better.

  • You speak excellent German and good English (at least B2 level).


ABOUT LINEHUB
Linehub is a marketing collective of 11 specialised agencies. We believe that together we are more than the sum of our parts. Our strong internal culture and the relationships we’ve built with one another are the key to our success.
At Linehub, we go one step further: for you, for each other, for our partners and for society. We strengthen each other by working together, with our colleagues and with our partners. We strive to be an exceptional place where you can be yourself. A place with room to relax and have fun, both during and after work. A place with room for development, progress, optimisation and your contribution. For our goals and for you personally. Because when you grow, we grow too.


MAKE IT WORK!
